description: The facade of the United Bank of City-States looms in the shadows, presenting an immoveable front to the forces of time and weather.  Tall stonework columns brace gracefully arching stonework embrasures, each of which frames an octagonal glaesine tracery window glowing from within.  Low granite steps lead upwards into the bank.

The facade of the United Bank of City-States looms skyward, presenting an immoveable front to the forces of time and weather.  Tall stonework columns brace gracefully arching stonework embrasures, each of which frames an octagonal glaesine tracery window.  Low granite steps lead upwards into the bank.

Beneath a dome of sapphire tiling, the United Bank of City-States looms, presenting an immovable front to the forces of time and weather.  Though the rest of the building is a silvery blue granite, the tall columns that frame the windows are white marble, as are its four peacock shaped gargoyles.  A small flight of steps leads upwards and inside.  Beyond the edge of the var stretches the expanse of Ta'Illistim Green.

title: [Bank of Ta'Illistim, Lobby]
description: The stained glaes rosette windows, capturing just enough moonlight from the night sky, cast a rainbow of shimmering color across the bank's pure white marble floors.  A richly hued Loenthran carpet, vibrant in shades of wine, sapphire and emerald, rests in front of the bank's entrance.

The stained glaes rosette windows cast a rainbow of shimmering color across the bank's pure white marble floors.  A richly hued Loenthran carpet, vibrant in shades of wine, sapphire and emerald, rests in front of the bank's entrance.

The establishment's patrons wander through a corbelled stone arch.  Fashioned of the same mica-flecked granite that graces the Sapphire Gate, the arch towers above, nearly reaching the peak of the bank's vaulted ceiling.  The arch is carved with a pattern of sinuous dahcres.

Fashioned of the same mica-flecked granite that graces the Sapphire Gate, a corbelled stone arch towers above, nearly reaching the peak of the bank's vaulted ceiling.  The establishment's patrons wander through the opening as they go about their business.  Set back in the wall is a small alcove that is partially obscured by a curtain of ivory velvet.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: The Shimmarglin Court, surrounded by shops, provides a home for the city's famed floating garden.  Throngs of townspeople and travellers move through the court, shopping at the various merchants and socializing in small groups.  Torches placed at regular intervals illuminate the walkways threading through the area.

The Shimmarglin Court, surrounded by shops, provides a home for the city's famed floating garden.  Throngs of townspeople and travellers move through the court, shopping at the various merchants and socializing in small groups.

In the darkness cast by the floating dais overhead, a few tables and shop stalls remain open through the night, lit by unflickering blue lanterns.  The detritus of a day's commerce still litters the cobblestones.  Around the edges of the courtyard, the porticos of the more permanent buildings have already been swept clean.

In the lee of the floating dais overhead, small shops and temporary stalls are set out to catch potential customers passing by on their way to the gardens.  The cobblestones are nearly obscured under the mass of commerce waiting to happen.  Around the edges of the courtyard, more permanent buildings fight for the space around their own arched doorways and porticos.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Hanging Gardens]
description: Although the floating platform is suspended well above the ground below, it overflows with abundant plant life.  The edges of the dais are brimming with delicate white queen's lace, dark lavender, fragrant rosemary and a variety of other colorful flora.  Thick grass underfoot provides an enticingly peaceful resting spot.  A thin silk canopy is suspended above, providing ample shade from the day's brightness.

Although the floating platform is suspended well above the ground below, it overflows with abundant plant life.  The edges of the dais are brimming with delicate white queen's lace, dark lavender, fragrant rosemary and a variety of other colorful flora.  Thick grass underfoot provides an enticingly peaceful resting spot.  A thin silk canopy is rolled back to permit an unobstructed view of the starry night sky.

The dais is ringed by a series of slender columns, each one simply fluted and carved from perfectly white marble.  Within the circle of the columns' embrace, and elevated high off of the ground, a tiny garden of cultivated plants grows.  Closed roses climb around the carved legs of a mistwood bench, which sits alongside neat beds of night blooming columbine and a tended plot of white jasmine.  Over the whole enclosure is a coffered dome set with an oculus.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: A low grey stone wall provides a backdrop for several flowering trees, each sending a small shower of petals tumbling towards the ground with each stir of the night breeze.  The court is relatively quiet, as a few shoppers visit merchants and a single group of travellers chat amongst themselves.  Warm amber light shines from the northeast and the glowing glaesine windows of the imposing Shimmarglin Inn.

A low grey stone wall provides a backdrop for several flowering trees, each sending a small shower of petals tumbling towards the ground with each stir of the day's breeze.  The court is bustling with activity as shoppers visit merchants and groups of travellers chat amongst themselves.  Much of the pedestrian traffic flows to the northeast towards the imposing Shimmarglin Inn.

A colonnade frames this section of the Court, attached to the portico of a low-slung white marble building.  Access to the porch is blocked, however, by a pair of tables, each covered for the night with a white tarpaulin.  Overhead, the slowly spinning bulk of the dais looms.

A colonnade frames this section of the Court, attached to the portico of a low-slung white marble building.  Access to the porch is blocked, however, by the mass of stalls and tables set up in front of it.  A wide path winds through the confusion, unobstructed, but by no means straight or direct.  Overhead, the slowly spinning bulk of the dais casts a shadow below.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: Crenellated like a miniature fortress, the facade of the city's armory towers above.  Though the building's grey stone walls are weathered with time they still show the chisel marks used to form the massive blocks.  Twin bronzed breastplates flank the wide door leading into the establishment.  Several city guardsmen stand nonchalantly nearby watching for signs of troublemakers.

With an undecorated pediment and plain frieze, the facade of the city's armory towers above.  The building's silvery blue stone walls are weathered with time, showing their age in worn water rivulets and soft edged corners.  Twin silver breastplates, each emblazoned with the Illistim peacock, flank the arched door leading into the establishment.  Above the roofline, a dais hovers.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: A steady patronage frequents a nearby building, undoubtedly a bakery judging from the fragrant scents emanating from within.  Several beds bursting with rosemary, lavender, thyme, and other herbs frame the shop's cobblestoned walk.

Twin smokestacks protrude from the top of a long, low building.  Around their outputs, the marble that makes up the building's cladding is tinged a dirty grey, off from the overall white.  A further grey on the building is a deep shadow, cast from the shape of a floating dais raised over the roofline.

description: The bottom of the floating dais overhead falls over this patch of the courtyard, shrouding the cobblestones below in a darkness only broken by the purposeful placement of a few silver lanterns.  Their unflickering blue light illuminates a white marble boutique.

The bottom of the floating dais overhead falls over this patch of the courtyard, shrouding the cobblestones below in a dim, perpetual gloaming.  Nonetheless, the space is filled with impermanent shelving and carrels, set out with no regard for order, placement, or easy passage through the morass.  Settled in the center of the chaos is a white marble boutique.

The northern corner of the court is relatively quiet, the low hum of conversation punctuated only by the occasional bursts of laughter emanating from the nearby dais.  A row of monir trees delineates the curvature of the cobblestoned lane, their leafy boughs creating a shady resting spot.

title: [Wehnimer's, Land's End Rd.]
description: Vigilant night guardsmen scrutinize the citizens and travelers arriving and departing through the wide gates spanning the land route into Wehnimer's Landing.  The cluttered streets of the city to the south are a far cry from the deceptively calm expanse of the wilds of Elanith outside.  Two daunting towers survey the countryside and protect the town, flanking the road to the east and west.

title: [Land Tower East, Office]
description: The ground floor of this guard tower appears to be some kind of office.  A single guard sits behind one of the desks reviewing some paperwork.  A small wood stove in the corner provides heat to the room.

title: [Land Tower West, Dining Room]
[Land Tower West, Infirmary]
description: This large open room serves as a combination dining and recreation room for the guards stationed in the two land towers.  Although the room is empty, the long wooden tables are set for the next meal.  In the corner, a wooden ladder leads to the upper levels of the tower.

Formerly a dining room for the tower guards, this large open room has been converted to a makeshift infirmary.  Most of the wooden tables have been shoved against the walls, though a few have been draped with linens to serve as treatment platforms.  A battered metal cabinet, sparsely stocked with healing herbs, hangs near the entrance.  Having borne the brunt of bleeding bodies and rotting corpses, the wood floors are clean, but heavily stained.  A sturdy ladder leads to the upper levels of the tower.

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]
description: This intersection links the bazaar routes with those bisecting and encircling the Landing.  A few ruddyfaced sailors, loudmouthed dockworkers, and off-duty soldiers linger along the wall of a tavern, which is set back from the side of the road up a slight incline.  A shaky wooden stairway, the bane of many an overimbiber's existence, leads up to the tavern door.

title: [Helga's Tavern, Barroom]
description: The blended odors of ale, sweat, leather, perfume and hearty stew fill the stifling air of the tavern.  Disheveled regulars and road-weary travelers rub elbows at the wooden bar, which looks recently varnished but already bears a variety of stains and grime.  Helga, the ancient, obese proprietor, moves behind the bar, wiping glasses with a dirty towel as she keeps a beady eye on the patrons.  A small fireplace in one corner burns feebly, adding little light or warmth to the room.

title: [Town Square, West]
description: Here in the midst of the town stretches the cobblestoned main bazaar, its lamplit lanes abuzz with traders and vendors hawking their wares at any hour of the day or night.  Groups of citizens, discussing the day's events or preparing for nighttime hunts, gather around the doors of the merchants whose shops border the square.  The gilded but peeling stone facade of the First Elanith Bank dominates this side of the square.

Here in the midst of the town stretches the cobblestoned main bazaar, its serpentine lanes abuzz with traders bartering, bickering, and hawking their wares.  The freewheeling vendors in the bazaar provide a lively alternative to the somewhat stodgier merchants whose shops border the square.  The gilded but peeling stone facade of the First Elanith Bank dominates this side of the square.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [First Elanith Bank, Lobby]
description: An ancient gnoll keeps a watchful, though nervous, eye over the people visiting Wehnimer's Landing's main bank, the First Elanith Secure Stronghold.  Large, dirty windows allow little air to disturb the layers of dust on the threadbare carpet.  The few flickering candles around the room add virtually no light.  A broken gate from a teller's window sits in the corner.

title: [Wehnimer's, West Ring Rd.]
description: The lane to the east leads into the heart of town and the main square.  Pedestrians and carts laden down with cargo make their way along the road.  The back wall of the grocer's shop borders the road, its wide door surrounded by piles of rough gunny sacks and stacks of wooden crates, some empty, others still to be unpacked.

The lane to the east leads into the heart of town and the main square.  The back wall of the grocer's shop borders the road, its wide door surrounded by piles of rough gunny sacks and stacks of wooden crates, some empty, others still to be unpacked.

title: [Dark Cavern, Dead End]
description: The passage ends suddenly here, blocked by a wall of rubble where the tunnel has collapsed.  The glowing greenish lichen that covers the landslide is well-worn in several places as if someone or something had crawled over it many times, and a slight current of fresh air seems to come from above.

title: [East Row, Monir Road]
description: The massive, hulking posts of the fortifications to the east are reinforced with large stakes of monir, as if the wall here was once a weak point.  To the west, a variety smaller monir trees line the roadway, their boughs braced upon one another in a natural, arching motion.

title: [Fleurs' Glowing Goods, Entry]
description: Enclosed by polished oak walls, the shop features a subtle arrangement of fragrant pink stargazer lilies accented by tiny white iceblossoms in the center of its oak floor.  A painted silk wall panel hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a lacquered white rosewood cabinet.

title: [Wehnimer's, Bay's Watch East]
description: This remote northeast end of Wehnimer's Landing, swept by the fresh breeze from the bay, seems far removed from the commerce and activity of the town to the west.  A few guards and militiamen patrol here, the intense look on their faces as the watches come and go bespeaking of the importance of the round-the-clock vigil they keep.

title: [River Tower East, Headquarters]
description: Papers are strewn over the desk that stands in the middle of the room.  On the wall behind the desk is a banner with the insignia of the guard regiment assigned to man the walls and watchtowers of Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [Kilron's Pawnshop, Front Room]
description: This little pawnshop is somewhat cheerier than you would expect, presided over by its well-dressed and well-heeled owner, Kilron.  A polished white marble counter is set off by freshly whitewashed walls and a highly varnished wood floor.  An antique cabinet on the far wall holds several impressive and equally ancient weapons, some precious trinkets, and several items that you cannot identify, except that they seem to glow in different shades of colored light with different intensities.

title: [Pawn Shop, Backroom]
description: This backroom is where many of the items pawned are offered for resale.  On one wall a prominent sign reads, "Warning:  All items that are sold here are used merchandise and sold on an "as-is" basis with no guarantees and no refunds. -- Kilron".  A sales clerk stands nearby, ready to offer help with any purchases.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: The narrow trail curls around the side of the hill, swerving to avoid clumps of trees.  The wind is coming up the hill now, and the trees offer little protection to your chilled limbs.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: The forest thins nearer the top of the hill, and you find yourself bracing against the constant, nagging chill.  Old trees, gnarled by years of assault, shudder against the cold winds, cowering yet strong against the constant harassment of the elements.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: The evidence of a lightning strike is more pronounced here, and even massive trees have been felled and charred.  One impressive ruin is the huge trunk of a fallen modwir, which lies upon the ground.  Just barely the height of a man, a hole in the trunk shows it to be hollow.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Hollow Tree]
description: The buzzing of ceaseless activity shows this fallen trunk is far from dead, rather it is teeming with life.  The flurry of activity centers around a beehive clinging to the tree's inner wall.  The warm, sweet smell of clover honey and gathered pollen, and the gentle, purposeful humming of the bees, lull you into a sense of security.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You are standing on the western shore of the Locksmehr river.  From here you can see the southern water entrance to the town of Wehnimer's Landing.  It is through this entrance that the boats returning from their upstream sojourns to the south have access to the town.  A rough trail descends a rocky slope toward a stand of willow trees.

title: [Willow Grove]
description: A rough trail winds down a rocky slope from the bridge above, passing through a stand of willows.  The trees' lacy fronds move slowly at the prompting of a light breeze off the river.  They stand together, growing more dense the closer one gets to the bank.  The path meanders between the trunks, running at an angle from the swift current of the water with its constant susurrus and sparkling reflections of sunlight.

They stand together, growing more dense the closer one gets to the bank.  The path meanders between the trunks, running at an angle from the swift current of the water with its constant susurrus and twinkling reflections of moonlight.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: You are wandering through the grasslands of Lower Dragonsclaw.  This area is hilly, but not enough to justify the mountain which juts out from the ground to the east.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wet Ravine]
description: Moss and fungus coat the rocks at either side of this deep, wet ravine.  The ground is slippery with mud and leaves.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: The strange song of the Sirenflower is more distinct and more eerie here.  Tree branches, heavy with the old growth and dripping with vines, seem to bend over in mourning.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: Townsfolk meander into and out of the city's weaponry shop, carrying fat purses on the way in and large packages on the way out.  Three of the city guardsmen stand near the establishment's door, keeping a watchful eye on the comings and goings.

A square stone shop, ringed with columns on all four faces, stands at the edge of the courtyard.  To either of side of it are buildings of white marble, though the square building is, instead, silvery blue granite.  A floating dais hovers over the center of the open space.

A square stone shop, ringed with columns on all four faces, stands at the edge of the courtyard.  To either of side of it are buildings of white marble, though the square building is, instead, silvery blue granite.  A series of smaller, less permanent stalls have been erected in front of all of the storefronts, hovered over by a floating dais.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Hanging Gardens]
description: Although the floating platform is suspended well above the ground below, it overflows with abundant plant life.  The edges of the dais are brimming with delicate white queen's lace, dark lavender, fragrant rosemary and a variety of other colorful flora.  Thick grass underfoot provides an enticingly peaceful resting spot.  A thin silk canopy is suspended above, providing ample shade from the day's brightness.

Although the floating platform is suspended well above the ground below, it overflows with abundant plant life.  The edges of the dais are brimming with delicate white queen's lace, dark lavender, fragrant rosemary and a variety of other colorful flora.  Thick grass underfoot provides an enticingly peaceful resting spot.  A thin silk canopy is rolled back to permit an unobstructed view of the starry night sky.

The dais is ringed by a series of slender columns, each one simply fluted and carved from perfectly white marble.  Within the circle of the columns' embrace, and elevated high off of the ground, a tiny garden of cultivated plants grows.  Closed roses climb around the carved legs of a mistwood bench, which sits alongside neat beds of night blooming columbine and a tended plot of white jasmine.  Over the whole enclosure is a coffered dome set with an oculus.

Over the whole enclosure is a coffered dome set with an oculus.  A small crack travels up the column and appears in the dome.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: The imposing facade of the Shimmarglin Inn dominates this corner of the court.  Flanking the inn's doorposts and hanging above each glaesine-paned window, grinning gargoyles stand in stony defense of the lair within.  A trickle of patrons flows through the inn's wide front doors, allowing a short-lived flood of light into the court with each swing of the doors.

The imposing facade of the Shimmarglin Inn dominates this corner of the court.  Flanking the inn's doorposts and hanging above each glaesine-paned window, grinning gargoyles stand in stony defense of the lair within.  A steady stream of patrons flows through the inn's wide front doors.

Two paths snake out of the courtyard and around the imposing facade of the Shimmarglin Inn, with its tall, arched doors and stained glass lancet windows.  In front of the building a line of silver torches lights up the open space, illuminating the hanging gardens above, as well as the Inn itself.

Two paths snake out of the courtyard and around the imposing facade of the Shimmarglin Inn, with its tall, arched doors and stained glass lancet windows.  In front of the building an open space has been carved out of the jungle of massed tables and temporary stalls, large enough to allow for safe passage through the throng and to the Inn itself.  Above, the floating dais spins slowly in the air.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The farmhouses and fields are closer together here as the road nears the village of Sylvarraend.  One of the farmers has left a plow nearby, apparently in preparation to till one of the fields for a new crop.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: A few patrons walk the cobblestones of the bazaar at night, their faces illuminated by glaesine-paned lanterns set before a row of storefronts.  Several of the shops have closed for the evening, thick curtains concealing the merchandise within.

In an attempt to draw customers, a quartet of musicians have set up in front of a row of storefronts.  Their effervescent music draws a small crowd and enthusiastic applause after every piece.  Several merchants watch appreciately outside the doorways of their cozy shops.

title: [Queen's Ransom]
description: Beneath a silk-draped ceiling with a twinkling chandelier, a series of platinum sconces hangs on one of the exquisitely muralled walls.  A circular cut-glass display and a crystalline counter sit in opposite corners while a stunning crystal statue rests on a lustrous cream marble floor.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Rocky Ledge]
description: The sheet of stone comes to a sudden end by swerving to rejoin the mountain.  Just at the terminus of the ledge, a tunnel has been carved into the face of the peak, providing access to the shelter within.  The sharp alpine wind rushes across the entrance, creating a harsh and ominous whistle.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: Some light spills through the entrance, but the tunnel quickly turns as dark and chill as krolvin dreams.  The smooth surfaces of floor and walls suggest that the passage was not created by nature.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Stone Steps]
description: A natural formation of stone steps comes to an end high atop the mountain.  At the very top of the stairway, years of travel have carved a shoe-shaped depression just in the spot where your foot wants to go to bring you to a narrow ledge.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Crevasse]
description: The gap between the walls of the crevasse widens from the weight of the stone into a small antechamber leading back out to the open air of the mountainside.  A small pile of torches lies to one side of the opening.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Mountain Ledge]
description: The rocky ledge comes to a sudden end at a dropoff apparently caused by the collapse of the ledge some time ago.  The wind whistles across the mouth of a deep crevasse that cuts the stone wall in two.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Crevasse]
description: It is hard to keep a thought in one's head, with the distraction of a high-pitched whistle that rises from the wind blowing across the mouth of the crevasse.  The high walls created by some massive rupture of the stone remain open to the night sky, though the trail itself is plunged into the deepest darkness.

It is hard to keep a thought in one's head, with the distraction of a high-pitched whistle that rises from the wind blowing across the mouth of the crevasse.  The high walls created by some massive rupture of the stone remain open to the sky, though the trail itself is deeply shadowed.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Tunnel]
description: The omnipresent sound of falling water fills the tunnel, silencing all other noises.  To the south, the tunnel opens into what appears to be a vast, underground cavern and the source of the nearly visible sonic vibrations.  To the north, the tunnel continues onward, fading into darkness.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Cavern]
description: The thunderous roar of the waterfall seems deafening, its descent into the darkness of the cavern sending up thick clouds of vapor.  A narrow, stone ledge works its way around the eastern side of the large cavern, opposite the tumult of falling water.

title: [DragonSpine Mountains, Crevasse]
description: The pass dwindles and disappears into a large crevasse.  Nearly black inside as compared to the bright light of day, dwarves and travellers hasten into the crevasse, from which odd grinding and squealing sounds can occasionally be heard.

title: [Kharag 'doth Dzulthu, Tunnels]
description: Several small torches are mounted upon the walls of this large cavern, casting a dim light across the faces of the occupants.  Half a dozen dwarves scurry about, directing passengers aboard a series of mining carts that barely stop long enough to allow entrance.

title: [Locksmehr River, Plank Bridge]
description: The bridge spans the shallow river, its planks well above the level of the water.  The bridge is built from weather-resistant cedar, and it even looks as if someone has taken the time to apply a coat of varnish to the handrail.  Someone made this bridge to last.  Below, the river snakes through boulders, rocks and logs as it slowly flows southward.  Fish dart from shady area to shady area as they search for food but fear the light.

title: [Locksmehr River Trail]
description: A plank bridge crosses the river.  The bridge appears weathered but extremely sturdy.  Whoever built it sunk the pilings deep into the river, then heaped up boulders against them to prevent the river from carrying the bridge downstream even in the highest water conditions.  The bridge sports steps on either end and a handrail on both the upstream and downstream sides.  Much farther to the south the river appears to join a second river.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Modwir pines rustle in the wind, and bluejays swoop back and forth among them, belittling you and each other in rough, raucous voices.  The main trail curves to the west and southeast, while a rougher trail heads up the side of the hill to the north.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Great blocks of stone thrust out of the earth all about you as you pick your way across the jagged landscape.  Here and there, a patch of crinkly lichen clings to the pale gray stone, but other than that, this area is devoid of plant life.  You hear a faint skittering in the distance, and think of claws on rock.  You glance around nervously, wondering what lives here.

title: [Reignbeau Caverns]
description: Many-hued clay forms the walls, ceiling, and floor of this low, twisting cavern.  Dozens of stalactites drip thick liquids in every color of the rainbow.  It takes a keen eye and a quick step to avoid an unintended change in hair color.  The clay that oozes from the walls and drops from above forms dozens of multihued puddles around you.  Grumbling, uncooperative dwarves loiter in every corner.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Order Room]
description: A massive dye-stained stone counter dominates the muddy rock-walled chamber, overseen by a disgruntled-looking dwarven clerk who glares and mutters to himself at each customer's approach.  Behind the counter, a dwarf-sized tunnel leads into some mysterious back room from which sounds of splashing and cursing and grumbling can be heard.

title: [Solhaven, Triton Road]
description: Ivy climbs the walls of a stone cottage.  Smoke curls from the chimney, leaving the air heavy with the scent of burning modwir.  An old man sits on the doorstep, whittling a stick.

title: [Imperial Courier Office, 'Haven]
description: Faint light from the street outside filters into the room through the a large oak-framed window, providing scant illumination for a pair of paintings hanging upon one wall.  Numerous large sacks, packages, and crates are stacked and organized behind a long wooden counter that dominates the back and side walls.  A pair of glass hurricane lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting soft light across the room.

Sunlight fills the room as it pours in through a large oak-framed window and illuminates a pair of paintings hanging on one wall.  Numerous large sacks, packages, and crates are stacked and organized behind a long wooden counter that dominates the back and one side wall.  A pair of glass hurricane lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting additional light across the room.

title: [Solhaven, Eastbridge End]
description: Standing out because of its crisp, but darker lines, as well as its location, the high wall surrounding the estate at the southern corner of the intersection is constructed entirely of grey brick.  Wrought iron arabesques and spikes adorn the top of the wall and the felwood gates at the compound's entrance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Huge Tower, Nexus]
description: Wooden planks reinforced with bands of steel form a circular platform high into the sky.  A tall ladder is bolted to the side of the tower, leading down toward the ground far below.  An arched roof overhead provides shelter from the elements, and the tower branches off into four main sections from this point.  The surrounding landscape is visible for miles, the horizon blurring into a blend of land and sky.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: Glimmering droplets of moisture coat the moss-covered trees and rocks, occasionally dripping to the sodden ground with a soft *plunk*.  A pile of massive boulders blocks the view to the east, the encroaching mist slamming harmlessly against the stone.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The trail wends its way up a steep hillside dotted with small trees which, at some point in their long-ago lives, found purchase in the rocky soil.  A pile of boulders blocks progress westward.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The trail moves along the edge of the ridgeline, skirting the bases of the massive trees dotting the cliffside.  Large granite boulders, many covered in glowing lichen, jut raggedly from the ground.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The dead trees thin somewhat, the rocky ground having made it difficult for them to colonize more ground in their days of life.  A pile of large rocks blocks the trail.

title: [Golvern and Dragonstail]
description: A massive drilling rig is set against the tunnel's east wall, placed to excavate further into the rock.  The rig looks a bit like a huge metal mole, with a conical screw for a snout.  It is idle just now, as are the dwarves who operate it.  They lean on their picks and grumble.  One kneels to look under the mole and scratches his head.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Hollowed directly out of the mountain, this office is little more than a formalized cave.  The walls are cold and damp, and the floor is uneven.  An old mining cart holds stacks of bundled paper, and rough plank benches provide somewhere moderately comfortable to sit.  Guttering torches hang in wall brackets, darkening the ceiling with soot.

title: [Canyon Alley, Khazar Way]
description: Canyon walls, smooth from rain and faded from the light, feature striated bands of color ranging from a deep rust to a pale sandstone.  The matching stripes on parallel sides of the alleyway clearly indicate this stone was once whole, though it's now separated by several lengths.  Twin rows of torches illuminate the pass, their golden light casting dancing shadows.

Canyon walls, smooth from rain and faded from the sun, feature striated bands of color ranging from a deep rust to a pale sandstone.  The matching stripes on parallel sides of the alleyway clearly indicate this stone was once whole, though it's now separated by several lengths.

title: [Raggler's Snack Pantry]
description: Beneath an extremely low orase ceiling, a large bridge tapestry hangs on one of the white-iced gingerbread-hued walls.  A tall invar cooling rack and a low display case sit in opposite corners while a gigantic brick oven rests on a messy flour-dusted floor.

title: [Basalt Flats, Colossal Boulder]
description: A huge boulder sits next to the trail, towering overhead in the moonlight like a hulking giant watching any who traverses the path.  Its granite composition is foreign to the surrounding basalt, as though the stone was dropped here by something so monumental that hefting such a boulder would pose no difficulty.  Beneath its considerable overhang, the darkness is dense and visibility, nonexistent.

A huge boulder sits next to the trail, towering overhead like a hulking giant watching any who traverses the path.  Its granite composition is foreign to the surrounding basalt, as though the stone was dropped here by something so monumental that hefting such a boulder would pose no difficulty.  Beneath its considerable overhang, mosses thrive in the perpetual shade.

title: [Outpost Tunnel]
description: The warm air hangs still in this subterranean corridor, surrounded by the hill on all sides.  Torches mounted along the walls merely illuminate the way, as there are no decorations or furniture to cast their light on.  The tunnel forks, leading toward a tall stone door to the northeast and a square stone door to the northwest.  A round steel hatch claims an unusual place in the tunnel's ceiling.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: You see a sharply descending cylindrical crawlway leading down into the depths of the volcano.  The air here is so hot it's painful to breathe.  This passageway is cramped, and the lava-scorched glassine walls seem somewhat unstable as they squeeze in from either side.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: This small alcove provides a little protection from the hot air and steam that constantly plague the area below.  Beads of sweat roll down your face and hands as you try and decide if you want to again venture downward back into the chaos.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: Your feet stir clouds of dust, which hang like pale ghosts in the still, musty air.  Ruined coffins line the walls of dark stone, each closed up tight for the ages.  High on one wall, a gaping hole leads back out.

title: [Mausoleum, Tomb]
description: A chill races up your spine as you see that even the dead were not spared the foul ransacking that most of the village was subjected to.  Stone coffins were ripped open, probably in search of treasure.  No mercy was shown, nor respect of any kind, as even the mummified remains of these bodies were ripped asunder and hacked to bits in order to obtain the jewelry they must have been wearing.

title: [Icemule, Hope and Fear]
description: The intersection of Hope Alley and Fear Alley creates a small esplanade in front of a square defensive tower in the northeast corner of Icemule Trace.  A few buildings dot the tiny square, and its black and white granite pavers ring out with the military cadence of halfling militia guards who periodically march from the corner towers to the gate barbicans along these narrow back roads.

title: [Northeast Tower, Entrance]
description: Several halfling guards keep watch over the staircase that curves around the tower's walls.  One always paces in front of an iron-barred gate across the stairs, while the others maintain poses of rest or prayer in corners of the room.  Two elaborately embroidered woolen tapestries adorn the hall, the only furniture save for a small wooden barrel conveniently placed for the collection of trash.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar and Cholen]
description: Koar Street ends in an ice-slicked hill that rises to merge with the town's outer wall.  The glacier stretches out over the road, blocking view of the sky, though street lamps with bases fashioned in the shapes of dancing figures illuminate the shrouded span.  Priests wearing the symbols of several orders come and go through an iron-gated tunnel in the ice, though some fill the cavernous space with their murmurs as they stand talking quietly with one another.  At the road's end, a frosted silver gate leads into a walled courtyard.

Koar Street ends in a huge hill of ice that serves as part of the town wall.  Priests representing several orders come and go through a tunnel in the ice, or stand talking quietly, carefully polishing symbols of their deities.

Koar Street ends in a huge hill of ice that serves as part of the town wall.  The only light in the area flows through an unobtrusive tunnel in the ice.  The sound of chanting can be heard from somewhere deep within the hill.

title: [Brother Stumbleskink's Emporium]
[Stumbleskink's, Emporium]
description: The walls glow with a luminous blue light, reflecting off the various religious symbols hanging from the walls. Brother Stumbleskink bustles about, polishing, dusting and generally fussing over his wares.  Despite his busybody attitude, the shop is very peaceful, and you are loathe to speak above a whisper for fear of disturbing the calm.

Frosted glass lanterns along the ceiling glow with a pale blue light, reflecting off of various religious symbols hanging from the walls.  Brother Stumbleskink bustles about, polishing, dusting and generally fussing over his wares.  Despite his busybody attitude, the shop is very peaceful, and you are loathe to speak above a whisper for fear of disturbing the calm.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: A thin spire of pure ice ascends toward the heavens, its narrow spiked peak glittering with reflected sunlight.  Two tall modwir trees flank the enormous structure, their needle-covered branches dusted with a heavy coating of snow.  Small grey rocks peek out from the layer of white upon the ground, marking two paths that lead to the large tower and off to a smaller building situated near the southeastern wall.

A thin spire of pure ice ascends toward the heavens, its narrow spiked peak glittering with pale moonlight.  Two tall modwir trees flank the enormous structure, their needle-covered branches dusted with a heavy coating of snow.  Small grey rocks peek out from the layer of white upon the ground, marking two paths that lead to the large tower and off to a smaller building situated near the southeastern wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Icemule Trace]
description: The icy walls sparkle in the sunlight, glimmering with silvers and golds.  The light caresses the two ice statues standing, backs turned but looking over their shoulders, in the center of the room.  Both are female, but one is something less than humanoid in its form.  They stand on a base of ice, words carved into the surface.  The air is crisp and cold, smelling of melting glaciers and gently falling snow.

The icy walls sparkle in the moonlight, glimmering with silvers and blues.  The light caresses the two ice statues standing, backs turned but looking over their shoulders, in the center of the room.  Both are female, but one is something less than humanoid in its form.  They stand on a base of ice, words carved into the surface.  The air is crisp and cold, smelling of melting glaciers and gently falling snow.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest, up, out

title: [Icemule Temple, Basement]
description: This long hallway carved deep under the glacier is unadorned save for the two round doors at the far end.  Due to some acoustical anomaly the corridor echoes with the sound of footsteps from above, providing the temple staff with notice that the building is in use.

title: [Luminaries and Aromatics]
description: Silken standards, bearing various denominational insignias and mounted directly into the wood floorboards, line one side of this room.  In front of the standards is a two-tiered glass table with a large candle-centered floral arrangement.  Scattered rugs, hooked from vibrant silk yarn, appear like colorful shadows under the weight of the cabinets that hold them to the floor.

title: [Incantation and Enchantment]
description: At the northwest corner of Icemule Trace stands a sturdy square tower, its impressive height casting the meeting point of Incantation and Enchantment alleys into cold, damp shadow.  A few militia guardsmen slip in and among the spellcasters who move between the run-down alleys at all hours of the day.

At the northwest corner of Icemule Trace stands a sturdy square tower, its impressive height blocking the light from all but the stars directly overhead.  The halfling militia patrols in pairs, their spears and tridents held ready to meet any threat that might approach under cover of darkness.

title: [Northwest Tower, Entrance]
description: The base of this square tower is patrolled by a halfling militia guard.  The stone floors are empty but for a few wooden chairs and a wooden trash barrel, and the woolen wall hangings provide more quiet and warmth than cheer.  A narrow staircase bends along the walls as it rises into the heights above.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
[Magical Burrow, Tunnelway]
description: An acrid scent, not entirely natural, travels through the air in a biting undercurrent.  Tangled roots hang from the walls, while a few larger ones stretch across the ground, making the terrain difficult but not impassable.  Fog mostly conceals the obstacles, but here and there, a gnarled tangle breaches through the mist.  To the south, an opening in the roots offers access to a shop occupying a well-lit burrow.
Tangled roots hang from the walls while a few larger ones lie on the ground, making walking difficult.  To the south, you can see an opening in the roots that looks like some sort of burrow.

title: [Sorena's Emporium]
[Sorena's Emporium, Showroom]
[Sorena's Alchemy, Showroom]
description: Lamps are slung from some of the thickest roots.  Shelves have been hollowed out of the walls and are filled with dark glass jars and clay pots.  A slab of granite in the center of the room serves as the worktable.  It is covered with vials, tubes, candles and various tools of alchemy.  Fluids, in all colors of the spectrum, bubble and hiss in their glass containers.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Between a pair of barbican towers, a constant stream of halfling farmers from the Olbin Strath and richly dressed human traders from Briarmoon Cove flows through the West Gate, with the occasional krolvin crew scattered among them.  Town guards inspect cargo, sharply dressed in dark blue and brown leathers emblazoned with the rampant mule that is the town's sigil.  Outside of the gates, the land is spotted with scraggly grasses and snows, and there is little tree cover.
The cobblestone road ends at the large western gate here.  Through the gate you see vast plains of grass about as tall as a halfling, with very few trees for cover.

title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
description: A few scattered alum pebbles lie in a heap in the corner, their unusual roundness and shine hinting at their use to pass the guards' slow nights away.  Shallow steps whose surfaces are marred by many muddy bootprints ascend toward the top of the tower, the entrance guarded by an iron-barred gate.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Between a pair of barbican towers, a constant stream of halfling farmers from the Olbin Strath and richly dressed human traders from Briarmoon Cove flows through the West Gate, with the occasional krolvin crew scattered among them.  Town guards inspect cargo, sharply dressed in dark blue and brown leathers emblazoned with the rampant mule that is the town's sigil.  Outside of the gates, the land is spotted with scraggly grasses and snows, and there is little tree cover.
The cobblestone road ends at the large western gate here.  Through the gate you see vast plains of grass about as tall as a halfling, with very few trees for cover.

title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
description: A simple wicker wreath hangs above the entryway, the thin twigs making up its body tied tightly with bits of twine and leather.  A pale white staircase slowly ascends in a spiraling fashion toward the top of the tower, the stone chipped and marred by stains in some places.  An iron-barred gate stands before the steps, ensuring a secure point to check those who would venture further.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: A flow of adventurers, merchants, trappers, and lumberjacks congeals into a noisy throng near the South Gate of Icemule Trace.  Adding to the clack of wagon wheels and the din of the crowd, sounds of laughter and clanking mugs beckon from the inns and taverns that occupy the Tavern Burrow, just to the west.   The road lies in the shadow of the town's high walls and barbican towers, the foundations of which are of darker stone than the top.

Several groups of adventurers jostle past you on their way through the South Gate.  The sounds of laughter from the west remind you of the inns and taverns back home.  You notice that the lowest part of the wall is darker stone than the top, a sign that this fortification was raised at some point in the past.

title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
description: A small cross-hatched window looks out to the wilds beyond the gate, and a few torn, bloodied bandages hang along a series of nails hammered into its lower edge -- simple tokens testifying to the bravery of the local guard.  A long, winding staircase edges the round walls of the barbican tower, the shallow steps defended by an iron-barred gate.

title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
description: Small piles of pale white snow collect in the corners of the tower's doorway, the pale grey stone glistening with faint moisture.  A spiral of stairs slowly ascends the height of the barbican, and distant shafts of light pierce the gloom further upwards.  An iron-barred gate guards the base of the winding stairway, the metal bars encased in a thin shell of glistening ice.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Trader Way]
[Commerce Burrow, Trader's Way]
description: A brisk wind blows down the street, shivering the branches of evergreens along the roadside.  The road comes to a sharp corner in front of a marvelous two-story bakery.  Countless small windows with white shutters peek out of the brick facade of the shop, and a polished silver plaque is affixed next to the door.  Woodsmoke billows gently from the stone chimney, though its bite is sweetened by the aroma of baked goods.

Trader's Way comes to a sharp corner here, in front of a marvelously grand bakery.  Painted bright pink, the front of the shop is decorated with numerous tiny windows outlined with white shutters.  A polished silver plaque hangs next to the door.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin ironwood plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of ironwood that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point despite the icicles growing here and there.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Gate]
description: Pack mules bray from wide hitching posts to either side of the East Gate, laden with luggage and gear from travelers fixing to brave the snowy wilderness.  Crowds pass through the barbican beyond, a peculiar mix of returning adventurers, weary merchants, and serene monks and sisters from the abbey to the east.  A group of halfling children plays a game by the barbican towers, daring one another to run out into the wilds beyond.

Pack mules bray from wide hitching posts to either side of the East Gate, laden with luggage and gear from travelers fixing to brave the snowy wilderness.  Crowds pass through the barbican beyond, a peculiar mix of returning adventurers, weary merchants, and serene monks and sisters from the abbey to the east.  Several town guards stand watch in the darkness near the barbican towers, their eyes trained on the wilds beyond.

A layer of dust swirls around the ground, stirred up by the trampling feet of the crowds passing in and out of a tall gate.  A group of halfling children play a game by the gate, daring each other to run out into the wilds beyond.

title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
description: A single steel shield hangs over the entryway, its edges trimmed with stained leather and its surface heavily scarred.  A winding staircase slowly ascends the length of the tower, an iron-barred gate set at the threshold to ensure that those who enter are well-protected.  A few hardy patches of weed have grown in the cracks along the floor, enjoying shelter from the cold outside in this safe haven.

title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
description: The tower's interior is protected from both the elements and attack by a massive ironwood door further reinforced with dark steel.  A long, winding stairway spirals up the edge of the circular walls, ascending towards the very top of the barbican.  An iron-barred gate stands before the very first step, its bars glistening with a faint coat of ice.  A few simple glass vases rest at the foot of the gates, each filled to the brim with a collection of dried flower petals.

title: [Barter and Trade]
description: The packing crate pavement of Barter and Trade Alleys widen into a broad if unimpressive plaza in front of the sturdy tower in the southeast corner of Icemule Trace.  A few halfling militia guards patrol the square at all hours, but most of the people in view have more important matters in mind:  doing business with one of the many small merchants whose shops stand in the shadow of the tower.

title: [Southeast Tower, Entrance]
description: Two hinged doors do little to keep the winds from swirling around this square keep, and the halfling militia guard that patrols the stairs shivers in the cold.  More spartan than drab, this room boasts little in the way of furniture: a small wooden trash barrel near the door, a few odd chairs, and some woolen tapestries on the walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: The air is still, heavy with the closeness of the spruce and fir trees.  The movement of a bird or squirrel high above in the trees sends a cascade of snow from the upper branches down onto the path.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rime Hall]
description: The heat radiating from a firepit in the middle of the vast hall scarcely reaches the grey stone walls, leaving them cold.  Carved into the frosted surface is an ethereal forest of leaf-bare trees creating the image of perpetual winter in familiar deciduous groves.  Pools of pale wax mar the tiled floor where tiered candles set in cast iron chandeliers overhead have been left to drip.  Oaken benches circle the blazing fire with the added comfort of thick furs draped over their high backs.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: A drooping pine tree stands to one side of the trail, its long branches sweeping downward to brush against the ice-crusted ground.  High overhead, the snow-tipped spires of the towering trees dance in the wind.

title: [Icemule Trail, Pine Tree]
description: The tree shelters all who are within the embrace of its branches.  Although the wind batters hard against the intertwined limbs, it fails to find entry, making the confines of the shelter much warmer.  A pile of sweet-smelling pine needles offers a comfortable, resting place.

title: [Lake of Tears]
description: The warm water of the lake churns in the grip of strong currents.  Tossed by the confluence, water droplets spray into the air above the waves, creating shimmering rainbows in the low cavern light.  The bank of the lake beckons with its promise of solid ground, while below, the depths descend into shifting shadows.

title: [Heated Sands, Cavern of Ages]
description: After the bitter, numbing cold of outside, the luxuriousness of warm air is all encompassing.  Then the surroundings creep upon one's consciousness, like a panoramic view emerging as fog lifts.  Red stone walls arch in ridges overhead, reminiscent of an immense rib cage.  The cavern's higher regions are remote and dark, however, soft light radiates from a fine, ivory-colored carpet of sand that stretches from wall to wall.  Heat rises from the sand as well, lending a shimmering quality to the air.

title: [Altar of the Elder]
description: The ledge is more generous than it appeared from the lower stone platform, which now looks extremely narrow and far below.  The view from here of the monumental ice sculpture reveals its top to be as superbly detailed as its other aspects.   Incongruously, a pool of clear, sapphire-colored water lies between the ledge and an immense statue of a sleeping drake, its recumbent body curled around a large throne on the pool's northern edge.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: To the northwest, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  Above the course of steps, a dais is visible below a ridge.  Strange flickers of reflected light bounce off the icy walls above and around the dais, as if the low light were rebounding off water.  To the south, the huge, sculpted mountain of ice exudes a constant wave of brutal cold, as if it was exhaling the wilderness of rime encasing the ancient edifice.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: The ice coating the platform flows unbroken into the nave's huge iceberg, a seamless sweep of graceful spirals that eventually merge with a monumental figure towering above.  There, a dragon plummets from the sky, its wings trailing behind it like tattered streamers.  Icy shafts protrude from the drake's neck and body and rivulets of ice seep from the wounds.  The form hovers moments before impact, its features a study of agony and at the same time, resignation to the finality of its endless fall.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: To the northeast, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  This platform is totally encased in a frozen sheet that muffles sound and reflects light in a glistening shimmer.  Above the treacherous ascent, a ledge is visible - and towering above that, a monstrous, serpentine figure reclines, its head and tail forming a protective curve around the ice-sheathed dais.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [East Stair, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs curve up toward the west, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  The stone of the outside walls is heavily carved in bas-relief.  Overhead, the ceiling is a distant, shadowy pool of darkness, but the intricate detail of the carved walls can be glimpsed reaching past the point of sight in a rich landscape of embellishment.

title: [Domed Entry Hall, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs culminate in an entry hall, little more than a glorified landing replete with sculpted stone.  Stairwells curving down to the southeast and southwest converge at a double column surmounted by capitals carved in high relief.  Opposite the trumeau, two arches, crafted of alternating dark and reddish-toned granite blocks, open to the northeast and northwest.  Over every surface, the relentless sheath of ice gives a reflective coating that is as lovely as it is precarious.

title: [West Stair, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs curve up toward the east, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  Along the outside wall, friezes follow the ascent, providing a rich panorama of dense detail that adds to the menace of the ice, adding the temptation of studying the carved stone instead of the ice-covered steps.

title: [Domed Entry Hall, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs culminate in an entry hall, little more than a glorified landing replete with sculpted stone.  Stairwells curving down to the southeast and southwest converge at a double column surmounted by capitals carved in high relief.  Opposite the trumeau, two arches, crafted of alternating dark and reddish-toned granite blocks, open to the northeast and northwest.  Over every surface, the relentless sheath of ice gives a reflective coating that is as lovely as it is precarious.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Clouds merge with blowing snow and an uncertain horizon.  Courageous patches of light randomly filter through the wind, sparkling off the frozen path and then fraying back into the haze as if devoured.  The way curves to the northwest around a wall of stone, encrusted with ice that almost obscures its carved surface.  To the northeast, a trail, little more than packed ice, snakes across a narrow ledge which is almost obscured by a dense shower of blowing snow.

Clouds merge with blowing snow and an uncertain horizon.  Courageous patches of moonlight randomly filter through the wind, sparkling off the frozen path and then fraying back into the haze as if devoured.  The way curves to the northwest around a wall of stone, encrusted with ice that almost obscures its carved surface.  To the northeast, a trail, little more than packed ice, snakes across a narrow ledge which is almost obscured by a dense shower of blowing snow.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The trail ends in a redoubt created by immense formations of ice.  Snow rains down in sheets, like a frozen waterfall cascading down from above in slow motion.  What remains of the trail meanders down to the northeast, fraught with dangerous patches of ice and irregular outcrops of stone, which wait for an unwary footfall to offer up disaster.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The biting wind howls incessantly over a sharp precipice, whipping jagged pieces of ice around brutally. Deep indentations have been etched into the surface ice covering the precipice from the ferocity of the wind.  High overhead, several large icicles look dangerously close to falling from a small outcropping.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: The hall ends at the foot of an oak door, but branches to the left and right diagonals.  A second door to the right stands opposite a fine painting, depicting a strange, craggy mountain of seemingly pure ice.  The mount is surrounded by low, thick clouds, giving it a moody, introspective quality.

title: [Pinefar, Double Ready Room]
description: Oak bookshelves cover two of the walls, filled with a variety of leather-bound tomes.  A pair of armchairs covered in saddle-tan leather sits before a generous window, taking advantage of the ambient light.  Antelope hides cloak the polished plank floor and a small fireplace claims the remaining wall.

title: [Northern Slopes, Bluff]
description: As the altitude rises, the air grows more crisp and biting, full of the rich aroma manufactured by the pines.  The bluff is a narrow ridge of stone, banded on the north by thick stands of trees, and open to the wind on the south, where the trail disappears down into the jumble of boulders creating a steep incline.

title: [Northern Slopes, Clearing]
description: The pines open into a clearing produced by a large outcrop of boulders in its center.  A number of rhododendron bushes grow in a clump against the rock, their oval leaves curled into thin fingers with the cold.  The trail disappears at the foot of an incline, where more of the granite breaks through the loam and displays a face banded with minerals.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: Bracketed by pines at either side, a sheer rock slope rises over the snowscape.  The slope is formed of a dark gray rock that is stained a rusty red in spots, and is encased entirely in ice.  Near its base, a dark cave opens into the mountain, its mouth a shadowy maw that stands in stark contrast to the snowy hillside around it.

title: [Ice Cave]
description: This small cave is filled with shadows, the only illumination provided by a dim ray of light that peeks through an opening in the southern wall.  In the cave's center is a fire pit, its rim ringed with a number of scorched rocks.  Overhead, a multitude of designs cover the walls and ceiling, incised upon the rock with rich earth tones.  Noticeable by its lack of ornamentation is a small silhouette on the east wall, the crevice about the size of a halfling.  Dense shadows cloak the back of the cave.

title: [Southern Slopes, Narrow Shelf]
description: Above, the granite canopy has broken, leaving a narrow vertical crevice in the pinkish rock.  Through it, the sharp pinnacle of the eastern peak can be seen set against the sky.  Large boulders crouch beneath the crevice.  Over the cliff to the south, a frozen lake sits far below.

title: [Foothills, Frozen Lake]
description: The trail ends at the shore of a frozen lake that sits in a low basin here.  Waterfowl slip and slide across the opaque ice, like children at play.  The northern shore of the lake is formed by the sheer cliff stretching upwards towards a craggy mountain peak.  The other shorelines are comparatively flat, and heavily wooded.  Perched high upon the boughs of an edge-water pine is a thatched stick birds nest.

The trail ends at the shore of a frozen lake that sits in a low basin here.  The northern shore of the lake is formed by the sheer cliff stretching upwards towards a craggy mountain peak.  The other shorelines are comparatively flat, and heavily wooded.  Perched high upon the boughs of an edge-water pine is a thatched stick birds nest.

title: [Foothills, Snowy Trail]
description: The curving hillside is covered with pine and maple, their snow burdened branches creaking in the fierce winds.  The only break in the forest is along the barren face of a sheer rock slope just to the north.  At its base, a deep mound of snow buries all but the roots of a few splintered trees.  Eastwards, a snowy trail winds its way across the foothills.

title: [Northward Trail, Ice Floe]
description: Carved over centuries by the floe of ice at its bottom, this narrow gorge provides some relief from the elements.  The air is still bitterly cold, but at least the harsh winter winds are kept at bay by the lichen-covered walls that lie to the north and the south.  The carcass of a mule lies nearby, preserved from decay by the freezing temperatures.

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: Marking the northern boundary of the valley, a narrow gorge slices through the plain.  A row of trees lines its edge, visible only as vertical streaks smudged across a dull, gray canvas.  The land begins to rise and fall past the gorge, forming low hills that strain upwards as if trying to match the magnificence of the mountains they sit beneath.  The wind whistles hauntingly.

title: [Northward Trail, Ice Floe]
description: Carved over centuries by the floe of ice at its bottom, this narrow gorge provides some relief from the elements.  The air is still bitterly cold, but at least the harsh winter winds are kept at bay by the lichen-covered walls that lie to the north and the south.  The carcass of a mule lies nearby, preserved from decay by the freezing temperatures.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Passage to the east is blocked by an enormous landslide.  Rocks and ice long ago melded together to form a slick, seemingly unclimbable barrier.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: An enormous landslide chokes the pathway, yet it is not as impenetrable as it first appeared.  Beneath the rubble, traces of a wider, stone pathway emerge and continue upwards and around the base of a broad mountain.

title: [Snow Fort, Ice Altar]
description: An elaborate chapel is hollowed out of the ice here, calling praise to an unknown deity.  Towering pure white pillars stand sentinel over a massive altar of snow and ice.  Strange, ensconced torches illuminate the altar, glowing with a cold blue fire.

title: [Arctic Tundra, Under Altar]
description: Several lanterns light the corners of this tiny room.  Warm fur throws cover the floor, providing a sense of comfort.  Nestled in one corner is a tiny trapdoor.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield, Trench]
description: The wind howls with menace above, but finds itself unable to gain entrance to the deep battlement.  The stone-reinforced walls are covered with slick ice, and what might have granted sanctuary long ago seems nothing more than an icy prison now.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Deep pits fortified with large stones and boulders still remain as quiet momentos of the war that ravaged this plain.  Dented greaves and smashed helms lie crushed between two huge boulders, implying the violence of previous battles.  Wind screeches through the gaps in the low rock walls, bringing a terrifying, ominous song to the area.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Side]
description: The ledge tapers off and once again becomes part of the hill leaving no way for you to continue around the east side of the hill.  A smooth ramp continues upward to another ledge that looks to head back in the direction you came from.  The ramp has two iron railings along each side and is completely covered with ice, making it difficult to climb.  Just underneath the ramp is the entrance to a tunnel heading north.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: This room branches off into several different directions but appears to be the central location to this tunnel.  A large table dominates the room, with many stools arranged along the outside for the inhabitants to sit while they dine.  A large firepit ringed with stones is off to one side of the room.  It looks as if the area has seen a lot of use recently, and the odor of burnt flesh lingers in the air.

title: [Temple Burrow, Icy Pool]
description: Penguins churn the frigid pool.  They swim through the limpid waters, diving and splashing with a comedic flair that provokes uproarious laughter from onlookers on the banks.  The water is freezing cold, but the birds do not seem to mind in the slightest.  To the side, an icy ledge offers a way out of the gelid drink.

The water is alive with penguins.  They swim all about the pool, diving and splashing so comically that you cannot help but laugh.  The water is freezing cold, making your teeth chatter and turning your lips blue, but the birds don't seem to mind in the slightest.  To the side you spy an icy ledge that you believe you could climb to get out of the drink.

title: [Temple Burrow, Penguin Hill]
description: Cold and crystal clear, a small lake has formed at the peak of the hill, providing a popular spot for local wildlife to congregate.  A huge colony of penguins flourishes on the shores of the lake.  They waddle comically around the edge, preen themselves and one another, and dive after little silvery fish darting through the frigid waters.  A smooth runnel in the bank makes an ideal slide for the creatures and, it appears, some of the younger townsfolk.

A small lake has formed here, making this a popular spot for the local wildlife.  A huge grouping of penguins lives on the shore of the lake, waddling comically around the edge, preening or catching the cold water fish.  A smooth area on the bank makes an ideal slide for the creatures and, looking more closely, it seems you could join in the fun.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Honeybeer Road]
description: At the busy intersection of Stout Street and Honeybeer Road, the smell of roasting meats drifts from the west on a cold breeze.  The whistling of a traveling merchant rises over the moaning of the wind as her mule-drawn cart clatters down the road.  Sounds of town guards drilling filter over the high wall of an armory to the north.

You find yourself at the busy intersection of Stout Street and Honeybeer Road.  The smells of roasting meats entice you to move west, yet there seems to be some activity to the north which might be worth investigating.  Pausing briefly, you whistle a quick tune and make your way down the road.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin ironwood plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of ironwood that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point despite the icicles growing here and there.

title: [Bootlegger's and Brewer's]
description: The intersection of Bootlegger's Alley and Brewer's Alley creates a large clear space in front of the defensive tower that occupies the southwestern corner of Icemule Trace.  The comings and goings of the militia can be seen as uniformed halflings weave their way in and among the cobbles.

The intersection of Bootlegger's Alley and Brewer's Alley creates a large, clear space in front of the defensive tower that occupies the southwestern corner of Icemule Trace.  A pair of flickering torches outside the tower illuminates the area and causes the shadows of the militia to flicker off the walls, as the guards weave their way in and among the cobbles.

title: [Southwest Tower, Entrance]
description: Warm woolen tapestries decorate the stone walls of this square tower, providing some measure of softness to what is otherwise a stark, military space.  A halfling militia guard paces in front of a narrow staircase that winds along the side and back walls before rising into the upper stories.  The double oak doors leading out to the intersection of two alleys swing loosely in the wind, providing very little in the way of protection against the chill.

title: [Icemule, Brewer's Alley]
description: Under the protection of the towering west wall, an odd assortment of ramshackle buildings appears in this back street.  Some artistic soul recently scraped the ice off the wall, revealing a multi-colored mural depicting a troupe of halflings performing for a crowd of onlookers.

Under the protection of the towering west wall, an odd assortment of ramshackle buildings appears in this shadowy back street.  Some artistic soul recently scraped the ice off the wall, revealing a multi-colored mural depicting a troupe of halflings performing for a crowd of onlookers.

title: [Bellaja's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a low wrought iron table on one side of the shop and a heavy wooden desk on the other.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Amaranth Court]
description: Towering high above, the stone facade of the city's bank presents a windowless face to the cobbled wey.  Twin ironwork doors are flanked by city guardsmen who impassively watch every patron that comes and goes from within the building's darkened interior.  A large mithril plaque is mounted to the stone walls beside the front doors.

Towering high above, the stone facade of the city's bank presents a windowless face to the cobbled wey.  Twin ironwork doors are flanked by city guardsmen who impassively watch every patron that comes and goes from within the building's darkened interior.  A large mithril plaque, illuminated by the golden amber flames of nearby torches, is mounted to the stone walls beside the front doors.

title: [Bank of Ta'Vaalor, Lobby]
description: Thick Loenthran carpets in shimmering hues of aubergine, olive and amber cover the smooth stone floors, adding warmth and luxury to the chamber.  A vaulted ceiling, painted with a scene of ancient battle, soars overhead.  Small beams of colored light refracting through the panes of stained glaes windows arc across the otherwise undecorated ivory limestone walls.

title: [Wisteria Lane and Rose Avenue]
description: Night has fallen on the alcove of Wisteria Lane, blanketing it in silvery moonlight.  Small campfires, surrounded by the gypsy folk, burn brightly in the darkness.  Songs can be heard coming from the folk gathered as they celebrate another fine day.  Circling the camp are numerous wagons and tents, set up by travelling merchants who have come to the Isle to sell their wares.

Two roads converge in a semi-circled corner, Wisteria Lane heading west back toward the gates, while Rose Avenue heads north toward Oleander Avenue.  In the cozy nook, tents from various travelling merchants have been set up.  Gypsies move about the camp, some tending to their own while others attempt to sell their various wares to any who pass.

Night has fallen on the alcove of Wisteria Lane, blanketing it in silvery moonlight.  Small campfires, surrounded by the gypsy folk, burn brightly in the darkness and ancient songs drift on the wind.  The circle of wagons and tents set up by various traveling merchants are brightly colored and a complete a contrast to the more orderly glass-walls of the atrium across the street.

Two roads converge in a semi-circled corner, Wisteria Lane heading west back toward the gates, while Rose Avenue heads north toward Oleander Avenue.  An ivy-twined atrium occupies the corner, while directly across the street is a nook filled with tents and wagons that various traveling merchants have set up.  Gypsies move about the camp, some tending to their own, while others attempt to sell their various wares to any whom pass.

title: [The Portable Water Hole]
description: Oilcloth and canvas panels are strapped to monstrously large sea thrak ribs to create a weather-friendly roof that is loose enough to allow breezes to enter, yet tight enough to protect against rain.  Several of the ribs are yellowed with age, while others display tiny fractures that are mended with wide strips of rawhide.  A narrow corridor runs the length of the wagon with barely enough room to travel between the four booths housing tidy tables, the narrow entryway, and the bustling kitchen.

A narrow corridor runs the length of the wagon with barely enough room to travel between the four compact booths, the narrow entryway, and the bustling kitchen.

title: [Gardenia Lane]
description: A pair of tall, beribboned stone columns flanks the entrance to the Four Winds National Bank.  The three-story building dwarfs the surrounding shops and remains the largest in the city proper.  Tiled in a rustic red shingle, the roof of the bank appears to be a cool silvery purple hue as the moonlight reflects off its surface.  A pair of armor-clad elven warriors guard the entrance, their gaze never wavering as they protect the city's treasure.

A pair of tall, beribboned stone columns flanks the entrance to the Mist Harbor National Bank.  The three-story building dwarfs the surrounding shops and remains the largest in the city proper.  Tiled in a rustic red shingle, the roof of the bank appears to be a cool silvery purple hue as the moonlight reflects off its surface.  A pair of armor-clad elven warriors guard the entrance, their gaze never wavering as they protect the city's treasure.

A pair of tall, beribboned stone columns flanks the entrance to the Four Winds National Bank.  The three-story building dwarfs the surrounding shops and remains the largest in the city proper.  Tiled in a rustic red shingle, the roof of the bank appears to be on fire, as sun glints off its surface.  A pair of armor-clad elven warriors guard the entrance, their gaze never wavering as they protect the city's treasure.

title: [Four Winds Bank, Lobby]
[Mist Harbor Bank, Lobby]
