description: Exotic potted palms line the walls, their fronds gracefully reaching out creating a canopy of leaves that tickle the ceiling.  Between the trunks of the palms, a hint of the rich mahogany wall peaks out.  Handwoven imported grass rugs cover the wood floors.  Patrons come and go irregularly, a small group occasionally stopping to mill about in quiet discussion before continuing on through an intricately carved maoral arch that leads farther into the bank.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Your eyes strain to adjust to the utter darkness of your surroundings.  Strange, scuffling noises from the corner of the room cause your nerves to prickle unpleasantly.  Moving cautiously, your hands outstretched before you, you discover a smooth, cold rock which feels as if it's been pulled from the wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Squatting precariously atop this immense pile of dirt, debris, and animal remains, you see a small, dark opening.  Soft, shuffling sounds travel through from above, making the tiny hairs at the back of your neck stand on end.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The dim flicker of torchlight casts shadows that flit across the uneven stone walls in a macabre dance that evokes images of death and demons.  A heavy, iron door hangs from rusted hinges.  A crude, iron ladder leads up to a sturdy-looking trapdoor.  The trapdoor has a strong-looking spring mechanism across its underside.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Deep brown wood panels this room, making it look even darker and smaller than it actually is.  A solid-looking trapdoor with heavy hinges is set into one corner of the floor, surrounded by tightly fitted grey stone.  A burned-out torch lies discarded in the corner near the trapdoor, which looks blackened and singed in places, but is still as solid as ever.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: Sheer stone walls rising hundreds of feet above your head blot out the sky, making any further upward movement impossible.  You turn to look out over the ledge, but your perch is precipitous and you quickly decide that the view from here is not worth the possible, and highly likely, fall.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: The peak levels off slightly here, and movement becomes easier.  Leading off to the northwest, the tracks of a large animal follow alongside a path of burrowed earth.

title: [Helden Hall, Inner Bailey]
description: As you step through the gate, you find yourself in a walled enclosure some one hundred yards square.  To the north is a massive hall with large oaken doors, and the sounds of livestock are coming from pens to the northeast.  There is a hut against the western wall of the Hall with tendrils of steam escaping from an opening in the roof.

title: [Helden Hall, Green Ash Tree]
description: As you get closer to the base of the large green ash tree, you grow amazed at the size.  The roots are spread out and they push through the circular area of earth surrounding it.  This area feels almost sacred - the leaves rustling in the breeze bring to mind the voices of the gods.  The shade and comfortable grasses are inviting, and you are tempted to sit and enjoy the peacefulness.

title: [Bailey Meadow]
description: At the western end of a small meadow stands the crumbling shell of a circular tower.  Large stones scattered about the tower's base, and the uneven line of the tower's top, are ample proof that it once stood much taller than it does now.  A gaping hole marks where the tower's doorway used to be.  The squareness of the small meadow tells you that a bailey once stood before the tower, but there is no other sign of it remaining.

title: [Tower Ruins]
description: A large V of sky fills a gap in the south wall, and fallen building stones lie about, cleared from the center of the tower's floor by those who have taken refuge here in the past.  Long grass covers the ground, although it has become trampled and matted around a stone-lined firepit.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: The trail ends here in a wide ledge, part of which is sheltered under a shallow overhang of snow-covered rock.  Back from the edge and obscured by the black and greys of ice and stone, a dark blotch marks the entrance to a wide-mouthed cave.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Round Cave]
description: This shallow cave provides slight protection from the shrieking wind that bolts up the mountainside outside.  It's enough for something, though, as the entire space is taken up with a motley collection of tree branches and animal hides.  Even in the cold air, an acrid stench rises from the nest.

title: [Wizard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Flanked by a small hill of verdant green grass, a massive spire of silver-sheened crystal rises up amid the tall rooftops of the city, its surface sparkling and pristine.  A white walkway leads up to the base of the tower, yet its flawless walls offer no obvious means of access.  A ring of identical silver monoliths encircle the tower, and a scarlet circle of runes is scribed into the soft earth at the end of the walkway.

title: [Wizard Guild, Entrance Hall]
description: Supported by thin, spiraled columns of pure ivory, the hallway stretches on to the north, the soft sounds of various banners hanging from between the gaps of the pristine pillars echoing about you.  A variety of arched doors lead away from the main hall, each of them securely bolted by both conventional methods and faintly pulsing runes of warding.  Dark velvet rugs are draped across the mirror-finished stone underfoot, creating narrow paths of florid scarlet to follow.

title: [Temple, Chapel]
description: Two pillars frame a simple chapel.  Followers of the land's many religions offer prayers here, each to their own gods.  On a pine pew a Zhaolmin monk in tattered robes sits beside a solitary elf softly intoning an ancient chant.  In front of the pews, you see an unadorned altar.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The altar is plain, and bears only onyx bowls of smouldering incense and smoking paraffin.  Draped behind it is a cloth banner, appliqued with an ancient mystical pattern.  A legend is embroidered along the bottom.  On the far side of the room at the end of an aisle, you see two pillars.

title: [Warehouse, Nexus]
description: The air is filled with shouts and bellowed orders as warehouse workers, wagons, and tradesmen barely avoid each other in their rush to get to their appointed locations at their appointed times.  A large wooden platform sits in the center of this whirling pool of chaos, a calm eye in the center of the howling storm of commerce.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Warehouse, Platform]
description: The solid oak platform sits in the middle of the warehouse floor, an island in the middle of a swirling sea of activity.  From here you have a wonderful view of all of the activity going on in the warehouse.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A steep path twists up the slope of the hill to the north and disappears as it plunges through a thick patch of berry bushes.  Clinging to the intimidating thorns of these bushes are a few strips of shiny metal and some decaying bits of now unrecognizable flesh.

title: [Cave, Entrance]
description: A large opening in the rock face of the north wall of this cliffside has been covered with a few scraps of roughly cured leather.  Apparently this leather was meant to serve as a crude door to the obvious cave behind it.

title: [Graveyard]
description: You pause inside the gates to survey the eerie scene.  A magnificently crafted granite crypt to the north inspires wonder and loathing.  The carvings on the facade are horrific, detailing the onslaughts of the Unlife throughout the chaotic history of Elanthia.  A gravel path wraps around the structure, while thorny brambles growing among the tombstones deter you from leaving the paved route.

title: [Graveyard, Crypt]
description: The entry foyer to this enormous granite crypt is stark, adorned only with grisly friezes sculpted in low relief into the walls.  Bands of bluish-green ahnver are inlaid into the stone in thin strips just below the ceiling throughout the entire structure, bathing the rooms in a subtle light.  A shadowy arch curves overhead and leads deeper into the inner sanctum of the sepulcher.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The smell of death and decay almost overcomes you and you gasp for air, but your lungs refuse it.  Although you have smelled death before, you have never experienced the revulsion you feel entering this area.  You wonder if you should advance any further as the nausea drains your strength.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: As the light of the room flickers something is different, the wall carvings have become very shallow.  They are so shallow that bodies have been turned on their side to save work in carving the holes.  In fact, most are held to the wall pockets by simple restraining straps, some of which have rotted, allowing the bodies to tumble from their resting place.

title: [Ruby Level, Emerald Access]
description: A sturdy ladder descends into the next level of the mine, the rungs thick and capable of holding even the stoutest giant.  A huge, but badly flawed, emerald is inset into the wall.  A disinterested dwarven sentry stands nearby.

title: [Blademistress, Entry]
description: Entering the hushed calm of this cavern, the mild scent of oiled leather wafts on the breeze.  A round oak table with delicate gold scrollwork covering the top is set in the center of the room, upon which rests a beige vellum placard.  Underfoot is a soft brown bearhide rug, while two distinctly female suits of armor stand sentry at the back corners.

title: [Ruby Level, Topaz Access]
description: Two stout dwarves are chatting with each other, not terribly interested in anything but their conversation.  They look up briefly as folks pass, but continue their heated debate.  A ladder leading down is visible just behind the pair.

title: [Irsalla's]
description: Several faded banners depicting images of mythical beasts and symbols hang limply from the uneven walls, evidencing the lack of air currents here.  Primly positioned in the center of the cavern, a humongous flat rock serves as a pedestal for a collection of uncut gems.  A small plaque engraved with silvery inscription has been affixed at dwarven eye-level.

title: [Ruby Level, Passage]
description: A heated argument can be heard coming from the room to the north, something about cheating.  A stout dwarven woman in a thick leather apron leans against one wall, staring in consternation at a broken hammer.

title: [Bone Crusher, Entry]
description: A golden glow from glass lanterns fills this small, natural cave.  Earth-toned wool rugs cover the dirt floor in order to keep dust to a minimum.  The shop is neat and tidy, with all the displayed wares having received a recent polishing to make them shine.  A curtained narrow passage can be seen to the rear of the cave.

title: [Topaz Level, Central Access]
description: A metal ladder bolted into the wall ascends to the upper levels of the mine.  The ladder looks sturdy enough to bear the weight of a giantman, but the rung separation is much better suited to a dwarf or halfling.  A pair of shafts leads out from this accessway.

title: [Shield Shed, Entry]
description: At first glance, the dim shop seems a bit dreary and dingy.  Rustic wooden beams support the ceiling, and the grey stone walls are drab.  No decorations alleviate the monotony.  Slowly adjusting to the low light, it can be seen that the shop is filled with magnificent shields of all sizes and types.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Topaz Level, Elbow]
description: Two columns centered in the shaft fortify the passage, but both are buckling badly under the weight.  A dust-covered sign is attached to one wall, the words barely readable.

title: [The Invar Dog, Entry]
description: Some time in the past, this narrow cavern was visited by an industrious dwarf who took his pickaxe to the wall, creating a wider space complete with a stone-hewn bar.  In a nook behind the bar, a dog, fashioned from invar and accompanied by a plaque, watches over the patrons.  Some visitors, especially dwarves, belly up to the bar for a drink, but many others drift to the east, searching for wares.

title: [Topaz Level, Elbow]
description: Solid stone on either wall has made it necessary to carve a steep bend to continue the shaft.  The stone is scarred with numerous attempts to widen the gap, but evidently without success.  A few twisted pieces of metal litter the ground, remnants of what must have been a pickaxe at one time.

title: [The Plaid Brat]
description: This small shop is brilliant with whitewash, liberally applied over carefully plastered walls.  Tea has been laid upon a plaid tablecloth covering a three-legged table.  The table provides an excellent vantage point for perusal of the polished clothes press adjacent to the arch or contemplation of the niche carved into the wall close to the exit.  An assortment of brats and cloaks on the rack in the shop's center also invites a second glance.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: The curving passageway is filled with crates and sacks, most filled with gear or supplies.  A bit of grain spills out from one of the large canvas bags, a small hole at the bottom likely caused by vermin of some sort.  A swarm of insects are taking advantage of the unlikely feast.

title: [Big Things, Foyer]
description: Stone walls smoothed over by both tools and time form a large cavern, however, little of the walls remain visible.  Polished teak plaques adorn the walls, covering most of the stone.  Each plaque has been decorated with at least one oversized weapon, some far to large in size to be of any practical use to anyone.  A bright green runner lines the floor leading off deeper into the cave.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: A wheelbarrow filled with ore separates two miners engaged in a heated debate.  Their faces are covered with soot, and their beards are so full of the dark silt that one good shake would create a dust storm.  The argument is in the dwarven tongue, but the word "elf" is repeated often, and not in a very pleasant tone.

title: [ArmorWorks - Breastplates]
description: The grey-hued limestone floor of the cave has been worn to an almost slippery smoothness and a dull reflection.  On the concave stone walls there is not much to be admired in the way of decorative efforts.  Instead, an odd pile of leather and metal pieces is somewhat reminiscent of a broken statuary.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: Water sporadically drips from the ceiling, although it never seems to fall to the same spot twice.  As a result of this constant leaking, the ground is muddy and soft.  Somebody has thoughtfully placed a few planks over the muck, but they are mostly underwater and of little use.

title: [Cloth of Life]
description: Durable oilcloth flaps are held around the opening of the makeshift tent, their ends tied in place with braided hemp.  Three large support posts are driven into the bare rock floor with large metal stakes to create evenly spaced peeks throughout, which help divide the area into three chambers.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: The rock face rising out of the snow at your feet is completely featureless.  A thick rope, crusted in ice and apparently secured above, turns slowly in the ever-present wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: After a final steep scramble, the trail widens out to a path that slopes to an end at a sheer drop off.  About twenty feet below, the snowy valley floor is cut in half by the black stripe of a cold, rushing stream.  Heavy pegs, pounded into the old ice, look like they have been there for generations.  From the pegs, a knotted rope disappears over the side of the cliff.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Ruby Point]
description: The top of this peak is little more than a snow-topped spike of red granite.   Footing is precarious, and the pummeling wind does not invite contemplation.  The trail drops away steeply from the peak on two sides.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Ruby Point]
description: A huge nest takes up the entire available level space in this cramped cave.  Inside it you see grisly reminders of what it would be like to be caught here by the inhabitants.  A faded red cap dangles forlornly from the broken end of one of the many tree branches woven into the nest.

title: [Cysaegir, Citadel Bailey]
description: Twin towers stand as sentinels to a vaulted archway leading out to the town common.  The adjoining, thick stone walls extend to encircle a grassy bailey, until they butt up against the stony face of the granite mountainside.  Protected within this small fortress are a rustic wooden hostelry and the grey granite facade of the bank.
Twin towers stand as sentinels to a vaulted archway leading out to the town common.  Across from the bank is a pale stone gate that gives entrance to a corral near the wooden hostelry.

title: [Cysaegir Bank]
description: Simple wooden teller windows fitted with glaes panes stand open to service the many Aelotoi men and women bustling about.  A domed skylight allows sunshine to stream in, glinting off the silver coins being transferred, withdrawn, and deposited.  Vivid butterflies have been painted flitting across the pale pink and blue-tinted stone walls.

title: [Cysaegir, Linsandrych Common]
description: Placed strategically under a leafy arbor for shade, a vine-carved bench hides in the darkness.  Interrupting the natural beauty of a grassy knoll sprinkled with a scattering of buttercups is a lattice-worked gazebo.  A slate-paved walkway that snakes through flowering bushes and trees leads toward the steps of the structure.  Gorgeous bell-shaped flowers in shades of blue and pink encircle the base of a pedestal upon which a magnificent gold statue of an elven man is perched.

title: [Gems of the Earth]
description: Shards of colored glass dangle from the ceiling, casting a myriad of jewel tones upon the platform as sunlight shines through them.  A simple wooden counter houses two rather large chests and serves as the only furniture on this level of the store.  Sturdy-looking steps rise to the second floor in a wide spiral around a massive tree trunk.

Shards of colored glass dangle from the ceiling, glimmering like jewels amid the freestanding torches.  A simple wooden counter houses two rather large chests and serves as the only furniture on this level of the store.  Sturdy-looking steps rise to the second floor in a wide spiral around a massive tree trunk.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Echoes bounce back and forth over the smooth stone walls of the cavern.  Cylindrical cones of calcite protrude from the ceiling in a haphazard manner.  Pointed spikes dot the surface of the stalactites, and every so often drops of water plummet to the ground, creating small puddles on the floor.  Irregular stone steps lead up to an oval-shaped hole in the wall.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Colorful dupioni silk tapestries showing various scenes of wizards at work and play conceal one of the shop's stone walls.  The room is illuminated by mullein torches that cast a flickering light along the walls.  Natural recesses in the stone serve as bookcases, housing huge, dusty leather-bound volumes.  A stalagmite draped with an irregular piece of water-stained damask stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
[Seethe Naedal, Grassy Plateau]
description: Several tall shrubs cast their shadows across the dark grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the greenery, splitting into a fork.  One way lies a trail of rough terrain, while the other way appears to be well traveled and better tended.  A pine tree towers over the path, its branches swaying occasionally in the breeze.

Several boulders are scattered across the emerald green grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the larger rocks while smaller stones rest on the path itself.  A pine tree towers over the path, its lower branches providing shelter against the elements.

Several boulders cast their moonlit shadows across the dark grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the larger rocks while dark stones create a hazard to progress along the path.  A pine tree towers over the path, its branches swaying in the night breeze.

Several tall shrubs cast their shadows across the dark grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the greenery, splitting into a fork.  One way lays rough terrain, while the other way appears tended.  A pine tree towers over the path, its branches swaying occasionally in the breeze.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Beneath the Pine]
description: The heavy boughs of the pine droop low as they fan out from the tree trunk, and the dense fur of the needles creates a raincoat for the sheltering pine.  Stray beams of sunlight filter through the needles.  A ring of stones surrounds a patch of blackened ground and a thick matting of fallen pine needles provides a comfortable bed for the weary traveller.

The heavy boughs of the pine droop low as they fan out from the tree trunk.  The dense fur of pine needles creates a raincoat for the sheltering pine.  Stray beams of moonlight filter through the needles.  A ring of stones surround some blackened ground while a thick matting of fallen pine needles provides a comfortable bed for the weary traveller.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: The rocks provide a small resting place in the form of a narrow ledge jutting out from the sheer cliff.  Far below, the city of Ta'Illistim spreads eastward, the valley below it a blur of verdant green.  A large crevasse opens into the cliff's face.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Entryway]
description: A sun-bleached skull lies partially buried at the jagged opening of the cavern entrance with what appears to be a baby cave worm slithering in and out of the empty eye sockets.  The rest of the skeletal remains are nowhere to be seen.  A circle of rocks encases charred pieces of wood and ashes, apparently the surviving traces of an old campfire.  Tattered and torn clothing hangs from two tree branches that have been buried deeply in the dirt.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine's Edge]
description: The level ground of the old riverbed suddenly disappears as the ground falls away to the east amid a jumble of boulders and fallen branches where a rushing waterfall must have once filled the still air with mist countless years ago.  A huge formation of piled rocks bounds the northern entrance to the ravine, and the more traversable ground of the forest rises in a shady hillside to the south.  High moors rise beyond the deep ravine, their geography shrouded in clouds of darkening mist.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Narrow Cave]
description: Massive walls of dark granite meet overhead to form a small passage, shielded from the wind and weather.  The walls are patterned with greenish lichen, and clumps of white-capped mushrooms grow in the sparse patches of soil and debris that have collected in the cool darkness of the cave.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: A natural cavern has been worn into the cliff face by the constant pounding of the surf.  Jagged rocks surround the entrance to the cavern, but the floor inside is sandy and dry.  The crashing waves can be heard just outside, but none of the waves manage to enter the cavern.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The cavern turns sharply here, the sounds of the ocean fading away to the south.  Echoes of dripping water grow steadily louder to the west.  The floor of the cavern dips low here, and a shallow pool of salt water gathers in the corner.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path turns sharply to the southwest and southeast here, looping around a small, marshy area to the south.  Stepping off the path to the south here means sinking to the ankle in mud.  A small spring could be the source of the wetland.

title: [Warrens]
description: The cramped tunnel begins to squeeze in on all sides and travel in this passage is reduced to an uncomfortable crawl.  While the earthy aroma of the area is not unpleasant, the thick and heavy air is making it quite difficult to breath.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from either direction, although it is difficult to tell just how far off they might be.

The cramped tunnel begins to squeeze in on all sides and travel in this passage is reduced to an uncomfortable crawl.  While the earthy aroma of the area is not unpleasant, the thick and heavy air is making it quite difficult to breathe.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from either direction, although it is difficult to tell just how far off they might be.

title: [Manor House, Kitchen]
description: As dirty and damp as this room is, with patches of yellow mold and cobwebs in the corners, the steel spit spanning the large fireplace and the butcher block counter make the original purpose of the room quite plain.  A rusted basin rests on a table between a boarded up window and a stairway set against the east wall that climbs to the second floor.  Beneath the stairway, stone steps descend to the manor's cellar.  A haon door stands just south of the fireplace in the kitchen's west wall.

title: [Manor House, Servants' Stairs]
description: Along the east wall a stairway descends to the ground floor of the house, while another stairway along the south wall leads up to the manor's attic.  Both sets of stairs look weak, and a few of the steps are actually missing.

title: [Warrens]
description: Large gnarled roots run along the walls and roof of this tunnelway, likely the only support for the soft earth forming this passage.  Dim light peeking through a jagged hole overhead is managing to provide a bit of illumination for this otherwise darkened lair.  Curious grunts echo from all about, the sound magnified by the claustrophobic terrain.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Rocks about the size of pumpkins litter the path here, which appears to have once been a stream bed.  The rocks, unseen beneath the fog, make walking painful and treacherous.  The swirling fog pours downward into a large hole in the ground.

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: A tunnel looms to the north, dark and foreboding.  The approach to the tunnel does not make it any less foreboding.  From the dust outlines in the floor, it seems that many of the pots and toadstools have been removed from this area.  The reason is unclear, but the section is quite dim, with the majority of the light located to the southeast.  Even under the low light conditions, it is apparent that stains the color of dried blood mar the floor just this side of the tunnel's entrance.
a.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Mraent Cavern, Entrance Tunnel]
description: A low, dark shaft leads down into the heart of the mountains.  A number of large stone blocks have been placed to discourage progress down the tunnel.

title: [Victory Road]
description: Small rocks and pebbles litter the ground and patches of white mushrooms grow haphazardly near a weathered stone turret.

Small rocks and pebbles litter the ground and patches of white mushrooms grow haphazardly alongside the gnarled roots of a twisted and bent tree growing near a weathered stone turret.  Etchings in the cobblestones have been worn thin over the years.  Off in the distance, a lone bird sings a sad melodic tune.

title: [Stone Turret, Ground Floor]
description: The cool, stony darkness of this circular room is pierced by a shaft of sunlight coming through the open doorway.  A thick carpet softens the footsteps of the well-heeled gentry who stop to chat with the staff seated at a long table before ascending a twisting stone staircase.

A dozen tiny lamps, flickering in the draft coming through the open doorway, light this stone-walled, circular room.  A thick carpet softens the footsteps of the well-heeled gentry who stop to chat with the staff seated at a long table before ascending a twisting stone staircase.

title: [Krag Slopes]
description: Poised on the very edge of a canyon wall, you look upon the brink of a seemingly bottomless pit, your feet threatening to slip out from beneath you and plunge you into the dark depths below.  The distance across the chasm is not too great, and you ponder the wisdom of trying to cross it.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rocky Pass]
description: Jagged outcrops of craggy rocks split the valley into twin canyons.  Small rocks skitter down the steep walls of the canyon and form small wisps of dust that look like rising steam.  Cold air flows steadily north out of both canyons as the night cools the rock faces to near freezing temperatures.  Very faint chattering sounds can be heard coming from large cracks in the rock outcrop to the south.

Jagged outcrops of craggy rocks split the valley into twin canyons.  Small rocks skitter down the steep walls of the canyon creating small wisps of dust that look like rising steam while the cool rock of the canyon floor creates a stream of cool air that flows steadily north out of both canyons.  Very faint chattering sounds can be heard coming from large cracks in the rock outcrop to the south.

title: [Krag Slopes]
description: The mountain trail wanders up the side of the slope becoming readily steeper.  Just off the side of the path, a darkened recess in the face of the slope draws your attention.

title: [Krag Slopes, Dark Cave]
description: The dim light that creeps in through the cave entrance casts eerie shadows that dance upon the mounds of bones scattered about the floor.  It is hard to imagine a beast who could pick the bones so clean.

The dim moonlight that creeps in through the cave entrance casts eerie shadows that dance upon the mounds of bones scattered about the floor.  It is hard to imagine a beast who could pick the bones so clean.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A dull stone fountain rests near the base of the chipped marble staircase that leads into the palace ruins.  Scattered cobblestones circle around the fountain and head away to the west, hinting at a long overgrown road.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Dilapidated metal fire pits flank the massive, broken doors that form the entryway into the building.  Grime-covered shards of blue, white, and yellow stone form a detailed mosaic of the sun rising over some mountain peaks on the ceiling above.  Smooth marble floors stretch down the halls to the east, marred and scratched violently at random intervals.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Two massive chairs rest on a small dais to the east, one splintered and shoved aside to reveal a large trapdoor behind the pair.  Large purple and gold banners hang from the ceiling and walls, moldy and torn.  A small balcony extends from the eastern wall, offering a view of the slopes of the Upper Krag.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: Thin shafts of light stream through tiny openings in the cave roof above, casting a dim light about the area.  Shattered pottery rests near the base of the cave wall, several shards stained with blood.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, Promontory]
description: A small stone promontory stretches outward slightly from the mountainside, overlooking the ground far below.  A gentle breeze swirls about playfully, carrying with it the strong scent of pine.  Stone benches travel around the walled edge of the circular platform, turned to face the handsome statue of a warrior-king.  A steep trail leads away from the simple sanctuary, down and across the cliffs of the plateau.

title: [Plateau's Edge, Steep Path]
description: Slick and frozen terrain prevents passage back up the cliff.  The path continues sharply down the edge of the plateau, ending abruptly several feet above the ground of the frozen slopes below.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Overlook]
description: This small clearing reveals a view overlooking the moonlit reflections from Lake Eonak far below.  A few steps away, a narrow set of stairs lead up toward an imposing grey tower.  A broad path is barely visible at the end of the clearing.

This small clearing reveals a spectacular view of Lake Eonak and Wehnimer's Landing far below.  A few steps away, a narrow set of stairs lead up toward an imposing grey tower.  A large mountain blocks the sunlight and casts darkness along a broad path pushing down into a grassy valley.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Tower]
description: Looming before you stands a tall grey tower shrouded in a misty fog.  A courtyard surrounds the tower and is protected by a massive portcullis.  A thin blanket of mist flows toward a narrow set of stairs leading down.

Looming before you stands a tall grey tower silhouetted by a dark mountain.  A courtyard surrounds the tower and is protected by a massive portcullis.  A few steps away lie a narrow set of stairs leading down.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Promontory]
description: You are standing on a rocky promontory, gazing up at the steep cliffs of a high peak to the west.  A high ridge leads away to the south, promising passage down into the foothills.  In the side of the cliff you can make out a small cave opening.  There is a faint odor of charcoal rising out of the opening.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: This small cave is dimly lit by the light shining in from the opening at the east end.  There is a gritty layer of some strange black dirt underfoot that leaves black smudges on anything it touches.  The walls and ceiling of the cave are also covered in the same black grit.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Marliese]
description: From this angle, the surface of the lake appears to be covered with diamonds.  Moonlight shimmers off the water all around you, providing a flickering counterpoint to the starry night sky.
From this angle, the surface of the lake appears to be covered with diamonds.  Light shimmers off the water all around you, almost blinding you to anything beyond this spot.
From this angle, the surface of the lake appears silver.  Moonlight casts slivers of silver along the crystal lake.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Marliese]
description: Here at the shallowest part of the lake, thick blades of grass just break the surface of the water.  A chorus of frogs croak out their welcome, their guttural night song echoing with an odd harmony across the valley.

Here at the shallowest part of the lake, bright green blades of grass just break the surface of the water.  A chorus of frogs croak out their welcome, their guttural song echoing with an odd harmony across the valley.

title: [Small Courtyard]
description: This small courtyard is enclosed by the curtain wall and tower on the west, and an ancient keep that stands to the northeast.  There is a battlement walk that appears to connect the two, its walls covered with a thick curtain of ivy that's so dark, it appears more black than green.  Curiously, the fog has not intruded here, although low clouds are hanging around the parapets of the keep.

title: [Anwyn Castle, West Tower]
description: The vaulted ceiling is low, and as a result, the room seems warmer than most of the other parts of the castle.  The chamber is in remarkably good condition -- the large fireplace still possesses its decorative carving and a few furnishings survive intact.  By far, the most noticeable thing in the room is the large mirror hanging above the hearth.  It seems to absorb and amplify the low light drifting in through the narrow slit windows.

title: [Crevice Floor]
description: The confined space here gives you a sense of claustrophobia.  The wind blowing across the top of the crevice creates a haunting melody throughout this area.  A dark hole lies in the southern wall, and it seems that you can just make out the sound of shuffling footsteps coming from it.  The crevice narrows to the east and a narrow path leads out of the crevice.

title: [Gnome Mine, Entrance]
description: This is the entrance to a series of natural caves.  As your eyes adjust to the change in light you see a path worn in the cave floor leading to the southeast.  It looks like the cave off to the southwest is seldom used by the cave occupants.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Village NE]
description: A well-traveled path winds up the side of the mountain, away from the main village.  A penetrating wind howls through the scraggly pines that cling dangerously among the rocks.  A rotten stench wafts out at you from the mouth of a small cave dug into the mountainside.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Dark Shrine]
description: A powerful stench overwhelms you as you step inside the cave.  Rotting animal carcasses lie scattered about the dirt floor, below a bloodstained crude stone altar.  Pelts of various sizes and shapes cover walls marked with odd scratchings, and you shudder as your gaze falls on one that looks quite a bit like the remains of a halfling.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: The gorge ends in a sheer cliff face here, but looking at it you notice that the phenomenon is clearly not natural.  The cliff wall is blackened and fused together such that it forms a near glasslike face.  The path that follows along the gorge leads directly up the cliff as though it once continued onward, and the floor of the gorge only contains a mere trickle of water where a raging river once flowed.

title: [Gorge, Rock Ledge]
description: You stand in awe on a large rock shelf which protrudes out over the canyon as if by magic.  Gazing northeast, you turn your attention to the sheer cliff that blocks further passage in that direction.  You can find no way to scale the wall from this side.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: You are standing in the southwest corner of a large square yard, which forms the center of the castle.  The high inner curtain walls give the place a sense of being isolated from the rest of the world, making you feel both secure and claustrophobic at the same time.  The southwest tower, with its jagged and broken top, rises high above you from here, and a portcullis of pure mein guards the exit back to the outer keep.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: Large cracks in the walls here make you question the structural integrity of this tower.  Broken bits of stone and a fine rocky dust cover most everything in this room, what little there is.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: This is the northwest corner of the central square of the castle.  The tower at this corner of the keep is virtually undamaged and even shows signs of recent renovation, unlike the others which are in various states of delapidation.  Against the northern curtain wall is a large building that also looks recently renovated.  Closer inspection indicates that the northern building is the castle's great hall.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: This room is in surprisingly good condition.  The walls are solid and unbroken and there are even some furnishings in good repair to be seen.  Perhaps a guardroom or entry hall, it now seems to do duty as both a bedchamber and library.  A rough but servicable bed sits in one corner and a massively solid blackened oak table sits in the center of the room with some ancient leather-bound books upon it.  A woven tapestry hangs on the far wall, heavy and black as primordial sin.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: This is the northeastern corner of the central courtyard of the inner keep.  The great hall runs along the northern wall here, and the northeast tower rises high above you.  The castle's well is conveniently located here, well defended and close to the great hall.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: You are standing on a small stone ledge which once supported the great beams which held up the wooden floor of this room.  All of the flammable parts of this tower have been destroyed, however, leaving the walls stained with black streaks of soot and smoke and the tower a gutted hulk, open from the dirt floor well below you to the circular opening which was once the roof high above.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Climbing under the wall and up into this room, you find yourself on top of a pile of rubble, up near the ceiling.  There's a trapdoor set in the center of the ceiling within your reach.  This is a good thing, because you can make out the remnants of a ladder, smashed to splinters beneath the collapsed wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This room is empty except for a trap door set in the middle of the floor. The wood is solid, and there's no ring or latch visible.  Even the hinges are on the other side, with whatever else may be there.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A structure much like a well stands in the center of the room.  Looking like a stone box, with sides about three feet high, the shaft descends into blackness.  A passage leads off to the north, and another slopes upward to the west.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The damp chill in the air, the dark, echoing stillness, and the occasional scratching, rodent noises make you long for warmth, fresh air, and light.  An iron door hangs loosely from corroded hinges; now and then, it seems to move, though it is only a trick of the torchlight.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Several benches and a table are piled against the wall in this smallish room.  Chunks of grey stone are stacked in front of them, and smaller pieces of rubble are piled around a pitch-black hole gaping in the center of the floor.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This small space is dark and cramped.  Feeling your way around, you find something that feels rather like an arm, and it seems to have been here for a while.  There's a largish crack to the north, and rubble all around.  The ceiling is black with shadows, but you get the impression of space above.

title: [Graveyard, Natural Dam]
description: A pile of uprooted trees lying across the creek creates this natural dam that holds back the scummy green waters.  The waters contain the slimy remains of putrifying vegetation and carcasses.  A dragonfly skims the surface, causing concentric ripples to radiate out from its landing spot.  Looking down, you see the dry remnants of the creek bed.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The small lake overflows the creek bank and laps against your feet.  Low, shrubby spinewood trees grow right up to the edge and some protrude from the surface of the water.  The only firm footing to be found is over the felled logs that hold back the course of the creek, blocking its northward flow.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The creek widens into a small lake.  Dragonflies dart about, filling the air with color, while other, less pleasant insects buzz about the cattails lining the bank.  Something brushes against your leg, causing you to start, and you desperately hope it's a fish.  The bank seems stable enough for you to climb to dry land.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: Just downstream, the creek empties into a small lake.  Cattails grow at the edge of the water, waving in a slight breeze, and jewel-hued dragonflies dart about the pool.  Although the banks are marshy, they look stable enough to support you, giving you safe access to the creek.

Just downstream, the creek empties into a small lake.  Cattails grow at the edge of the water, waving in a slight breeze, and you hear insects darting about the pool.  Although the banks are marshy, they look stable enough to support you, giving you safe access to the creek.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The creek overflows its banks slightly, making the banks sodden, but not impossible to climb.  Beneath your feet, bright green slime covers the bottom, easily seen in the shallow water.  From the east a slight hum reaches your ears, unpleasantly familiar.

The creek overflows its banks slightly, making the banks sodden, but not impossible to climb.  Beneath your feet, green slime covers the bottom, easily seen in the shallow water.  From the east a slight hum reaches your ears, unpleasantly familiar.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The ground here is quite sodden, making walking unpleasant, and your feet make squishing noises each time you take a step.  It is likely that your feet would get less wet walking in the creek, and strolling through the creek might be less messy than slogging through the mud.  A hum can be heard from the east, the sound sending a shiver down the back of your neck.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A black swarm of gnats hovers over the bank a few feet away.  Stray insects fill the air, buzzing too near your face for comfort.  The ground beneath your feet is slick, covered in slippery green slime, and the movement of the water makes standing precarious.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The air is filled with gnats.  They have swarmed in an immense cloud just off the creek, filling the air with an unpleasant hum.  You wave your hands about your head in an effort to keep stray insects off your face, but it seems to do very little good.  There is plenty of room around the gnats to continue to the west, and you could still make it into the creek around the black mass.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The creek is flowing rapidly here, digging away at the banks and making them soft and muddy, although sturdy enough to walk on.  A patch of water grass clings to the side, seeming to hold on with all its strength, and a few small fish nibble at the leaves.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The banks of the creek are softer here than to the east, although access to the creek is still possible.  To the west, the ground seems more damp, and a humming sound can be heard from that direction.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A few dead fish float here, trapped in the dangling branches of a berry bush on the bank.  The smell is noxious, and you briefly wonder what killed the fish only in this area of the creek.  The dirt and rocks beneath your feet are very slick, and you don't care to think about what you may be stepping on.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: Several bushes covered with berries cling to the bank of the creek.  The berries are plump and dark, and very tempting, but as you reach for some you notice the corpse of a small animal beneath the bush.  Several half-eaten berries sit near the body, and you wonder if eating anything from these bushes would be a good idea.  The bank seems solid enough for you to walk into the creek without difficulty.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A stand of cattails lines the bank, waving in the current.  Rustling sounds come from the plants, making you very uneasy, and your feet keep slipping on the slime clinging to the bottom of the creek.  Beyond the cattails you can see tall trees, very near the edge, and it looks like getting to the bank would not be a problem from here.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The woods end at a marshy creek.  Cattails line the gently sloping banks, moving with the flow of the water, although an occasional rustle and splash from the plants lead you to believe there may be something more than water there.  Given the gentle slope of the ground, it looks like you could enter the creek anywhere along the bank.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A long, thin shape weaves through the forest of cattails on the bank.  The plants continue off in both directions, leaning with the current, and although it is difficult to get to the bank, it is certainly not impossible.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: Strange thin tracks mark the soil here, giving you an idea of how the creek got its name.  The banks slope down into the creek, making accessing the water easy, although the vague shapes you catch moving through the cattails make you wonder if you want to.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A mass of mud and sticks can be seen through the thick plants growing along the bank.  On closer inspection the mass becomes the nest of a water bird, nestled in the grasses and cattails.  Four mottled eggs rest in the bowl, although looking at the placement, one egg may be missing.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The nest of a marsh bird is nestled in the water plants, and several mottled eggs rest in the bowl of sticks and mud.  A thin track leads to the nest, and a slightly fatter track leads away from the nest, each long and squiggled.  Apparently, a snake found the bird's eggs to be a much-desired delicacy, as the creek is easily accessible from the bank.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The soil beneath your feet is rockier here than to the southwest.  The slime clinging to the rocks and the creek bank complicates walking, causing the occasional slip and curse.  Above the babble of the water and your own clumsy splashing you can hear the whisper of wind through trees, speaking in a language you do not understand.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: A breeze moves through the area, rippling the surface of the creek.  You can hear it whisper through the forest in the distance, and it seems the trees may be trying to tell you something, if only you could understand what.  The bank slopes easily into the creek, providing you with an easy way to the water.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The water tumbles over dirt-coated stone.  Your way to the northeast is blocked by a large shale slab, too big to step over and not stable enough to climb, although the bank is easy enough to reach from here.  The creek flows out from beneath the slab, talking happily to itself as it wanders to the southwest.

title: [Slither Creek, Stone Bank]
description: The soft soil turns rocky here.  Further travel to the northeast is impossible over the uncertain ground, but it seems the creek can still be reached safely enough.  The soft hissing of scales against stone makes you uneasy, and you glance at the ground, attempting to locate the source of the sound.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: Your eyes adjust to the semi-darkness as a pale shaft of light filters through the tiny natural chimney in the domed roof of the curved chamber.  You see no signs of life yet low, unearthly murmurings, vague rustlings and flickers of faint lights swirl about you.  The only reality you are sure of is the dull thud of your footsteps on the earthern floor, echoing off the packed dirt walls.

title: [Graveyard, Top of Mound]
description: From the lofty perch atop the burial mound, you look out over the lowlands and marshes to the south and west and the desolate plateau to the north.  Facing southeast are the ominous graveyard, unquiet crypt, and the gates and cemetary walls beyond.  The ridge is narrow and uneven, with little room to maneuver.  Startled by the cawing of a nesting gorcrow, you realize that any distraction from keeping your balance would be courting to disaster.

title: [Dark Crevice]
description: Darkness prevents a clear survey of this small niche, but you feel a space above your head.  The floor begins a steep incline rising up into the rock and a narrow fissure, possibly wide enough to squeeze through, is barely visible along the wall.  You feel a cool dampness around your ankles.

title: [Underground Chamber]
description: This underground chamber seems to be naturally formed, perhaps from some tectonic movement or similar seismic activity.  The tunnel leading away however is obviously recently dug and, it appears, somewhat hastily done.  The layout of this place is rounded, with a concave floor in the middle.

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: Steep rocky walls rise high above, squelching any thoughts of climbing out.  A cold biting wind blows across your face, stinging your eyes and lips.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Drab grey clouds twist overhead in muted anguish, casting writhing shadows over this secluded pasture.  The pasture spreads out dully to the southeast, broken only by the occasional misshapen tree or rotted trunk.  An ancient trail, overgrown from countless years of disuse, weaves its way from the rising valley walls into the desolation.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues here with little noticeable change.  Streaks of yellow and orange deposits smear the walls in places where the aquiferous stone has been cut through.  Droplets from that stone layer trickle down the walls to join the small flow in the center of the room.  Most of the crypts in this section have been picked clean by grave robbers long ago.

title: [Catacombs, Inside Crypt]
description: You curse instinctively as you hit your head on the low ceiling of the crypt chamber, and revile your ancestors under your breath for having been so short.  There is barely enough room to crawl through here, so you quickly glance from side to side to discover anything of interest.  Among the crushed bones and the rubble, you spy a very narrow chute.

title: [Shanty Town, Inside Hut]
description: You are inside a one-room hovel.  A worn quilt patched together from hundreds of tiny scraps of fabric is folded neatly in the corner.  A fat candle, melted down to a waxy stub, rests atop a warped crate in the center of the room.

title: [Catacombs, Inside Crypt]
description: You curse instinctively as you hit your head on the low ceiling of the crypt chamber, and revile your ancestors under your breath for having been so short.  There is barely enough room to crawl through here, so you quickly glance from side to side to discover anything of interest.  Among the crushed bones and the rubble, you spy a very narrow chute.

title: [Beach Area, Tide Pools]
description: Here, at the bottom of the rocky slope, you stand along the edge of the pool itself.  The far end opens out to the sea and unknown depths.  The only way out is back up the slope behind you, as even with power to walk on water, the pounding surf a few yards out would make short work of any such attempt.  As you lean against a worn boulder to rest a moment, you notice an odd smell all around the area.  Further examining of the rocks shows a large smudge of some black viscous goo that stains your fingers.

title: [A Tidal Cave]
description: Years of tidal erosion have carved out a rough cave large enough for unrestricted movement.  Cool seawater laps around your ankles and the light filtering in from the cave mouth reflects off the resulting wavelets in a hypnotic display.  The tunnel extends southward, deep within the cliff, but peering in that direction you notice that the light does not diminish into blackness.  Far into the cave, you can barely make out a faint emerald glow illuminating the rough walls.

title: [Sea Cave, Waterfall Room]
description: Standing on a small ledge, you pause for a moment to take in the sight of a subterranean waterfall, tumbling and frothing in the furthest corner of the cave.  There is a large fissure between the boulders that line one of the walls.  Somewhere upstream, a hot spring has merged into the flow, and the water is surprisingly warm.  The room is comfortable, and a pleasant change from the dankness of the outer cave.

title: [Sea Cave, Behind Waterfall]
description: The rush of the waterfall cascading down into the black depths creates an oddly refreshing breeze, making you feel invigorated and somehow less weary.  The rock walls of this hidden room are pitted with holes and niches of different sizes, and the wall of water shimmers and dances before your eyes.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: Whitened bones are scattered carelessly to the side of an open pit.  Several broken boards lie scattered in and around the pit.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: You are standing in what is obviously a plundered grave.  Given the tools lying about in the muck, it would appear that the grave robbers were frightened off.

title: [Underground, A Deep Pit]
description: You are in a deep pit.  The walls are smooth for the most part but enough roots have grown through to make some good hand and toe holds.  Above you, the trapdoor taunts you with visions of freedom.

title: [Underground Ruin, Entrance Hall]
description: This is the southern most end of the entrance hall.  The walls are bare except for a few burnt out torches.  Flattened against the south wall is the mummified corpse of a guard.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The cavern's ceiling is lost in the cloying darkness above, and quiet dripping sounds rebound and echo about the massive chamber.  Two flickering torches are set upon the craggy grey walls, casting an uneasy light into the shadows that shrouds the chamber.  The air is mildly chilly deep within the embrace of the earth, and the faint scent of decaying flesh hangs in the air like a fog.

title: [Underground, Hidden Wing]
description: This appears to be a small shrine of some sort.  Against the east wall is an altar with tarnished religious symbols on it.  The covering is tattered and the three pews here are dry and rotted.  For the first time you notice that the thick dust on the floor is punctuated by shallow footprints, leading you to think that this place is not as abandoned as you first imagined.

title: [Underground Ruin, Sub-Basement]
description: A few scattered bits of broken lumber surround a small trapdoor in the south wall, its surface scarred with raking claw marks and dark stains.  The room is littered with fallen beams leaning awkwardly against the walls and various other broken remnants of the prior inhabitants.

title: [Underground Ruin, Basement Pit]
description: Whirling motes of dust flicker in and out of sight as they pass through the faint beams of light filtering in through the broken trapdoor.  The air is stifling with mold and ancient decay, and a few yellowed scraps of bone litter the moist dirt floor.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens into a yawning cavern, its pale grey walls festooned with small glowing patches of greenish lichen.  An arch of rock opens into a small cave in the northern wall, faint beams of light winking in and out of existence from within.

title: [Caverns, Crystal Pool]
description: Spokes of quartz peek out from beneath a large, circular pool, the glassy water illuminated by an eerie glow filtering from above.  Pale white lichen hangs down from the ceiling, casting the chamber in a steady, faint light that shimmers with a rainbow luminescence.  The crystals within the pool continually reflect the unearthly, pristine light, sending off fractured beams across the chamber like twinkling stars.

title: [Caverns, Chamber]
description: A low, darkened tunnel branches off the main cavern to the west, its jagged opening almost resembling a gaping maw.  A few fragile stalactites have broken away from their brethren, lying broken in a damp puddle that collects at the tunnel's opening.

title: [Caverns, Low Tunnel]
description: Phosphorescent moss grows profusely in streaks down the undulating stone walls and in saucer-shaped hollows along the rough cave floor, its pale glow almost making it appear as if the walls were melting.  The floor of the tunnel meanders downward to the northwest, where the darkness emits a faint scent of distant salt air.

title: [Cave, Entrance]
description: A large opening in the rock face of the north wall of this cliffside has been covered with a few scraps of roughly cured leather.  Apparently this leather was meant to serve as a crude door to the obvious cave behind it.

title: [Cave, Intersection]
description: Several large passageways converge here near the opening to the cave.  A crude leather flap covers the way out, and to the west you hear the distant sound of dripping water.  A foul stench, which seems to be coming from the north, permeates the air of this room.  To the northwest, a well travelled passage leads back into darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, west, northwest, out

title: [House of Paupers, Crystal Room]
[Paupers, Crystal Room]
description: An abundance of overgrown hanging plants and excessive humidity encourage you to shed your inhibitions along with your clothing to participate in the water sports played in this enormous area covered by a translucent crystal dome.  In one corner you see a steaming hot tub surrounded by rocks and lush greenery.  The plants release aromatic vapors which relax your senses.  An expansive swimming pool sparkles as it reflects the moonlight.

An abundance of overgrown hanging plants and excessive humidity encourage you to shed your inhibitions along with your clothing to participate in the water sports played in this enormous area covered by a translucent crystal dome.  In one corner you see a steaming hot tub surrounded by rocks and lush greenery.  The plants release aromatic vapors which relax your senses.  An expansive swimming pool sparkles as it reflects the light from the sun.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Sunlight glints brightly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Moonlight glistens softly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

title: [Kobold Mines, Entrance]
description: This is a wide section of cavern that slopes rapidly downwards into darkness.  The rock-strewn floor has been worn smooth by the passing of many feet hauling heavy loads.  Several smaller caverns and chambers open up in several directions, but in the uncertain light their contents remain hidden.  Twin streaks of rust vanish downslope into the chill and damp air of this benighted domain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northwest, down, out

title: [Kobold Mines, Cavern]
description: Dark and damp, this small cavern is silent save for the eternal sound of water, dripping and flowing, echoing dimly as it seeks the depths of these caverns.  Columns of rust-tinted limestone form a lifeless and grotesque forest that waits endlessly for the ages to pass, hoping for a Spring that never comes.

title: [Kobold Mines, Dark Pool]
description: You are standing on a narrow footpath worn into the smooth stone in between the cavern wall and the edge of the dark pool.  As you gaze out over the pool, you notice step-like terraces of slick rock that rise along one wall, creating a multi-layered natural dam.  Water trickles down from level to level, forming a quiet waterfall that pools near your feet.

title: [Kobold Mines, Deep Pit]
description: Standing on a narrow ledge before a yawning black pit, you peer down only to see that the walls soon drop out of sight.  The ground is dry and your footing seems secure, but a feeling of uneasiness hangs in the musty air.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: Dark, granite mountain walls hem the small trail.  A cave is partly hidden in the shadows.  Strange-looking symbols are chiseled around the cave opening.  An eerie aura seems to emanate from the cave and you can't help but notice that the locals stay well away from it.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Cave]
description: Enough moonlight leaks in to make the outermost portion of the cave hazily visible.  A couple of rusted torch-holders are bolted to the walls, and fantastical petroglyphs adorn most of the surfaces.  The ground is hardpacked soil and surprisingly flat.  The depth of the cave disappears in darkness, though a small crevice can be seen just where the blackness usurps the remaining light.

Enough light leaks in to make the outermost portion of the cave hazily visible.  A couple of rusted torch-holders are bolted to the walls, and fantastical petroglyphs adorn most of the surfaces.  The ground is hardpacked soil and surprisingly flat.  The depth of the cave disappears in darkness, though a small crevice can be seen just where the blackness usurps the remaining light.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: A bluish-grey mountain spire dominates the terrain.  The top of the spire is hidden by clinging clouds.  Around the base of the mountain pillar are strewn rocks of a variety of shapes and sizes.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Crag]
description: A grey and moist sea of mist envelops the crag, making it quite impossible to see more than an arm's length or two.  The moist air makes the small, granite mountain top slick and treacherous, but also adds a vibrancy to the blue-grey hued rock.  Occasional icy blasts of wind make the mist swirl hypnotically.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of moonlight parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of light parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cave]
description: The hollow may be cold and clammy, but it is also impossible for large beasts to enter.  Nasty snarls from somewhere outside the opening almost make it possible to forget the shivering and the darkness.  Almost, but not quite.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: A group of tall, rough cut boulders lies carefully placed in a semi-circle with its opening toward the ocean below.  There are numerous carvings of stone faces, some quite intricate, and others which appear to have been hewn with poor stone tools.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: It's damp and chilly in the cavern, and only a little moonlight filters in from a hole leading up.  The walls are natural rock, worn smooth by wind, water and time.  The cavern widens to the east.
It's damp and chilly in the cavern, and the only light comes from a hole leading up.  The walls are natural rock, worn smooth by wind, water and time.  The cavern widens to the east.

title: [Ocean View]
description: The ocean and all of its majesty dance far below this man made perch.  A bench of solid stone, carved from the cliff, overlooks a simple stone table.  Dried flowers adorn the table, an offering by some unknown person devoted to the old ways.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This dark, narrow tunnel smells from the remains of small creatures that have crawled in here to die.  The walls are covered with a slimy residue that also has an unpleasant odor.

title: [Sea Caverns, Garbage Chamber]
description: Massive piles of garbage reach nearly to the ceiling.  Bones, scraps and unrecognizables mix together in a rotten morass of greys, browns and black.  Much of it is piled about a fissure in the floor.  The stench is so bad it's almost visible.

title: [Sea Caverns, Refuse Pile]
description: The floor is covered with rotting piles of garbage, apparently dumped from the dark fissure above.  Some of the piles seem to be writhing, though it's tough to be sure through the noxious fog that blankets the floor.  To the southeast, a mass of webs fills the tunnel.

title: [A Faint Path]
description: Only a few scattered rosebushes remain in the magic-scarred waste, bearing roses as black as the tower that rises in their midst.  The graceful obsidian walls of the dark edifice are smooth and seamless, and no entrance is visible.  The air here in the tower's shadow crackles with a dark energy that seems to crawl along your skin.

Only a few scattered bushes remain in the magic-scarred waste, bearing roses as black as the tower that rises in their midst.  The graceful obsidian walls of the dark edifice are smooth and seamless, and no entrance is visible.  The air here in the tower's shadow crackles with a dark energy that seems to crawl along your skin.

title: [Guarded Entryway]
description: Two tall, lean figures, their features obscured by heavy dark cloaks, stand before a door forged from solid black ora.  Their eyes glint violet from beneath the deep cowls, as if daring you to test their skill with the Dhe'nari whip-blades they carry in their gloved hands.  Opposite the sentinels, a tunnel disappears into the darkness of the caverns.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: The shadows are deep on this side of the sanctuary.  To the north is the altar, sitting above the level of the pews, seemingly casting the shadows down upon you.  To the east, a small prayer chapel sits apart from the sanctuary in a small alcove and a small passageway leads northeast.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The old altar sits overlooking the sanctuary.  From here, the shadows seem deeper, the silence more ominous, as if the sonorous breathing of a majestic life had suddenly ceased, leaving you alone and afraid.  Set into the wall behind the altar is a massive glass window, not yet broken, although a creeping dark stain has spread over it, turning the colors an unwholesome red-black.  Some marble stairs lead down into darkness, providing an alternative to going back to the sanctuary itself.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: A damp breeze blows in through a warped door tucked away in an alcove in the west wall.  Dead leaves skitter across the floor, leaving tracings in the dirt.  To the north, at the head of the sanctuary, the altar sits above the floor level for all to see.  Once a comforting presence, the altar now seems dead at best, malevolent at worst.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The old altar sits overlooking the sanctuary.  From here, the shadows seem deeper, the silence more ominous, as if the sonorous breathing of a majestic life had suddenly ceased, leaving you alone and afraid.  Set into the wall behind the altar is a massive glass window, not yet broken, although a creeping dark stain has spread over it, turning the colors an unwholesome red-black.  Some marble stairs lead down into darkness, providing an alternative to going back to the sanctuary itself.

title: [Observation Tower]
description: The stone walls are bare, save for a raised mural on the north facing wall, which depicts in great detail the surroundings of Wehnimer's Landing.  Resting on a dais mid-center of the tower, a hand-carved obsidian chair captures the eye.  Deep gouges mar the surface of one of the steps which leads up to the surface of the platform.

title: [Observation Platform]
description: The rotating chair swivels easily around, showing great views of the surrounding area through vertical-slitted windows that traverse the walls.  All manner of gadgets presents themselves for manipulation.  A crystal eyepiece mounted on a spring arm can be raised and lowered on a whim by use of a horizontal and vertical cranks and a lever made of invar.

title: [Merchant's Guild, Anteroom]
description: This small antechamber has a desk with several important-looking documents scattered across its surface.  An oil lamp burning provides some dim light.

title: [Merchant's Guild, Records]
description: The only sound in this lavishly appointed room is the ticking of a wood clock.  The floor is covered with a rug of Velnalin pelts, the walls decorated with ornate stencils depicting various sorts of business transactions.  You notice a series of bookshelves, a rich mahogany desk, and an iron-bound chest.

The only sound in this lavishly appointed room is the ticking of a wood clock.  The floor is covered with a rug of velnalin pelts, the walls decorated with ornate stencils depicting various sorts of business transactions.  You notice a series of bookshelves, a rich mahogany desk, and an iron-bound chest.

title: [Bard Guild, Theater Lobby]
description: The chamber is shaped like a crescent moon, and within the curve of the arms, cascading tiers of steps lead down to arches opening into the auditorium beyond.  Heavy velvet drapes and thick rugs, all a rich shade of dark crimson, give the room a hushed ambiance, rendering footsteps almost soundless and conversation into a muted buzz.

title: [Bard Guild, Performance Hall]
description: The auditorium is cavernous, and every inch of the curved ceiling appears to be covered in vividly colored frescos.  The walls are a combination of polished mahogany and painted panels that equal the ceiling in decoration.  Tiers of seats descend toward a stage at the hall's far end, their ranks upholstered in crimson velvet that matches red carpet runners traversing the aisles between them.  A row of small lanterns illuminates the front of the stage.

title: [Wehnimer's, Treehouse]
description: This sturdy wooden platform, built of planks and wedged into a fork of the oak's trunk, provides a place to sit and rest in the shade of an overhanging branch.  A glance through the foliage affords a bird's-eye view of the town square below.

This sturdy wooden platform, built of planks and wedged into a fork of the oak's trunk, provides a place to sit and rest in the shadow of an overhanging branch.  A glance through the foliage affords a bird's-eye view of the lamplit town square below.

title: [Inside Oak Tree]
description: Deep in the hollow of this ancient tree, a few carved wooden stools are clustered around a fine-grained oak slab that serves as a table.  Soft light streams in through a large knothole, softly illuminating the area.  Sequestered from the hustle and bustle of the town square, this quiet chamber offers a cozy haven for weary caregivers.

title: [Cholgar's Bathhouse, Entryway]
description: You are in the entrance hall of the reportedly "therapeutic" and mostly scandalous Cholgar's Bathhouse.  Rich, red carpeting covers the wooden floors and the walls are hidden behind many draperies, tapestries and assorted sculpture of a questionable nature.  Rooms lie down a thickly carpeted hall to the north, where most any patron's fancy comes to life.

title: [Bathhouse, Ruins]
description: Devastation has been wrought upon the contents of the room, if it can indeed be called a room.  The blackened walls are caving in at various points.  Broken desks, chairs, and other unrecognizable items are scattered about in random piles of debris.  Bits and scraps of sodden parchment lie in tiny mounds here and there, the ink having bled until it turned the watery masses a dark grey.

title: [Wehnimer's, Constabulary]
description: The front room of the local constabulary contains the desk of the town constable.  The oaken floor is scuffed by countless feet dragged across it, obviously most reluctantly.  Behind the desk is a weapon rack.  A strong, ironbound door with a narrow, barred grate leads east.

title: [Catacombs, Dank Cellar]
description: A few brown sewer rats dart across the floor and scurry north, in the direction of the odor of spoiled food and ancient cooking grease.  In a far bleak corner stands a filthy cot, a heap of dirty laundry piled high at its foot.  Anchored into the southern wall is a ladder, which disappears into the total darkness that obscures the vaulted ceiling.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Sunlight glints brightly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Moonlight glistens softly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The very tall, very rickety wooden ladder sways considerably under your weight.  Below you the pool looks very, very small.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The very tall, very rickety wooden ladder sways considerably under your weight.  Below you the pool looks very, very small.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower Platform]
description: The narrow platform sways wildly under your weight.  Far below the pool seems nothing more than a bright, insignificant speck.  A short distance above you is the dome of the crystal ceiling.

title: [Frith's Inn, Second Floor]
description: You are on the second floor of the inn.  As you lean over the polished modwir railing that surrounds the open landing, you see the front room below.  The stairway continues up and down here.  To the east is an oak door and to the west a teakwood door bearing a brass plaque.

title: [Frith's Inn, Bedchamber]
description: The welcome sight of a roomy cot bedecked with a featherbed mattress, ice goose down quilt, and plump pillows greets you.  Any weary traveller would gladly rest and restore body and spirits alike in this comfortable, airy chamber.

title: [Helga's, Back Alley]
description: The narrow alley, shaded by the overhanging eaves of the stone and wood buildings that rise on all sides, is full of debris, piles of rags and filth.  A broken wooden chair, an old crate and a trash barrel are piled to either side of the smoke-stained oaken door that leads into the back of the building to the south.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Two sconces hang here, one unlit and leaving much of the area in darkness.  Of the portion of the wall that is lit up, the misspelled message  "Breware"  has been smeared in blood.

title: [River Tower East, Roof]
description: A small, roofed structure provides some weather protection on the open top level of the guard tower.  The view north across the bay affords a valuable vantage point, looking out towards the island of Glaoveln, home port of the warlike Ice Krolvin.  To the west and south, the blue rivers and rocky slopes of the Lower Trollfang region provide a breathtaking vista.

title: [Observation Platform]
description: All manner of gadgets presents themselves for manipulation.  A crystal eyepiece mounted on a spring arm can be raised and lowered on a whim by use of a horizontal and vertical cranks and a lever made of invar.  The rotating chair swivels easily around, showing great views of the surrounding area through vertical-slit windows that traverse the walls.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Several doorways open off the hallway, however, only two are currently used as guest rooms.  The chandelier hangs low enough that you must duck your head or risk being splattered with hot tallow should you bump into it.  A slightly worn tapestry carpet has been tacked down the center of the hallway.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, White Room]
description: The ceiling slopes low towards the floor on either side of a round dormer window.  Twin beds with thick down comforters are set to either side of the window, where the ceiling merges with the walls.  A white snowcat fur rug covers the floor between the beds.  Simple cedar chests are at the foot of each bed, filling the air with an agreeably woodsy scent each time their lids are raised.

title: [Northern Caravansary, SW Corner]
description: Stacked beneath and about a merchant wagon are scores of barrels and hogsheads, all tightly sealed and bound together with ropes.  A crudely fashioned sign depicting a pile of animals with 'X's' for eyes hangs above the door that the steps lead up to.

title: [Pets No More]
