The sound of rushing water filters across the path from a cliff that can be seen in the distance, while white cobblestones gleam in the moonlight from the courtyard that the bridge empties into at its other end.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Cliff]
description: The plateau leads to a steep cliff that overlooks the dense jungle.  A swaying rope bridge connects the cliff to the monastery below as it stretches over the forest's canopy.  A parting in the leaves beneath the bridge reveals several motes of torchlight glistening from the forest floor.  Centered in the plateau stands a run-down citadel, the majority of its towers and walls cracked and broken.  An arched doorway, long bereft of an actual door, leads deeper into the stronghold.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stone Tree]
description: Scratched into the bedrock is this hollow cavern that stretches below a great banyan.  A solitary candle on a simple altar lends illumination and shadows to the pockmarked and irregular formations surrounding the underground den.  An elaborate upside-down tree growing down from the ceiling has been shaped from the banyan's roots and mirrored in carvings that span the stone walls.  A light musk infiltrates as the air is stirred through the cavern, and a subtle but oppressive silence hangs in the air.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Corpse Copse]
description: What distinguishes this portion of the jungle is the abundant growth of rafflesia, many of the fungi in bloom with their enormous flame-hued flowers.  Lying low to the ground, the parasitic plants attach to the root systems of the multitude of liana vines growing up the trunks and limbs of a tight stand of rubber trees.  The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

What distinguishes this portion of the jungle is the abundant growth of rafflesia, many of the fungi in bloom with their enormous flame-hued flowers.  Lying low to the ground, the parasitic plants attach to the root systems of the multitude of liana vines growing up the trunks and limbs of a tight stand of rubber trees and a single ancient banyan tree.  The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

title: [Earthen Cave, Undertree]
description: A rough stone ladder descends from above near the very edge of the room.  The cave's chamber is walled with hard-packed soil, held in by a network of roots that crisscross the walls like the threads of a spider's web, two of which flank a narrow earthen passage.  A large bundle of roots descends from the center of the ceiling in a writhing tangle, some tips curled around glowing crimson globes, creating a macabre chandelier.  Set beneath the roots is a fire pit, while in the background, set into the wall, is a niche containing an ornamented skeleton.

title: [Shadowed Clearing]
description: Dense canopy surrounds this small clearing encasing it in cool dark shadow.  Thin white mist enshrouds a stained stone slab that is surrounded by tiny black gravel in the center of the clearing.  No living thing disturbs the silent grip that stillness holds on this secret, hidden glen.  Over the slab, three small orbs slowly hover, spinning around each other and casting a faint silvery light that mutes nearby colors into varied shades of pale whites, cool grays, and pitch blacks.  Between two trees is an arch of tangled boughs.

title: [Rogue Guild, Access Points]
description: Narrowing quickly, the huge tunnel deadends in a thick metal grate that completely covers one end.  Bits of paper and various other waste cling to the cross bars of the grate indicating that, at times, there is considerably more water here than now.  A rusty iron ladder leads up to a manhole above.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: White picket fences, their thick and thin slats entangled with vines laden with niveous violet-striped clematis and red-throated saffron hibiscus, encircle the yards of the houses that line the cobbled street.  Shell-lined pathways wind their way through the verdant lawns that the fences encircle and allow easy passage from the street to the cottages beyond, some of which have signs proclaiming them to be shops.  Lamps, their glass windows glinting in the sunlight, dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks that line the streets.

White picket fences, their thick and thin slats entangled with vines laden with niveous violet-striped clematis and red-throated saffron hibiscus, encircle the yards of the houses that line the cobbled street.  Shell-lined pathways wind their way through the verdant lawns that the fences encircle and allow easy passage from the street to the cottages beyond, some of which have signs proclaiming them to be shops.  Lamps dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks that line the streets and create circles of illumination.

title: [The Colonnade, Hallway]
description: The hallway here is brightly lit, with oil lamps resting in elaborate pewter sconces along the walls on both sides.  A wooden stage door stands between two sconces leading stage left, while a dressing room door in the opposite wall is clearly marked with a gilded golden star.  At each end of the hallway, a polished oak door leads into the audience chamber.

title: [The Colonnade, Auditorium]
description: Opposite the set of double doors leading in, the stage stretches from one end of the room to the other, beyond the proscenium arch with its dividing burgundy curtain.  Facing the stage, row upon row of opulent rowan benches, covered in soft burgundy velvet cushions, stand upon the black marble floor.  Torches around the room serve to light the space, and can be snuffed or lit as needed.  The proscenium steps on either side of the stage are each flanked by a small oak door leading out of the room.

title: [The Colonnade, Hallway]
description: The hallway here is brightly lit, with oil lamps resting in elaborate pewter sconces along the walls on both sides.  A wooden stage door stands between two sconces leading stage left, while a dressing room door in the opposite wall is clearly marked with a gilded golden star.  At each end of the hallway, a polished oak door leads into the audience chamber.

title: [The Colonnade, Backstage]
description: This small space is cramped, with props and scenery piled in haphazard stacks on either side of a narrow walkway.  The rope for the curtain stretches from ceiling to floor near the light switches, the pulleys glisten with oil to avoid squeaking, and the wooden lever is buffed smooth.  Providing access to the stage are two arches, while at the back of the room, a wooden stage door leads out to the hallway.

title: [The Colonnade, Balcony]
description: Where the staircase ends, its beautiful carved railings spread to each side, dividing the balcony from the open space above the lobby with twisting marble wildflowers and twining ivy vines.  Velvet ropes define the areas open to the public and those which require tickets.  A rowan door embossed with a silver plaque rests in the wall at one end, while an oak door embossed with a gold plaque stands at the other.

title: [The Colonnade, Box Seat Gold]
description: High above the auditorium, this box seat provides a perfect view of the stage and its heavy curtain.  Gold accents on the railings and thickly padded marble chairs sparkle in the lamp light as the flames flicker within their glass containers.  Serving trays rest on wheeled carts on the thick burgundy carpet near an oak door embossed with golden scrollwork leading back outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Rounded cobblestones are stacked with precision to create the smooth walls, which gently curve upward to create a domed ceiling.  Piles of debris are clustered along the southern wall, the faint scent of decay and mildew rising from them, though the northern wall appears to be largely clear where a sewer-capped ladder disappears into the ceiling.  Oddly deep, several claw marks mar the lower area of the rounded walls.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sea Turtle Lane]
description: Surrounded by flowering trees, the teak and cedar villa sprawls across a petal-strewn lawn along the northern edge of the street.  Glassless windows provide a view of the cobalt blue walls of the interior, while the exterior is marked by an elegant painted sign and an arched entry that exudes a welcoming atmosphere.  Golden sunlight illuminates the tangled clusters of the surrounding foliage, which provides a pleasant contrast to the bright white of the cobblestoned street.

Surrounded by flowering trees, the teak and cedar villa sprawls across a petal-strewn lawn along the northern edge of the street.  Wide open windows, illuminated from within, provide a view of the cobalt blue walls of the interior, while the exterior is marked by an elegant painted sign and an arched entry that exudes a welcoming atmosphere.  Circles of lamplight pool upon the cobblestones and cast shadows in the surrounding foliage that partially obscure a vast marble castle.

title: [Bard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Offering an excellent view of the harbor, the stone-lined walkway opens up into a large cobblestone courtyard.  Beds of bright flowers are planted about, splashing color over the pale grey stones leading up to an elegant whitewashed manor.  A pair of bright ceramic urns flank the staircase, each one filled with beautiful island blossoms.  Several varieties of orchid and fern trees surround the area, creating a colorful canopy.

title: [Bard Guild, Foyer]
description: Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a marble stairway leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a wide staircase leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Much of the water flowing into the area cascades through the gates in the floor in a frothy rush, leaving the available footing covered with spray and as slippery as metal.   Recessed into the wall, a ladder pushes up toward a trapdoor.

title: [A Dark Warehouse]
description: Cramped and crowded, the small room appears to be a warehouse with brick walls and a knotty oak floor.  Stacks of boxes and containers are piled to the ceiling in many places and create a labyrinthine maze of packed goods.  Incredibly faint light leaks out from behind one particular short stack of wooden crates, while light from the alley also filters in through the open doorway.

title: [Sewers, Beneath the Slaughter]
description: Smelling heavily of carnage, the dank passage is illuminated by a single torch resting in a bracket beside a blackened wrought iron ladder that leads upwards towards the oak ceiling.  Sanguine stains darken the walls and packed dirt floor.

title: [The Slaughterhouse]
description: Cracked and peeling paint decorate the walls of the small shop, their curled ends littering the rough floor amid a layer of scattered sawdust.  One long counter stretches across the room, easily dividing the shopping space from the work area.  Implements of the butchering trade, such as razor strops, black iron rib cutters, and knives, dangle from black iron hooks, which stand over sanguine filled buckets.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Scents of garlic and herbs mingle with those of rotten food.  The water flows slowly past piles of food wastes in various states of decay.  A soft click-click in the darkness suggests that the piles are feasts for some.  Rising from a pile of fresh slop, a slippery ladder leads upward to the apparent source.

title: [Monkey Fist, Storage Closet]
description: Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond the a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

title: [Rogue Guild, Training Nexus]
description: Several iron-grated drains are recessed into the uneven cobblestone of the floor and surround a raised platform that is covered in steel sheets.  Large alcoves lined in white and black stones are arranged around the north, west, and southern walls, their depths illuminated by candles from within.  Surrounding the eastern passage into the sewers is an old iron ladder, that leads up, and a rough oak table that is heavily scarred with jagged gashes.

title: [Warehouse, Tanner's Haven]
description: Thick and cloying, the air in this section of the warehouse is heavy with the acrid scent of chemicals despite the wide open window located in its eastern wall.  Curing frames hang from the exposed rafters above vats filled with viscous liquids, while a long counter stretching across the opposite wall provides ample workspace for the various apprentices that move through the room completing obscure tasks.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Locks]
description: Flickering light from the north spills into this section of the tunnel, though its licking fingers do not invade the deep shadows to the south.  Rising along the eastern wall, and bolted into place by large iron brackets, is a blackened ladder that leads from the cobblestone floor and disappears into the wooden ceiling.

title: [Locks and More, Workshop]
description: The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Windows up near the peak of the ceiling on either side of the room provide the only light, the lamps overhead unlit.

The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Moonlight filters through the windows up near the peak of the ceiling, the lamps overhead lit to provide more light.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Gems]
description: Bright light spills into this short passage from the south, its brilliance illuminating every stone, corner, and crevice in the area.  A single ladder rises from the stone floor and disappears into the wooden rafters of the ceiling.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels]
description: Blue, green, and purple striped rugs are scattered about on the floor, like small islands, while an oak counter partially spans one side of the room.  A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, the curtains drawn back allowing daylight to enter.

Blue, green, and purple striped rugs are scattered about on the floor, like small islands, while an oak counter partially spans one side of the room.  A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, and crystal lamps are hung between the windows, providing additional lighting.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Health]
description: Glass globes housed in copper cages are suspended from the ceiling and provide ample illumination for this section of the tunnel.  Painted bright white, the walls, ceiling, and floor are all uniformly the same and a narrow cot appears to be the only furnishing.  A blackened iron ladder leads upward through a small trapdoor.

title: [Healer's House]
description: Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat snoozes beneath them in a patch of light on the floor.  Drying herbs hang from hooks upon the wall, waiting to be used in various medicines.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat bats lazily at them from a big blue cushion on the floor.  A large quantity of lamps hanging overhead keep the room well lit.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

title: [Sewers, Under Lock and Key]
description: Roughly carved out of dirt, the terminus is surrounded on four sides by walls and has a small tunnel that leads towards a central nexus.  Spidery white roots decorate the smooth walls and the floor is pitted with oddly shaped rocks.  Four thick support posts mark the corners of the area, while a blackened iron ladder rises towards the knotty oak ceiling where a small trap door stands closed.  A waxed parchment is tacked near the ladder.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Cell]
description: Bitter and bleak, the air hardly moves in here except for a single vent in the center of the ceiling.  A thin shaft of moonlight is the only access to the outside through a vertical crack in the outside wall.  A small metal table is bolted to the floor as is a sturdy metal cot next to it.

title: [Sewers, Under Lock and Key]

A large fallen log rests underneath the shade of several of its companion trees, its roughened jagged-edged body covered in an array of vines and insects.  Butterflies flutter in and out of small patches of wildflowers flourishing near the edge of the jungle, their jewel-toned wings creating a subtle, yet distinctive, buzz in the humid air.  The presence of an occasional breeze, wafting in from the nearby river, alleviates the discomfort of the sauna-like surroundings.

title: [Sewers, Portal to Freedom]
description: Terminating to the northwest in a round grate, the sewer is fashioned of cobblestones and wrought iron.  Bright sunlight illuminates the passage and the scent of sea salt fills the air.

title: [Western Harbor, Pier One]
description: New planks mingle with older ones upon the pier, their addition creating a stripped pattern across the smooth platform as it juts a short distance out into the sea.  A series of oak steps leads to the main dock on one side of the pier, while on the opposite side is a small canvas-sided awning sheltering a bench.  Fishing boats are moored to the edge of the dock, their arrangement neat and tidy with an equidistant spacing between each.

title: [Sewers, Under the Scuttle]
description: Transitioning from cobblestones to knotty oak, the ceiling of the passage is largely hidden in shadows.  Smooth stone walls give way to a wall of packed dirt in the southeast, where a blackened wrought iron ladder disappears through a trapdoor above.  The scent of freshly baked bread mingles oddly with the overall dankness of the area.

title: [Scuttlebug Tavern]
description: Rough oak planks spread from the entry at one end of the room to the dinghy-shaped bar that is surrounded by stools at the other, their slender surfaces riddled with large and small knots.  High above, a chandelier housing dozens of candles provides ample illumination for each of the various tables that are scattered throughout, while also illuminating the various signs that hang from the rafters.  A rickety staircase leads to the upstairs and connects with a balcony that encircles half of the tavern.

title: [Silvergate, 3rd Floor Hallway]
description: Thick carpeting muffles your footsteps and warms this room.  A small window in the western wall overlooks a courtyard far below and the forest beyond.  Simply furnished, there is a single table and a straight-backed chair resting at the window.  A wide carpeted staircase leads back to the lounge far below.

title: [Silvergate, Dianatrue's Suite]
description: A warm-hued, hardwood oak floor is polished to a lustrous glow, and matching thick ceiling supports frame a leaded crystal dome.  One wall, created entirely of intricately mortared pieces of flagstone, holds a massive fireplace with an oak mantelpiece.  Deep-cushioned wing chairs of wicker ring a small, cloth-covered table in one corner, and a four poster bed rests directly beneath the crystal dome.  A curtained archway leads to a balcony, and an alcove holds an indistinct shape in its recesses.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Treetop]
description: Branches intertwine to form several large benches here, covered with moss and soft pillows.  There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the songs of the birds and the chattering of the animals that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

Branches intertwine to form several large benches here, covered with moss and soft pillows.  There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the muted noises of the insects that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

title: [Lady Lissa's Chamber]
description: The warmth of this chamber welcomes you, as the room is engulfed by the sun reaching through the intricately carved openings in the bark walls.  In one corner, a four-posted bed draped with a cockatrice feather comforter invites you to bask in the tranquility of your surroundings.  Below a painting on the opposite wall is an oak desk, covered with scrolls, colorful drawings and maps.  A rug covers the floor near a fireplace in the adjacent corner.

The serenity of this chamber welcomes you, as the room is engulfed by the moonlight reaching through the intricately carved openings in the bark walls.  In one corner, a four-posted bed draped with a cockatrice feather comforter invites you to bask in the tranquility of your surroundings.  Below a painting on the opposite wall is an oak desk, covered with scrolls, colorful drawings and maps.  A rug covers the floor near a fireplace in the adjacent corner.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rose Garden]
description: The scent of a hundred different kinds of roses fills the air here.  Bushes and vines grafted into the Sylvanfair tree bear magical blooms of every imaginable color, throughout every season.  A large branch arches off to the west.

title: [Sylvanfair, Morning Glory Room]
description: A large window framed by delicately veined morning glory leaves floods the room with light and fresh air.  The walls are covered with carefully cultivated morning glories of delicate violet shades.  A large bed covered with a puma hide blanket beckons from behind a thin ora screen in one corner, and an instrument rack holding a lute and a harp stands against the wall next to a large bookcase.

title: [Moot Hall, Orchard]
description: A large garden stretches out beneath the shadow of Moot Hall, where rows and rows of apple trees flourish in abundance.  In the center of the orchard stands a speckled dark grey granite fountain surrounded by hand-carved red oak benches.  Thick stone walls rise up behind the building, shielding the area from the rest of the town, and a carved wooden door leads back inside.

title: [Moot Hall, Rooftop]
description: Dark slate runs across the roof of Moot Hall, providing solid footing and an impressive view of the town square below.  To the west, the great oak tree in the center of town rises up, partially obscuring the western side of the bazaar.

title: [Linen or Leather]
description: Battered wooden boards line the floor of the wagon, covered in part by a mud-spattered green rug.  A sturdy monir rack hangs along one wall, while a dark mahogany wardrobe and a stained oak cabinet sit against the opposite wall.  A dented bronze hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Linen or Leather, Storeroom]
description: Stacks of wooden boxes and crates line the walls and fill up most of the space in this cramped storage area.  One corner remains vacant, save for a lumpy padded cot and a cushioned bench sitting perpendicular to each other.  A tarnished brass lamp hangs on the wall barely a foot above the cot.

title: [Town Barracks, Inner Courtyard]
description: Stone walls wrap around to form a solid enclosure to the courtyard, the ground smooth and paved with dark cobblestones.  Barely visible beyond the thick iron gate stretches North Ring Road and an expanse of the palisades of Wehnimer's Landing.  A large two-story brick building dominates the far end of the courtyard, its roof topped with a black and grey flag.

title: [Wehnimer's, The Mews]
description: This narrow lane runs north to south, shaded by the narrow, unadorned buildings that loom on both sides of the rough paving stones.  The clatter of wagon wheels on cobbled streets and the jangling of iron-fitted harnesses echoes from the south, along with a scent of leather and livestock.

title: [ShadowGuard, South Courtyard]
description: The dank, musty smell of rotting vegetation pervades this area as death has taken hold.  Overgrown with weeds and uncontrolled, twisted plant life, the courtyard must once have been beautiful.  The crumbling remnants of a gatehouse tower, and occasional intact pieces of the southern wall, stand as a sad reminder of the former might of the fortress.

title: [ShadowGuard, Gatehouse Tower]
description: The bottom floor of the tower is strewn with the rotting remnants of an ancient wooden desk and several chairs.  The rusted remains of a large weapons rack sag against one wall.  The air is so damp the moisture is palpable, and moss covers much of the cracked stone walls and rotting furniture.  A dilapidated archway leads back to the courtyard.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Courtyard]
description: Though dead and withered, the crisp clean lines of the formal gardens are still clearly visible.  Bright white pebbled walkways cut a sinuous pattern through the decaying flora winding their way around the cathedral to the northeast.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Tower]
description: Several rusted-out metal cabinets lie overturned amongst piles of rubble, spilling a variety of antiquated weapons onto the dust-covered stone floor.  Deep cracks in the walls allow a slight breeze to enter, but the breeze does nothing to alleviate the heavy dampness in the air.  Strategically placed stones jut out from the curved walls to form a stairway leading to the level above.

title: [Shadowguard, East Courtyard]
description: Neglected gardens have overgrown their boundaries here, spilling out over the pebbled walkways.  Several rotting trellises, heavy with twisted blackened roses, have collapsed against the deteriorating walls.  A pair of glowing eyes peers from beneath the tangled mess.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Tower]
description: Circular stone walls surround a large pile of debris that dominates the center of the room.  The remains of a desk, chairs, and broken pottery make up the bulk of the pile, while a few rusting weapons lie discarded nearby.  A small stairway cut into the east wall leads upward.

title: [Shadowguard, North Courtyard]
description: Piles of stone and timber litter the courtyard.  To the south, crumbling walls extend from the rear of the cathedral, the skeletal remains of the keep that once stood here.  The outer wall has been reclaimed by nature to the east, while a small section still stands to the west.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Tower]
description: Dust lies heavily on the hard stone floor of the tower.  Curved walls rise high above to a rough plank ceiling.  An abandoned desk and two overturned chairs bear testimony to the tower's former use.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Willow Tree]
description: This quiet, leafy bower seems remote from the courtyard below.  The gentle swaying of the tree in the breeze and the susurration of the leaves is relaxing.  Peering down through the willow branches you can spy the natural pool below.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Natural Springs]
description: The small spring is lined with a brilliant array of colorful stones.  Exotic plants, carefully arranged to provide privacy, grow in profusion along the bank.  A tall willow tree leans gracefully over the spring, as if granting its blessing on the swimmers.  The bottom of the spring is lined with fine sand, oddly warm to the feet.  Air bubbles rush up from below, tickling the bare parts of your skin.  A small waterfall trickles musically down a jumble of rocks, and a small wooden fishing dock juts out from a sandy bank.

title: [House Phoenix, Observatory]
description: Here on the highest level of the building, most of the walls and the roof seem to be formed of a clear glasslike crystal that allows an almost unrestricted view of the sky above and the surrounding townscape.  Various instruments of observation and study stand on a raised platform in the middle of the room.  To the south is a hallway.

title: [House Phoenix, Waldo2's Chamber]
description: This room is decorated in muted earth tones, giving a feeling of peace and contentment.  Obviously, the owner wishes to relax, away from the strife and combat of the wilds.  A solid oak chair sits before an equally sturdy oaken desk.  A plain but comfortable bed is the room's only other furnishing.

title: [Doggoroth Keep]
description: Plumes of heavy black smoke billow out of the three chimneys of the keep's forge.  Rising up next to the smithery is an enormous tower.

title: [Doggoroth, Round Tower West]
description: From the top of the tower, the scattered farmlands can be seen before they succumb to the massive woodlands that stretch for miles and miles to the west, broken up only by a narrow river bending through the forest.  A cold, icy breeze stirs through the cracks along the ramparts.

title: [Doggoroth Keep]
description: To the east lies a wide stone building tucked into the shadow of an enormous tower.  Knights and men at arms move throughout the area, hands never far from their weapons.

title: [Doggoroth, Round Tower East]
description: From the top of the tower, the surrounding woodlands give way to the walled city of Talador to the east and the great mountains and mines to the north.  A cold, icy breeze stirs through the cracks along the ramparts.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A stone half-wall lies partly collapsed around the exterior of an old stone tower.  Thick vines coil up the sides of the tower, stretching up and over its battlements.

title: [Old Stone Tower]
description: Sunlight gleams in through broken chunks and cracks in the walls of the stone tower.  The bloated carcass of a rodent lies next to a tarnished silver plate on the ground.  Once, a flight of stone stairs led to the top of the tower, but have since collapsed.

Moonlight gleams in through broken chunks and cracks in the walls of the stone tower.  The bloated carcass of a rodent lies next to a tarnished silver plate on the ground.  Once, a flight of stone stairs led to the top of the tower, but have since collapsed.

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: To the northeast and southeast the East Circle District opens up, lined with shops and colorful pavilions.  Sunlight gleams off the armor of the city's guards while they patrol the area.
To the northeast and southeast the Eastern Circle District opens up, lined with shops and colorful pavilions.  Moonlight gleams off the armor of the city's guards while they patrol the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Charleia's Charms]
description: The interior of the wagon is lined with crowded shelves full of glowing mushrooms, casting the area in a dim greenish glow.  Positioned near a blackened iron cauldron, an ebonwood bookshelf creaks under the weight of a multitude of dusty spell tomes.  A glass-panelled armoire displays a variety of crystals and trinkets at the rear of the wagon.

title: [Jungle Room, Bathing Pool]
description: The warm soothing water relaxes your muscles and the scents of rose and cedar intermingle in the air, leaving you with a renewed spirit.  How refreshing!  Fresh water constantly trickles in from the mouth of a small marble fish statue.

title: [Silvergate, Jungle Room]
description: The warm humid air of this tropical retreat invites you to cast away your worries and cares.  Flowering vines creep up the carved posts of a four-poster bed which provides support for a canopy of rustling ferns.  Water trickles from a fountain, cunningly crafted to resemble a waterfall, and fills a small bathing pool near the fireplace.  Several colorful cushions are scattered on the floor near the hearth.

title: [Silvergate, Meditation Room]
description: Polished oak floors with an inlaid teak border add to the tranquility and elegance of the room.  Centered in the room is a large stone basin with fragrant white water lilies floating in crystal clear water.  Delicate white sheer drapes hang down from an elaborately carved teak canopy that spans the ceiling.  Meditation mats circle the water basin, and tiny crystal prisms hang at different heights from the canopy.

title: [Silvergate, 3rd Floor Hallway]
description: Thick carpeting muffles your footsteps and warms this room.  A small window in the western wall overlooks a courtyard far below and the forest beyond.  Simply furnished, there is a single table and a straight-backed chair resting at the window.  A wide carpeted staircase leads back to the lounge far below.

title: [Storage Hall]
description: The hall is dark, lit only by a guttering torch over each of the two doors and a beam of light pouring through a small hole in the wall.  The obsidian walls are unbroken by decorations, and any noises echo loudly off the stone.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Den]
description: Large bookcases, filled with ancient tomes all bound with dark purple seals, stretch from wall to wall.  In the center of the room is a large, circular fireplace, its iron curtain protecting the plush fur throws that are laid out before it.  Chairs set about two large lamp-lit mahogany tables provide a perfect place for late night studies.  About the room rest several large trophies, and a large portrait hangs above the bookcases.

title: [Bard Guild, Lower Hallway]
description: A short, low-lit hallway is lined with doors and openings, with heavy velvet drapes to the north that shield the corridor from the Feast Hall's din.  The walls of the corridor are paneled in dark wood, and a row of rectangular lanterns standing on either side of the aisle sheds soft light.  Each door is labeled.  A brass sign on an oak door reads 'Practice Room,' to the east is the 'Music Room,' and to the south is the 'Music Library.'
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, up

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is an oak-paneled chamber with a small hearth.  In the center sits a chair and accompanying music stand.  Opposite the hearth is a side table, offering a place to scribble notes or work on musical compositions.

title: [Guardian Keep, Kitchen]
description: Beneath overtones of woodsmoke, the air of the kitchen is peppered with delectable scents of roasting meat and baking bread.  In stark contrast to the symphony of scents, the kitchen is largely utilitarian.  Beyond a series of wide-bellied cast iron stewpots, wide countertops boasting neatly bunched vegetables devour much of its space.  Huge recesses in the walls host hearths cooking spitted velnalins and gaks.  A swinging oak door in the north wall stands opposite a smaller doorway to the south.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Hallway]
description: Sword aloft, a hulking Vaalor elf is remembered in statue at the end of the low-ceiling chamber.  Runners of golden and crimson velvet soften the tiled floors below, the hues reflecting in the burnished marble of the ceiling.  A lustrous mosaic-tiled arch gleams from the southern wall at the hallway's midpoint.  Near the corridor's end, the simple entrance to the armory and a swinging oak door heading into the kitchens stand opposite one another.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: A dry warm breeze moves over the wall's edge, bringing with it the faint stench of rotting flesh.  A flight of flat stone stairs descends down the side, leading to a cracked sprawl of land and Barret's Gorge to the north.

title: [Barret's Gorge, The Sprawl]
description: A huge flight of flat stone stairs ascends up to the top of the crumbling ramparts of the fabled Demonwall.  The wall itself stretches far and wide to both the east and west, each section disappearing further than the eye can see.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Receiving Room]
description: A set of broad mosaic stone steps sweeps down into the airy enclave which reaches exceedingly low depths.  Positioned directly at the bottom of the stairs, a sunny flaxen carpet leads to a great haon receiving hall table lined with backless silk-tufted chairs.  An intricate celestial marquetry composes the majority of the vast flooring, balancing with the smoothly carved pale limestone walls.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Polished cobblestones of the var glisten as the sunlight strikes their surfaces.  A thanot-beamed enclave stands to one side of the road, its silvery blue stone shimmering in the heat of the day.  To the other side, a tall, stone palisade encircles a secluded compound.  Flowering greenery grows about a crystal lantern that hangs from an ornately carved alabaster post.

title: [Fogardruh's Wagon]
description: The combined smells of oil, steam, and molten metal assault the senses, and the distinct sound of a hammer on anvil resounds from beyond a wrought invar door located near the back wall of this dimly lit sales floor.  Racks filled with merchandise are attended to by a pair of young dwarven clerks dressed in blacksmith's garb.  Opposite the invar door, a forged glaes ramp leads out.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: An algal mat covers the stretch of water just next to the shore, and further out, the water moves quickly, shifting and swirling, as the barely-there current carries it in a southwesterly direction.  Although clusters of cypress are visible further north, few trees are present here, the foliage instead dominated by wild brush.

title: [A Bone to Pick]
description: Gritty limestone steps descend into this ancient mausoleum, where the floor is scattered with a variety of bones; some human, others not.  Near an alcove shelf, some pitted brass hooks are suspended from a far, nearly intact wall, rising adjacent to a dark tunnel leading to the north and deeper within.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Seven Hexes]
description: A huge collection of charms and fetishes dangles from the bald cypress branches overhanging this spot.  Pale mist covers the shoreline, disappearing abruptly at the water's edge.  Lily pads cover the surface, their petals overlapping each other, their blossoms a pale purple color that is especially vivid in the dank surroundings.

title: [Sunken Mausoleum, Undercroft]
description: Torches, each lit with a dark violet flame, are affixed upon the granite walls.  Standing in the center of the undercroft is a limestone sarcophagus, which is surrounded by piles of rubble.  The smell of dried blood wafts throughout the tomb, becoming more potent toward the tunnel.  Along the northern wall, a twisting granite staircase leads up toward the surface.

title: [Sunken Mausoleam, Dead End]
[Sunken Mausoleum, Dead End]
description: Along the walls, a group of ebonwood coffins has been plundered, leaving only some skeletal remains.  The circular room is a dead end, and the only exit is the flight of steps leading back toward the front.  A rusted iron plaque, its surface barely legible, is hammered into the granite wall.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: Grey, time-worn limestone walls provide a grim atmosphere to this wide hallway.  The high ceiling and thick layer of pale silt covering the floor provide hints that the passage may once have boasted a smooth, plaster veneer.

title: [Within the Snake]
description: Although carved from solid limestone, the walls, floor, and ceiling at the eastern end of the passage resemble the soft curves of the inside of a serpent's mouth.  A pair of crimson fangs curving up from the floor are visible just beyond the archway that forms the gaping maw.

title: [The Loot Cellar]
description: A set of glaes-paned lanterns are hung from the rafters of the pavilion overhead.  The room is hollowed out from a nest of gnarled cypress roots.  A dusting of pale green moss covers the ground.  At the northern end of the room is a plank ladder leading to a reinforced modwir trapdoor.

title: [Holly, Wood, And Vine]
description: Beams of white and red oak arch overhead forming the roof of this octahedral pavilion.  Large panels of gold and silver cotton are hung from the wooden framework, enclosing the space within the structure.  Garlands of holly and liana vine dangle from the oaken beams above and drape over a birch arch.  A carpet of pale green moss covers the floor of the pavilion.

title: [Fitzwobbin's, Inside the Beast]
description: Numerous pipes run in a confusing pattern over the walls and ceiling into a large iron box at the rear fo the chamber.  Two gears attached to the wagon's axles appear to be easily engaged with a nearby lever.  A small space in the center of the room serves as an obvious work area.

title: [Fitzwobbin's Figures, Show Room]
description: Some steel racks line the interior walls of the wagon, leaving little space for anything else.  Small wooden cabinets support a fold out countertop against the back wall, while a few iron rungs lead upwards to a circular steel hatch in the ceiling near the wagon's front.

title: [Basement, Cells]
description: A row of three iron-barred cells, one next to the other, line the western wall.  Across from the cells is a table holding a whip and a few scattered shackles.  Dark spots on the cold stone floor appear to be smears of dried blood.  Faint light spills into the area from the top of a narrow staircase.

title: [Li'aerion, Kitchens]
description: Polished white stone countertops laden with copper cookware are fitted along three sides of this room.  A wide copper vent extends from the ceiling, ending above a large fire pit and roasting spit.  Above the counters are shelves neatly filled with silver and gold serving trays, tea sets, plates, and goblets.  The center of the fourth wall is occupied by a small oak door, flanked on either side by wooden hooks hung with heavy linen aprons.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Cave, Upper Landing]
description: The upward slope of the cave evens out here to create a stable, if somewhat narrow, landing.  Light from a guttering torch affixed to the wall shows a dark tunnel leading out.  A pair of iron spikes secure the top loops of a thick rope ladder with leather ties, which leads back to the lower portion of the cave.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is very dark inside this tunnel.  The floor continues to rise as loose bits of rock crunch underfoot.

title: [Lockit A Lot]
description: Decorated with colorful feathers and charms that dangle from the ceiling, the shop space is cheery and bright.  Unnaturally bright light blazes from a series of candles, the smoke wafting from them imparting the scent of lavender into the air.  A single loom spans the a large portion of the space, its length hung with lockets rather than the results of weaving.  Past the loom, a small, diamond-shaped hatch is nearly hidden by an extravagant drape of cotton streamers.

title: [Lockit A Lot, Living Quarters]
description: Vibrant blue paint covers the floor, while yellow paint splashes across the walls.  Feathers hang from above, interspersed with charms of all shapes and sizes.  Covered in a massive quilt, a tiny bed takes up one corner of the room, across from a large worktable scattered with jewelry-making tools and various melted-down candles.

title: [A Frayed Knot]
description: Planks of knotted driftwood have been carelessly nailed together, forming an uneven flooring that makes it difficult to maintain your balance.  Rusted nail heads have bled a brownish red color into the planks, giving the appearance of a long-ago battleground.  A large sail painted with obscure markings hangs on the back wall, and a variety of wares clutter the room, filling both the sturdy netting that hangs from the ceiling and the haphazardly stacked chests and trunks.

title: [A Frayed Knot, Back Room]
description: A noticeable contrast to the front room, the walls and ceiling are planked with care, thick oak muffling every sound.  A pair of sputtering torches illuminates the area and casts dappled shadows across the room, while clothing hanging from a metal block and tackle sways with the gentle rocking of the ship.  A driftwood display with a trio of mounted fish hangs on the wall above a gigantic oyster, its upper shell stuck open.

title: [Naval A Salt]
description: A salt-stained rugs runs the length of the wagon, covering the warped wooden boards that comprise the floor.  A warped teak rack hangs along one wall, while a varnished oak table runs the length of the opposite wall.  A tarnished brass hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Naval A Salt, Storeroom]
description: Boxes and crates are stacked all along the walls of this storage area, taking up most of the space of this small room.   The rear corner remains empty, except for a short padded cot and a cushion-covered bench sitting next to each other.  An old bronze lamp hangs low on the wall just above the cot.

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: While wider and slower to the north, here the Mistydeep River gathers itself to squeeze between steep, narrowing banks.  Gaining speed in its southward passage, the water surges over hundreds of rocky cascades.  Small pools eddy deceptively before overflowing into churning rapids.  Safe on the trunk of a fallen tree, a pudgy raccoon grasps some unknown morsel in its paws, dunking it daintily in the water between bites.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The Mistydeep seems particularly dark and deep at this point, its clear, cold waters flowing quickly by a few large boulders.  The shadowy forms of a few large fish making their way upstream are outlined against the sand below.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, northwest, up
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Wild geese congregate midstream, honking noisily at anyone or anything that comes near.  Upstream, a tree-covered isle parts the waters, its lush shore creating a haven for fish and small animals.  To the east, a wide game trail leads from the riverbank into the untamed weald.  Rustling brush is accompanied by a quick glimpse of something brown, though it moved far too quickly to identify with surety.  Across the river, the shore bends gently south, with boulders of varying size extending into the water.

Small bubbles break the surface of the water as fish come to the surface to feed.  Upstream, a tree-covered isle parts the waters, its lush shore creating a haven for fish and small animals.  To the east, a wide game trail leads from the riverbank into the untamed weald. Across the river, the shore bends gently south, with boulders of varying size extending into the water.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Massive boulders of dusky granite lie scattered like children's blocks along the bottom.  Deeply buried in the sand to the south, the boulders rise successively higher to the northwest, finally breaking the water's surface overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, up
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Parlour]
description: Ivory crown molding joins cream-hued walls and the soaring vaulted ceiling.   An arched oak door stands to the side of a black marble fireplace, which is nestled into the western wall and has an ivy-etched mirror centered above it.  Facing the hearth is a plush floral-patterned couch framed by a set of petite lor end tables.  The northern wall boasts a series of floor-to-ceiling windows that look out onto the moonlit garden, broken only by a pair of multi-paned glass doors.  Along the eastern wall is a polished lor arch leading into the dining area.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Library]
description: Well-oiled dark oak paneled bookcases form the walls of the spacious two story room.  Segmented floor-to-ceiling windows along the north wall provide a breathtaking view of the moonlit gardens.  The polished stained oak floor adds a stark contrast to the warm ivory rug, centered with an intricately carved ash table.  Several two-toned ivory and beige couches provide comfortable seating around a carved ivory limestone fireplace, which is centered along the western wall.  A spiral staircase leads up to the second floor walkway, providing access to the books above.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This dark, cavernous room smells like a slaughterhouse.  Bodies in varying states of extended decomposition, from mummies to bare bones, litter the floor.  A dim light comes from a pot set high on the wall.  There is a dark hole in the wall here, which seems to lead upwards while gloomy passages lead away in three directions.

title: [Torture Chamber]
description: Gruesome instruments of torture fill this room, although most are now broken beyond repair.  The dampness of the castle walls here has promoted the growth of several molds, and a dank, musty smell hangs about the room.  The vague stench of death wafts up from cracks surrounding a trap door in the floor, filling you with dread.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: A pair of oversized greatswords hang above a set of stone steps, leading up into the arena seating, the corridor lined with iron sconces that provide flickering light.  Other weapons of a wide variety are mounted to the back wall, serving as ominous decor.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Scrip Shop]
description: Luminescent green moss lines the slick stone walls of this small chamber and provides adequate lighting despite a lack of windows or candles.  Thin pathways between various sized containers and tables impede navigation to a beaded curtain.

Luminescent green moss lines the slick stone walls of this small chamber and provides adequate lighting despite a lack of windows or candles.  Thin pathways between various sized containers and tables impede navigation.

title: [Baile Dragan, Courtyard]
description: In the center of the courtyard a white tower rises skyward, light flickering in the windows.  Mossy pathways meander among the quiet oak trees leading from door to door in the circular structure that encloses the area.  A small pond, its surface dotted with floating candles, is nestled near some flower patches.  Living sapling benches, formed by intertwining branches near a stone shrine, offer places to sit and enjoy the night air.  Somewhere nearby an owl hoots his nighttime refrain.

title: [Baile Dragan, Triskelion Hall]
description: This large, open room is filled with successively higher rows of polished ebonwood benches, supported at each end by heavy, dragon-shaped legs of cast silver.  The walls are hung with magnificent tapestries worked in silver thread on a black background.  Each life-sized panel depicts a scene of a mortal and a dragon in some sort of interaction.  At the front of the room is a large dais, behind which the Ord an Dragan standard is displayed.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Platforms at varying heights reside in the branches of the great banyan tree, their surfaces well worn with years of travel.  The branches continue upward toward the thick, leafy canopy, their leaves blocking out the moonlight.  A series of small glowing blue globes illuminate the area with an eerie light.  Several liana vines dangle down from the higher platforms, adding their sweet floral scents to the air.  Twin rope bridges extend in two directions, offering passage to the west and northwest.

Platforms at varying heights reside in the branches of the great banyan tree, their surfaces well worn with years of travel.  The branches continue upward toward the thick, leafy canopy, their leaves blocking out the sun.  A series of small glowing blue globes illuminate the area with an eerie light.  Several liana vines dangle down from the higher platforms, adding their sweet floral scents to the air.  Twin rope bridges extend in two directions, offering passage to the west and northwest.

title: [Devinely Yours]
description: Gnarled walls of unevenly hewed bark make up this small hole of a space in the banyan's interior.  Despite the cramped quarters, air flows freely through small slats in the wood, bringing with it the scents and sounds of the jungle.  Small dewdrop-shaped lanterns of glass hang from above, illuminating the delicate branch-woven furnishings and vine-wrapped sign.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Wide branches of a beech tree support this sturdy wooden platform.  The only passage away from this area is a woven ladder of natural fibers that hangs down toward the ground far below and a single rope bridge that stretches to a platform to the southwest.  No bridge connects to the nearest platform to the north, though the span seems small enough to jump.  A small gourd attached to the tree collects rain water, and a steady dripping cadence is generated from the water that overflows.

title: [Treasure Hollow]
description: A small, but well organized shop, as everything seems to be neatly organized and in its place.  A large silver chest sits in the far corner, out of the way.  A small glass display case sits in the center of the room, to draw eyes to it and make it the most prominent item in the room.  On the wall opposite the chest is a polished wooden clothes rack from which a selection of items hang.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: The branches of the large teak tree here extend upward, heading into the canopy above.  Several clusters of vines dangle down to ground level from some of them, their thick stems woven together like a natural rope.  An expansive platform of mistwood perches here as well, a pile of rocks sits to one side to use for defense.  Twin rope bridges extend to other platforms in trees nearby to the southeast and the west.

title: [Don't Weave It Behind]
description: The rough interior of the tree's trunk forms the walls of this hollowed out room, and the smooth wood floor is covered with a fine layer of scattered pine needles.  Along the walls some knots of all shapes and sizes have been left protruding and turned into makeshift pegs upon which the various wares hang.  A narrow passage leads further into the interior of the tree.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: The aerial prop roots of a great banyan tree have been used here to suspend several platforms at varying heights, while the main trunk rises even higher into the air.  Deep grooves between the roots offer glimpses of the forest beyond, and some of them contain small offerings like bundles of herbs or dried flowers.  A set of parallel woven ropes extends to the east, affording tremulous travel at this height, while a thin wooden ramp extends to the southwest.

title: [Balmy Blooms]
description: Dusky golden sunlight pours in from an arched glass window that forms nearly the entire back wall of the divided alcove.  Blossoming wildflowers and feathered greenery are softly strewn through the entire space, a few of the wayward blooms gathered in small offerings around a slender blue quartz reliquary.  Grown over with intensely verdant mosses, an ivory sculpture of Imaera and Jaston sits at the center of the room, the opaque planes of their eyes perpetually gazing up towards the sky.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: The aerial prop roots of a great banyan tree have been used here to suspend several platforms at varying heights, while the main trunk rises even higher into the air.  Deep grooves between the roots offer glimpses of the forest beyond, and some of them contain small offerings like bundles of herbs or dried flowers.  A set of parallel woven ropes extends to the east, affording tremulous travel at this height, while a thin wooden ramp extends to the southwest.

Blossoming wildflowers and feathered greenery are softly strewn through the entire space, a few of the wayward blooms gathered in small offerings around a slender blue quartz reliquary.  Grown over with intensely verdant mosses, an ivory sculpture of Imaera and Jaston sits at the center of the room, the opaque planes of their eyes perpetually gazing up towards the sky.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Two ramps meet up with a small platform here, perched in the branches of a beech tree.  Moonlight filters through the leaves, creating a dappled pattern on the rough wood flooring.  Some of the branches rising into the heights seem sturdy enough to climb, and several worn spots on the bark give evidence to that very use.  Globes of rose-colored glass dangle from a few of them, illuminating the dimly lit area with a rosy glow

Some of the branches rising into the heights seem sturdy enough to climb, and several worn spots on the bark give evidence to that very use.  Globes of rose-colored glass dangle from a few of them, illuminating the dimly lit area with a rosy glow.

title: [In Sprite Of It All]
description: Simplistic in design, the interior of the room is lit by strategically placed holes bored into the walls, creating an intricate criss-cross pattern as sunlight streams through their small openings.  Yellow-tinged wood, splotched with pale green lichen clusters, adds a natural decorative adornment that compliments the mottled brown tones dominating the room.  An elaborate wing design has been burned into a thin wooden board, the piece hanging over an oversized trunk fashioned from rough-hewn beech.

title: [Oreina's Treetop]
description: A patchwork covering is perched precariously overhead, made of a myriad scraps of fabric and strung between branches with bits of twine.  The excess is left to fall in great swathes to enclose the round platform nestled in the cradle of several large branches, and miniscule tears and openings in the fabric allow in thin shafts of pale moonlight.  Smaller limbs and branches encircle the platform, while a narrow rope bridge leads deeper into the tree's canopy.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Travel to the next platform is blocked by an open space, and the single woven rope bridge that heads to the northwest seems to end at this platform.  The view straight down is obscured by many crisscrossing branches of the rosewood trees that grow in a cluster below, their bodies so intertwined as to almost form one giant tree.  The faint scent of wood smoke lingers in the air, and the gentle rustle of leaves is the only sound.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Hidden Room]
description: Surrounded by earthen walls, this secret underground room smells of dirt and moisture, the air laden with dust and miniscule falling particles.  The only furnishings consist of a low bench and a large wooden chest with a broken lock.   Several candelabra have been stuck in the dirt walls, the candles casting their dancing light on the room, not quite eliminating the shadows at the edges.  Several wooden boards are set into one wall, creating a ladder of sorts.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Fire and Ice]
description: An open window takes up the majority of the back wall, allowing ample moonlight as well as errant breezes to enter the room.  At opposing corners of the opening, a deep brawling bin and a ranged weapons crate rest against the amethyst silk wall.  In the center of the floor, an edged weapons rack displays additional wares, while a hanging wooden sign resides above.  Opposite the window, a silver-beaded curtain hangs in a doorway, the tiny silver orbs clicking together when disturbed by the wind.

Opposite the window, a silver-beaded curtain hangs in a doorway, the tiny silver orbs clicking together when disturbed by the wind.

title: [Cooper's, Secret Room]
description: This cool and pleasant room brings a calm smile to your lips.  It bears the clean, comforting scent of freshly worked wood, and the floor is covered with shavings of modwir, cedar, oak.  The walls are formed of long, vertical planks, fastened with pegs to the substructure and joined in a dovetailed, almost seamless fashion.  Great care and skill has gone into making this simple storage space.
a.location: Pan's Place, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cooper's Shop, Workshop]
description: The crunch of wood shavings underfoot and the tangy scent of newly cut lumber indicate barrels are fitted and joined in this open workshop.  Mallets, chisels and hammers are neatly arranged in a tool chest on the floor.  Kegs in various states of completion surround you.

title: [Siren's Wood, River Walk]
description: A short wooden bridge arches over a burbling creek, joining the sections of the trail on either side.  Hostas and lush ferns grow along both sides of the bank, and various flowers in full bloom grow along the edge of this small clearing.  Brightly-colored butterflies and fat bees momentarily alight on the blossoms.  Swinging from an ironwork post is a glaesine lantern.

title: [It's Fitting]
description: Swathes of gossamer in varying colors hang from the center of the ceiling and are secured to the walls just above the midline, creating a festive tent-like atmosphere.  Several mannequins line one wall, each holding an article of unfinished clothing that is held together with more pins than stitches.  A thick, deep blue carpet covers the floor, and a steel pole is horizontally attached to the rear wall by a series of sturdy brackets.

title: [Siren's Wood, Wyvern]
description: A tall standard atop a stout metal pole has been pitched beneath a great thanot tree, its silken banner shifting and sighing in the day's gentle breeze.  Ferns and pale lavender phlox surround the base of the pole, and fragrant wild thyme has grown across the path, providing a lush green carpet underfoot.  A glaesine lantern mounted upon an ironwork post stands near a carved marble bench.

title: [Boots on the Ground]
description: The well-kept wagon is outfitted with a built-in cedar and oak rack that runs the length of the entire back wall.  Two cheery arrangements of feathery yellow-dotted fennel and goldenrod stalks flank a hammered copper mantle on the opposite side of the room.

title: [Protect and Serve]
description: A crimson and gold wool rug, woven with the image of a fortress, stretches across the floor of the wagon.  A low wooden bunk over a wooden drawer with a gear for a handle is built into the rear of the wagon, reinforced with two thick steel chains that secure it to the wall.  Brightly colored tapestries line the walls above neatly organized workspaces that hold bits of leather, assorted metal rings and plates, and other materials used in armor manufacturing.  Nearly hidden behind a diminutive armoire inlaid with copper sprockets is a small wooden hatch that leads outside.

title: [Protect and Serve, Wagon Yard]
description: A gold-striped crimson canvas awning, supported by a pair of thin steel poles, stretches from the roof of the wagon, bathing the thick grass in cool shadow.  Several wooden crates are stacked to one side of a small wooden hatch.  At the edge of the yard stands a tiny portable forge with an iron anvil and a low worktable nearby.

title: [Coliseum, Southwest Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of steel-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a forest green banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick indigo thread.  An indigo banner over a forest green arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant azure embroidery.

title: [Amphitheater of Kings]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Coliseum, Southeast Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of steel-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a golden banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick ebon thread.  An ebon banner over a golden arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant golden embroidery.

title: [Amphitheater of the Fallen]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Coliseum, Northeast Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of iron-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a deep azure banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick flaxen thread.  A flaxen banner over an azure arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant azure embroidery.

title: [Amphitheater of the Arkati]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [The Mage Dahcre Chamber]
description: High and airy, this elegant room seems designed for comfort and relaxation.  Several large cushions of the softest silk lie scattered before a white marble fireplace, above which is set a silver looking-glass framed by carvings of woodland sprites.  The carved sprites continue their frolic on a low bar to one side, which is flanked by twin blue and scarlet banners.  A moonglae opal medallion set above the entry arch glimmers in the light.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Cavern, Ritual Room]
description: The despanal-inlaid summoning circle dominates the center of the cavern.  Mottled veins of liquescent crimson stone bleed outward from the edges of the circle and snake toward the ceiling along the pale cavern walls.  Slick with condensation, hoary clumps of glowing lichen cast a murky green glow throughout the chamber.

The despanal-inlaid summoning circle dominates the center of the cavern.  Mottled veins of liquescent crimson stone bleed outward from the edges of the circle and snake toward the ceiling along the pale cavern walls.  The ophidian breaks in the rocks are continued through the side of the cave, where a small stream enters and exits the chamber with a subdued rushing sound that echoes off a small dock.  Slick with condensation, hoary clumps of glowing lichen cast a murky green glow throughout the chamber.

title: [Faendryl Enclave, Courtyard]
description: Symmetrical rows of lor trees stand as silver sentinels along a gravel pathway that broadens into a circular courtyard.  In the center of the yard, a pair of trees have grown together into a single towering tree, echoing the lofty reach of the alabaster spire rising to their north.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Sanctuary]
description: A towering sculpture in the likeness of Luukos dominates the sanctuary -- crafted from viridian marble, time has worn its way through the rock, causing severe damage.  Much of its left arm and shoulder lie strewn across the northern wall, entirely blocking off an archway.  Underneath the wreckage, a partially collapsed tunnel has been exposed.  A narrow chasm can be seen off to the west of an iron-hinged ebonwood door.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: The unstable walls have buckled in several places, depositing large chunks of stone along the path and nearly blocking the way ahead.  Mounds of dirt and rubble cause the route through the tunnel to be more circuitous in order to avoid possibly creating a cave in.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Surrounding the southern end of the dock is a graveyard of modwir gondolas, which juts out into the murky dark water of the underground lake.  Incandescent moss lines the opening of a narrow rocky fissure.

title: [Necropolis, Abysm]
description: The scent of sulphur intoxicates the area, the fumes so thick they feel heavy on the air.  The cramped space is engulfed in darkness, and there is barely enough room to crawl up through the narrow tunnel.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: The passageway widens to the west, where rows of columns are visible to the north and south, supporting the ceiling as it rises dramatically.  Ornately carved balustrades bracket the processional route which continues westward toward a massive, golden sandstone altar raised high on a dais.  To the east, the walls and ceiling close in rapidly, the passage shrinking to enter a dimly lit tunnel.

title: [The Gullet]
description: Carnelian-lensed lanterns flood the passage with the color of blood and serve to draw the walls inward.  Combined with the pale ribs and alternating expanses of smooth, wetly gleaming walls between them, the sense of being within the throat of a serpent is inescapable.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Under the Floor]
description: Cramped and dimly lit, this small area is contained by lichen-covered stone walls and a swept dirt floor.  A hefty, dull black metal safe stands open across from a rickety wooden desk next to a set of steep stairs.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Back of Counter]
description: Empty plates and cups, most of them clean, are stacked on shelves beneath the counter.  Neatly labeled boxes and sacks of supplies are arranged on a wooden rack at the far end of the counter.  A bowl of milk, a blanket-filled wicker basket and a tangled ball of yarn occupy the farthest corner.

title: [Wounded for Wear, Foyer]
description: The floor is covered in a plush crimson carpet with a series of black stripes, and the walls of the shop are painted black, with splotches of red paint on them.  Nestled into the wall is a small dark hole that leads back to the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: The brackish water flows past the shoreline so slowly that floating debris makes nearly imperceptible progress.  A swath of flattened reeds and grasses leads from the water's edge to a raised berm of debris.  Remnants of a single broken eggshell are all that mark this as a now abandoned empty nest.

The brackish water flows past the shoreline so slowly that floating debris makes nearly imperceptible progress.  A swath of flattened reeds and grasses leads from the water's edge to a raised berm of debris.  Nestled just to the side of the detritus, a weathered plank footbridge leads over a narrow span of water.  Remnants of a single broken eggshell are all that mark this as a now abandoned empty nest.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black Lake]
description: This stretch of the lake spans from the cavern shore to a large block of limestone floating atop the water's surface.  Though it appears murky and dark, the lake's water is strangely silky, like a mixture of oil and satin that moves of its own accord against your skin.  Small bubbles float up from the depths, creating a burbling sound that disturbs the otherwise placid.  Opposite where the water swirls down into a churning river, the lake streches out into darkness.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Stalagmites jut out of the ground, paired with stalactites that splay out from the ceiling.  The water-glazed formations are arranged in arcing rows, lending the appearance of multiple gaping maws spread across the distance between a doorway and a vast, murky lake.  Small pools of clear water reflect the sputtering flames of torches that send shadows scurrying about in their flaring, haphazard light.  Below a gaping hole at the southern edge of the lake, the water gathers into a churning river.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Geyser]
description: The temperature in this area is much cooler than the previous cavern, and dampness coats everything in the reach of a slick opening in the ground.  An opening in the ceiling appears to be a pathway out.  Adjacent a gaping hole in the wall, a massive rockslide blocks passage to the northeast.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black River]
description: Water rushes all around you, swiriling and splashing black liquid to and fro.  The current is particularly strong on the side nearest the open space of the cavern, visibly creating eddies that look as if they might suck you under.  The middle of the river, however, allows you to stay afloat and fight, though not easily, being pulled further downstream.  Opposite the slick rock ledge leading into the cavern, a rockslide rife with boulders and rocks of all sizes leads up to a massive hole in the wall.

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: The spacious and airy chamber is carpeted in soft coyote hide, and oil lamps set between the doors on all four walls provide a gentle illumination.  Tapestries and large paintings cover the walls between the doors and windows.  Stairs carved from one of the tree's branches lead down, and a nearby ladder leads up.

title: [Ranger Guild, Office]
description: The small office is cozy and filled with maps and furnishing, but immaculately tidy.  Directly across the room from the door stands a large monir desk with papers, scrolls and various implements and ornaments all arranged neatly on its top.  A large fireplace dominates the wall to the right, the fire burning within providing plenty of light.  The walls are covered with maps, some depicting strange and faraway places, others very familiar areas.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cavern]
description: Stalagmites and stalactites are sporadically spaced within this large cavern.  Light illuminates the passageway to the northwest, casting long shadows on the ground from the various rock formations.  Patches of luminescent moss create tiny glowing points on the ceiling.

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnels]
description: Tunnels branch off in every direction.  Tiny, white-flecked fungi grow in clusters along the rocky floor.  Heavy footsteps echo from somewhere deeper in the underground network.

Several small puddles reflect the light of the resident phosphorescent moss.  Water occasionally drops from the ceiling, landing with an audible *plop*.  The air is slightly stagnant throughout the area.
Part of the wall has been chipped away at, an apparent attempt at creating yet another tunnel.  Slender stalactites hang low, covered with glowing, mottled green-blue moss.

A faint scent of salt clings to the air, a result of the natural deposits in the rock and dripping water.  Grooves in the floor, obscured by the darkness, create a hazard for those wandering these tunnels.
Diffuse light emanates from the bluish-green moss thriving within the confines of the tunnels.  Roughly scrawled upon the rocky walls are several arrows, each pointing to a different passageway.
Snaking paths have been cleared through the rock, crisscrossing at this juncture.  A faint coat of slime covers several of the rocks here.
Clusters of reddish crystals sparkle among the rocky walls.  Several of the stalagmites have had their tops hewn off, with the rubble strewn across the uneven floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: Deep furrows in the silvery bark of the massive oak tree wind their way along its trunk, forming strange, intertwined patterns upon the surface of the ancient tree.  Large roots sprawl along the ground, their bark riddled with a faint sheen of moss.  The rest of the area is covered in pale green grass, the tiny blades waving in the breeze slowly.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: Long tendrils of hanging moss drape from the higher branches of the massive oak tree, deep silvery specks hiding within their soft recesses.  Blades of long grass rustle underfoot, their diminutive green forms complemented by random patches of wildflowers and colorful weeds of every type.  Several roots rise high into the air here, allowing one to sit and gaze upon the scenery.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.
