title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: A tiny stream flows through the forest of roots from the massive oak tree, the glimmering waters forming a small pool amid a circle of grey rocks.  Small wildflowers grow in between the gaps of the rocks, and the deep blackness of the pool is broken only by the faint ripples of the stream from above.  The hanging moss is particularly thick here, providing an intimate, tranquil atmosphere.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: The overhanging moss and drooping tree branches of the massive oak tree thin out a bit, allowing one to gaze down over the surroundings from atop the large hill.  Forests spread for miles beyond a small meadow at the base of the hill, and the landscape is dotted with clusters of wildflowers of every hue imaginable.  A few weathered grey stones peek out from the earth, offering up a pleasant place to sit and admire the view.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape. title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: A tangle of massive roots winds its way along the ground here, providing a shady haven speckled with spots of refreshing sun.  The area is a veritable garden -- flowers of every hue and type grow from the moss-laden ground, their florid hues set upon a backdrop of drab grey-greens of the large tree.  The girth of the tree provides a natural fence for the plants, their forms curving around the vivid petals in a gentle embrace.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: The gnarled bark of the massive oak is quite visible here, its huge boles and knots covered with a faint green coating of soft moss.  A variety of hanging moss has also made its home upon the trees branches, the tendrils of darker green swaying gently in the breeze.  Leaves litter the ground, their mottled brown hue mingling with the lush verdant surroundings.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, Foyer]
description: Modwir posts and beams are a darker accent to the white oak walls of this open room.  An undyed wool rug covers the sanded floorboards and benches of pine, teak, and modwir, elegant in their simplicity, rest near the door.  The clink of glasses issues from beyond the swinging doors to the west.

title: [Ranger Guild, Front Porch]
description: Plain cotton cushions cover the sanded maoral planks in lieu of chairs.  Wind chimes of wood and beaten brass turn in the breeze and add their gentle harmony to the atonal, yet tranquil music of nature.  To your south, the pavilion rises above the treetops, its banners brilliant against the cloudless sky.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Ingress]
description: Crystallized trails of water line the sheer face of a stone hill enclosed by the town walls, glinting brightly above the heads of a pair of dark stone statues.  The cobbles of the road grow fewer as it approaches the yawning mouth of a burrow in the hillside, giving way to the crags of a stone floor several paces within.  Natural light manages little better before it is supplemented by the merry crackle of torches fed by pine pitch, the smell of which lingers on the wintry air.

Crystallized trails of water line the natural stone walls of the ingress.  Placed on either side of the barrier are a series of carved runes paired with rhimar sigils.  A shallow trough runs the length of the walls, cracked and barren of fluids.  Carved black marble stones create a curving path heading north, alternating with white marble inlays.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Plaza]
[Ancient Burrow, Nexus]
description: Veins of natural minerals glitter in the torchlight illuminating the stone walls of the burrow.  Despite the torches' scant heat, immense icicles jut from the high ceiling, ornately carved into fanciful sculptures of sea beasts, including whales and sleek sharks.  A raised plaza sprawls at the lowest portion of the burrow's floor, the dark flagstones spiraling outward from a black marble statue.  A stained pine bench faces the monument, an old oaken tun at its side.

Cobblestones spiral outwards from a dark faceless statue in the center of the nexus.  Veins of assorted natural minerals glitter beneath the cavernous burrow's artificial glow.  Carved twice the height as the rest of the burrow, the ceiling is decorated with several suspended ice sculptures.  A carved ice bench sits facing the statue, with a rhimar-bound barrel next to it.

title: [Ancient Keep, Office]
description: Long, twisting veins of mithril and rhimar entwine around each other across the circular room's ceiling.  Several rectangular cubbyholes line the walls, each containing an intricately carved ice sculpture within.  Presiding over the center of the office is a large mahogany chair cushioned with rich leather, with an elegant mahogany desk behind it.  Framed with etched rhimar, an oak-bound door leads back out.

title: [Ancient Keep, Foyer]
description: Circular in shape, the floor is completely made from square-cut sections of black marble.  Large, blackened marble pillars line the walls, ending with a domed glass ceiling high overhead.  A narrow gap on the far side of the room leads to a sweeping stairwell with a mithglin-plated door beneath it.

title: [Rone Academy, Cleric's Vestry]
description: Marble flagstones separate walls lined with cabinets filled with vestments and shelves lined with prayer books, while a sky-lit cathedral ceiling provides excellent acoustics for the practice of liturgy and chant.  In the exact center of the room is a podium supporting a large volume.  Along one wall is a set of material-laden shelves and a fel prie-dieu.

title: [Rone Academy, Cathedral]
description: Moonlight floats down through tall, stained-glass windows from the gabled ceiling of the Cathedral.  Elevated by a two-step platform, the altar is located in the middle of the rectangular cathedral and circled by wooden chairs padded with soft material for comfort.  The cream colored marble floor shines as if newly polished.  To the right of the altar is the ambo, where sacred scrolls are placed.

Sunlight streams through tall, stained-glass windows from the gabled ceiling of the cathedral.  Elevated by a two-step platform, the altar is located in the middle of the rectangular cathedral and circled by wooden chairs padded with soft material for comfort.  The cream colored marble floor shines as if newly polished.  To the right of the altar is the ambo, where sacred scrolls are placed.

title: [Sacred Grove]
description: The branches here have been trained to grow upward and inward, creating a living steeple of limbs and leaves.  In a zig-zag pattern beneath the peak, strings of spherical white paper lanterns dangle, though they are little more than decoration as dappled sunlight spills through the canopy.  A flat, woven basket of vines sits in the cradle of three limbs, and a pair of shelves are formed by densely braided branches.

The branches here have been trained to grow upward and inward, creating a living steeple of limbs and leaves.  In a zig-zag pattern beneath the peak, strings of spherical white paper lanterns dangle, filling the space with an abundance of warm, golden light.  A flat, woven basket of vines sits in the cradle of three limbs, and a pair of shelves are formed by densely braided branches.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Travel to the next platform is blocked by an open space, and the single woven rope bridge that heads to the northwest seems to end at this platform.  The view straight down is obscured by many crisscrossing branches of the rosewood trees that grow in a cluster below, their bodies so intertwined as to almost form one giant tree.  The faint scent of wood smoke lingers in the air, and the gentle rustle of leaves is the only sound.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Foyer]
description: Scenes detailing the history of the Black Wolves Clan are proudly portrayed in magnificent oil paintings that line the walls.  The center of the ceiling houses a rounded crimson skylight that bears the silhouette of a howling wolf.  Moonlight penetrates the translucent image, casting the Black Wolves seal faintly onto the white marble floor below.  Bronze lanterns hang in pairs down the wide hallway, and a few armchairs have been arranged around a small table.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Back Yard]
description: Tiny motes of light flash aimlessly as fireflies gather about the landscape.  Two lofty trees stand on either side of the lawn as they guard over a freshwater pond between them.  An ancient ironwood prevails in the eastern half, while a stately haon tree spreads its boughs across the lawn's western side.  A stone path wanders through the yard, curving alongside a large fallen branch under the ironwood, before it reaches a low dock jutting over the pond.

title: [The Oubliette]
description: Dust motes dance in a beam of light that illuminates the seal of the Black Wolves which is set in the center of the rough stone floor.  The faint crackle of magic hovers over a tangle of broken weapons and shattered armor next to a long table placed under some low-hanging shelves.  A painted mural depicting a flight of dragons soaring through a twilight sky climbs the granite walls of the circular chamber, ending at an iron grate set high above.

title: [Defender Hall, Auditorium]
description: Directly across from the entryway stands a prominent rounded dais set off by an elegant tapestry on the wall behind it.  Ebonwood benches are staggered downwards to the dais curving in a semi-circle to provide a clear view of the speakers.  Trails of crimson carpet line the steps and aisles of a pale grey marble floor, granting quiet and safe travel through the auditorium.  Brushed silver oil lamps encircle the room and reflect their light off the thick glass panels that arch up to form a high domed ceiling.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: The gnarled rope has been knotted around a thick iron spike sticking out of a hole in the tree.  Little rays of moonlight that have managed to sneak past the thick green leaves that cover every branch spray down upon the tree, providing illumination to the hole.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: Though the moonlight provides illumination at the opening of this hole, as you climb up some wooden pegs visibility diminishes until it is completely dark.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Salt, rust, and grime cover most of the portside wall's solitary porthole, although one spot has been smudged to relative cleanness to allow a small band of light to filter into the dusty companionway.  Rags litter the deck just beneath the porthole, some blackened with tar that has hardened to thumb-sized nodules.
a.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Great Western Sea]
description: The icy, dark blue water of the Northern Waves stretches out around you in every direction.  Rippling waves, some topped with whitecaps, chop up the surface and make it difficult for you to tread water.  The triple masts of the krolvin warship tower over the much smaller schooner.  You notice that a ladder extends down from the schooner's deck to the east.
b.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Black River, Pool]
description: Gently swirling through the water, the current here is subtle, the river spreading its fingers out into a relatively calm pool before picking up speed at the far end, where it seemingly disappears into a black void.  Suffusing shifting areas of the otherwise inky black water, a glowing grate and the dim, undulating luminesence of tiny black, sinuous shapes swarming around in the water illuminates your immediate vicinity.  A small ledge juts out from slick walls rising up in every direction.

title: [Black River, Ledge]
description: Jutting out of one of the slick earthen walls and over the inky black pool of water, the spacious ledge sits at a slight angle.  Small cracks in the wall splinter in such a way as to create several natural niches.  The sounds of dripping water and the occasional whistling of gusts of wind mix unrythmically with the flow of the river water.

title: [Underground Tunnels, Rubble]
description: The surrounding rubble is damp, with little pools of water scattered between and atop various boulders and clusters of rocks, as well as a spattering of dead fish.  Trickles of black water cascade down from above, sourced from the almost invisible flow of a water snaking into a volomnious black void overhead.  Abutting where the water above ostensibly falls in heavy sheets when the void is not present, the wall has eroded away, leaving an opening where the rock has fallen in on itself and now provides egress.

Pounding down from above, a rapidly rushing waterfall falls in heavy sheets, creating a shin-deep turbulent pool of water, large boulders and clusters of rock jutting from below the surface.  Before continuing on its way downstream in a miniature flood, the inky black water fades in color and visual texture to the normalized murk of the Locksmehr River.

title: [Black River, Ledge]
description: Jutting out of one of the slick earthen walls and over the inky black pool of water, the spacious ledge sits at a slight angle.  Small cracks in the wall splinter in such a way as to create several natural niches.  The sounds of dripping water and the occasional whistling of gusts of wind mix unrythmically with the flow of the river water.

title: [Lich's Landing, Specter Lane]
description: A small well rises up from the broken and uneven cobblestone, and a trio of decaying goblin zombies stand around it.  Blood oozes up out of the brick-lined well and the zombies cup their hands, eagerly drinking the crimson fluid.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Steeped in the pale glow of wisps of light clustering around several low-hanging drapery stalactites, the broad space is peppered with long rows of small dog-tooth stalagmites that pop up from the ground.  The maw-like divisions span between the edge of the cavern and a huge wooden palisade wall.  Settled near the palisade is an unnaturally flat boulder partially encircled by a trio of red velvet couches.  Riddled with the scent of death and decay, the air is crisp and cool.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]
description: A guard tower dominates the side of the road, the dilapidated structure surrounded by a wave of diagonally placed pikes.  Chunks of flesh and leather dangle from several steel spearheads, the bloodstains trailing upwards towards the tower's entrance.  The pungent scent of decay and weapon polish waft outwards from an open slit at the top of the tower.

title: [Reim Settlement, Guard Tower]
description: Racks of steel armor and weapons lay in heaps beneath the slitted windows of the tower, scattered amongst oil-filled rags and other small tools.  The ornamentation of the pieces have been tarnished by hunks of gore splattered across their surfaces, the bloodstains covering the entire room in a curtain of crimson.  An intricate circle of chalk sits centered upon the ground, the circumference leaving a blackened ring radiating out towards the open windows.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]
description: Charred tiles hang precariously from the top of a guard tower, the scale-like adornments flapping slightly with changes in the wind.  The remainder of the structure has been blackened from roof to ground, the darkened stones stained sanguine and caked with chunks of mud.

title: [Reim Settlement, Guard Tower]
description: Flame-licked window slits have been set evenly along the tower walls, leaving black tendrils across the room and towards the open roof.  Broken glass and steel lay scattered across the floor, the large pieces casting odd shadows upon the walls.  Faint scratching sounds echo off the heavy stones, the louder noises muffled by the piles of straw scattered below the windows.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Cesspool]
description: The floor of this putrid pit is quaggy and wet beneath about three feet of liquid sewage.  A few roots stick out from the tall dirt walls, covered in slick sludge.  A wet and rotting rope dangles over the side from above, where a shaft of light descends through a small overhead circle.

title: [Abandoned Building]
description: Not a single piece of furniture is left in this dusty room.  A splintered crate filled with random litter sits against one wall, beneath a cracked and dirty window.  The air holds a foul, musty odor that emanates strongly from the piles of rat droppings located in the shadowy corners.

title: [Sea of Fire, The Hammer]
description: A narrow pathway of sawtoothed stone curves up the base of the gargantuan spire, beginning at a rocky outcropping near the base and rising toward the formation's flaring head.  Although ragged and sharp-edged, the path ascends too evenly to be entirely natural.  It proceeds past colorful swirls on the hammer's face, and these, at least, are certainly not the work of a mortal hand.

title: [Sea of Fire, The Hammer's Base]
description: The true and incredible scope of the hammer-shaped spire of rock is apparent when viewed from the ragged terrain at its base.  It stretches up into the sky, many times the height of a man, as colorful and beauteous as it is deadly.  Lying amidst the jagged stones is a pile of sun-bleached bones, though whether the remains are an offering or merely evidence of an unwary traveler is unclear.

title: [Reim Base Camp]
description: A strong, chilling wind blows through the area, the gusts threatening to flatten a tall canvas tent and a makeshift shop situated along the cliff.  A wooden vault creates a makeshift wall between the other structures, its thick pine planks warped from continuous exposure to the harsh elements.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Wooden Vault]
description: Heavy metal chains enclose a number of warped wooden chests, the rusted lengths pulled taut by several large padlocks.  Crumbling vellum posters tacked onto the structure's support beams display a variety of rates and numbers, material splattered in faded ink and dried blood.  A vault guard stands near a massive golden gong, his eyes scanning the vault and its occupants closely.

title: [Delirium Manor, Workshop Entry]
description: Dimly lit and musty smelling, this area is evidently not intended for guests.  The wide-open space appears to be roughly the size of the manor, but visible areas are neatly sectioned-off, each serving different functional purposes.  A massive chalkboard contains scrawled notes and drawings, most of which are half-erased.

title: [Delirium Manor, Pantry]
description: Set beneath a narrow window, the shelving and racks in this little pantry are similar to any other.  The contents, however, are not.  Front and center is a basket of hands, though it is unclear whether they are real or manufactured.  Propped up heads, turned to face a panelled wall, are spaced across the lowest shelf.  Alongside the peculiar array are fruits, vegetables, and a few sacks of grain.

title: [Delirium Manor, Upstairs]
description: A large, rectangular oil painting, framed in gold-leafed dried noodles, dominates the wall space at the top of the stairs.  Creaky floorboards sound an alert with the passing of each resident or guest.  A long, carpeted hallway extends off to the north and a shorter one leads to the south.

title: [Delirium Manor, Entry Hall]
description: Alternating tiles of black and white marble, though elegant in design, give a whimsical welcome with chalked barefoot footprints marching across every other tile.  Thick arrows scrawled with various words serve as directional guides to other areas, and a grand staircase leads to the manor's upper floors.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Rooftop]
description: Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a silver phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a blue phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: An imposing stone tower stands at the center of the inner courtyard, taking up the majority of the space.  Similar to the build of the rest of the outpost, the windows of the tower are narrow and better designed for arrows and defense than to offer light and a scenic view.  A wing extends from the tower's north side and soldiers continually file northward back and forth from it.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: An imposing stone tower stands at the center of the inner courtyard, taking up the majority of the space.  Similar to the build of the rest of the outpost, the windows of the tower are narrow and better designed for arrows and defense than to offer light and a scenic view.  A wing extends from the tower's north side and soldiers continually file northward back and forth from it.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Feast Hall]
description: A number of tables and chairs are set against the walls of the hall, waiting the next meal or well attended meeting.  At the end of the hallway is a wide stairwell with two Imperial soldiers standing sentry at its base.  Hendoran military banners decorate the stone walls along with flags of defeated enemies, a ragged Nalfein banner among them.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Den]
description: The sound of water flow is loud here, echoing in layers to form a constant ambient rushing noise.  The embers from a long dead fire are scattered across the stone floor, originating from a ring of stones off in one corner.  A rotting bedroll in another corner has been gnawed on by several generations of rats, their feces and bones littering the moldering cloth.  From a niche in the wall, a lone candle illuminates much of the small room, leaving only the tunnel leading out to remain in the shadows.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Tunnel]
description: The passage is almost completely dark, only illuminated by the light from the candles that filters in through the mouth of the tunnel.  A faint trickle of water can be heard from somewhere in the back of the room, the sound reverberating in the small space.  Just within the dim pool of light, a slatted wooden crate rests on its side, its contents threatening to spill out onto the stone floor.

title: [Underground Temple, Excavation]
description: Miniscule snowflakes dance along frigid gusts that blow through the wide fissure.  Deep carvings along frosted walls are partially filled-in with snow and have transformed into magnificent natural bas-relief designs.  Piles of rubble and dirt signify a recent cave-in.

title: [DragonSpine, Cavern Tunnel]
description: The upward path grows exceedingly steep and more dangerous.  Tracks in the icy floor lead downward, indicative of previous travelers who were unsuccessful in attempts to reach the top of the cavern.

title: [DragonSpine, Icy Cliff]
description: A treacherous and impassible cliff, no more than two feet from the mouth of the cave, disappears into a wintery mix of fog and snow.  Eerie howls echo through the mountainous crevices and are unidentifiable whether from wind or some unfriendly foe.  Occasional breaks in the thick veil overhead allow warming rays of light to bleed through, but they are quickly snuffed by the heavy clouds and blinding sheets of falling snow.

title: [DragonSpine, Cavern Tunnel]
description: Despite evidence of a nearby lair, the steep tunnel offers welcomed protection against the brutal assaults from the powerful winds outside.  Preserved tufts of white fur matted with dried blood cling against the cave walls, frozen in time from territorial battles of the past.

title: [Pan's Place, Smuggler's Cavern]
description: The faint scent of sea air suggests the far end of this tunnel opens somewhere along Darkstone Bay, but only someone who knew the path well would brave the branching passageways.  A subterranean waterfall conceals a dogleg turn that widens out into a natural chamber.  Within the vaulted chamber, sealed display cases hold delicate treasures, while gold and silver baubles cover the floor in glittering drifts.  A dip in the floor holds a pool of coins that would be deep enough for swimming if the pit were filled with water.

title: [Pan's Place, Hidden Garden]
description: A constellation of candles in punched metal holders illuminates the narrow garden beside the cooper's shop and the brewery, dappling the grey field stone path and sparkling off the water of a winding stream.  The stream traces the course of the Locksmehr River in miniature, its banks verdant with native rushes and ferns.  A stately oak tree surrounded by a collection of exotic plants stands in the west where Wehnimer's Landing would be on the real river.  To the east, a somnolent buzz points the way to a hidden apiary.

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: A raucous raven call reverberates through the treetops, its point of origin hard to discern.  Directly southeast, a large island splits the flow of the Mistydeep River.  The western branch runs wide, swift, and deep while its other half progresses at a more leisurely pace, skimming small sandy shoals.  On both sides, clear pebbled basins provide hiding places for crafty fish at the river's bottom.  Far above, a dark granite tor rises sharply from the island's heavily-wooded heart.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, northwest, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Several large boulders rising up from the sandy bottom dominate this stretch of the riverbed, rising far enough up to be a hazard to navigation without breaking the surface.  The algae and moss that have taken up residence there serve, in turn, as host to schools of minnows that nibble at their edges with dainty jabs.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, northwest, up
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: To the northwest, a sprinkling of homes can be spotted among the assorted hardwoods, but here, the river glides past patches of pristine wilderness.  The howl of a wolf resounds somewhere in the distance, yet two egrets wading on stilt-like legs at the shore seem unperturbed.  To the south, a large shape looms in the midst of the river.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The channel of the river runs very deep here, the sand at its bottom difficult to see even though the water is remarkably free of sediment.  A flick of motion deep below suggests that some of the larger fish on the river enjoy this benthic solitude.
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Along this stretch, the roots of several trees lie exposed where soil has been eroded by the river.  In the midst of one such root cluster, a turtle floats serenely, only its head and upper shell exposed.  Further along, a large oak tilts precariously out over the water, clinging desperately to its worn away foundation.  Some enterprising individual has taken advantage of the tree's situation by attaching a rope swing to one of the stouter branches.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The deep, clear waters of the Mistydeep filter the bright sunlight into ever-changing ripples along the sand and rocks that line the riverbed.  An eel peers out from its rocky lair, poised to strike at any fish that has the misfortune to pass by.
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Here, the Mistydeep slows its pace as it meanders through a quiet community.  Homes blend in with the surrounding foliage as if part of the forest itself.  Propped in the fork of a tree, a fishing pole leans out over the water, its line and cork float bobbing gaily in the current.  On the other side of the river, a pebbled shoal gives way to a marshy area where dragonflies dart about a tall stand of cattails.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The chilly waters of the Mistydeep run swiftly at this depth, scouring clean the pale sand below.  Dark piscene forms lurk at vision's edge, but they keep their distance, making identification impossible.
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Upper Reaches]
description: The water here is a pleasant dichotomy of quiet stillness and swirling agitation as a row of rocks dams the majority of the river's flow.  A few surging rivulets manage to break free, streaming in to fill this kidney-shaped depression.  A stone shelf beneath the rocky barrier allows those who perch there to experience leisurely water-massages.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, down
a.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The sparking water of the Mistydeep River runs deep, dark, and fast over the clean sand.  Large gneiss boulders provide a refuge from the swift current for smaller denizens of the river, who dart in and out among the grasses that grow there.
b.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Bard Guild, Corridor]
description: The hall stops before a large oak door, with a second almost identical door to the west.  To the east, a flight of steps descends a short distance to a landing below, where a brightly embroidered cloth banner over the doorway reads "Guild Office."

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small, its walls paneled in dark wood that enhances the quiet ambiance.  The scent of aged wood and years of polish hang heavily in the air, paired with a slight tinge of mustiness, the trademark aroma of older buildings.  Other than a small hearth with a carved mantel on the south wall, the chamber's only furnishings are a chair and a music stand with a lyre-shaped top.

title: [Bard Guild, Corridor]
description: The hall stops before a large oak door, with a second almost identical door to the west.  To the east, a flight of steps descends a short distance to a landing below, where a brightly embroidered cloth banner over the doorway reads "Guild Office."

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: The Guild Hall's office is a roomy chamber paneled and furnished in gleaming mahogany.  Bright tones woven into the intricacies of an antique Illistim area rug enliven the dark wood, providing an attractive color contrast.  Where bookshelves filled with manuscripts don't claim the wall space, a number of beautiful lutes are hung from hooks made especially for the purpose, much like paintings would be displayed in other establishments.

title: [Manor House, Sunken Tub]
description: The blue and green mosaic tiles lining the tub are magnified beneath the water and sparkle as rays of silver moonlight pierce the shallow water.  Wisps of steam rise lazily around you, creating a foggy haze on the cut-crystal spigots and the polished silver spout.  Nothing but the distant sounds of katydids disturbs the quiet in this tropical retreat.

title: [Manor House, Master Bath]
description: A substantial circular wall of rounded river rocks joined by smooth grey mortar provides privacy around this spacious bath.  No roof or overhead covering has been added however, leaving an open air feel and a view of the starry night sky.  A sunken tub, lined in smooth glass tiles of green and blue hues, commands the central location and provides occupants an unobstructed view while gazing upward from its depths.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Clearing]
description: The small hill gives way to a sudden cutoff as it approaches the swiftly flowing stream below.  Verdant shrubs and brush grow from the cliff face below, nestled into the gnarled roots of the large, towering trees along the hill's edge.  Brightly colored pink ginger blossoms bloom from a number of niches in the tree roots.  A three-masted ship is beached next to the hill and the jungle has begun to claim the boat for itself.  The captain's balcony at the back of the boat is quite close to the cliff face.

title: [The Wave, Captain's Balcony]
description: The small balcony at the rear of the ship is constructed from painted modwir and maoral.  Enclosing the length of the balcony, a carved modwir railing provides a view of the verdant hillside nearby.  A woven acantha-fiber hammock is strung from a hook on the wall and the edge of the railing.  A glass-paneled lantern hangs from another hook on the wall of the ship, next to a glass-paneled bright green door.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Courtyard]
description: Patches of dewy clover dot the lush green lawn around the base of an ivy-covered tall stone tower, its pointed, conical roof rising toward the starlit sky.  Flickering candlelight illuminates the window at the tower's very top as it overlooks the courtyard.  A cobblestone path winds toward the garden, while a stone-framed lancet arch leads out through the curtain wall.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Great Hall]
description: Beyond the threshold, the tower opens into a circular chamber of cold stone.  A spiraling stone staircase of the same ancient building blocks as the walls winds upward from the center, coiling patient and deliberate toward the floors above.  An iron railing traces the circumference, and behind it the curved walls rise in bookshelves, broken only by an open stone-ringed archway.  Iron candelabras ring the stairs, their candles casting a low amber light that deepens the shadows rather than drives them out.

title: [Bloodforge, Workshop]
description: Encased in stacked slabs of ur-barath, this cold and damp chamber reeks of metallic-tinged aromas, as if it were a carnage-filled battleground in recent times.  Thin blades sharpened to a fine point jut out from the front of a crimson-tinged stone bloodforge, and droplets of what appears to be dried blood stain the floor surrounding the workspace.  Piles of crimson powder cover the floor beneath a large opening.  A dwarven blacksmith assistant stands in front of a narrow archway leading toward the smithy.  An unadorned staircase spirals toward the temple.

title: [Bloodforge, Smithy]
description: Bursts of heat drift in from an adjacent room, and a sulfuric scent lingers in the air.  A blackened pine sawhorse draped with layers of thick padding is nudged against a large worktable cluttered with numerous knives, tongs, chisels, and a variety of other instruments.  Burning embers escape from a small furnace in a fiery crimson spray and threaten to set the worktable ablaze.

title: [Reim Base Camp]
description: The well-trodden, broad paths in this part of the camp are marked by scattered pieces of gravel with tufts of brown grass and patches of withered weeds poking out around them.  Here and there, a few boulders and assorted smaller rocks serve as makeshift monuments or provisional gravemarkers, while off to one side, a flimsy ramp leads up to a two-story wooden construction.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Store Foyer]
description: Aside from tools, mechanical bits, and numerous stacks of dark wooden crates, the foyer of this building is largely empty.  Near the eastern wall, a stack of lids lies toppled over beside a broken barrel.  To the west, a salesroom is visible, and a set of uneven stairs heads up to the second floor.

title: [Inside Weffinait's Wagon]
description: The inside of this large wagon is even more spacious than it appears from the outside.  A long wooden counter stretches the length of the interior, with packed shelves behind it, reaching from floor to polished wood ceiling.  Boxes upon boxes of wares are stacked neatly in the corners, each with its contents labeled by a clear hand.  A set of stairs leads back outside.

title: [Imflass and Dragonstail]
description: Most of the homes here are shuttered, their doors and windows closed tight.  Though most are sized for dwarves, a few of the homes are far larger, with doorways fit for a giant.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: Pale fog hugs the ground, obscuring the road as you pass.  Wispy tendrils of white smoke coil up from the mist, snaking around the numerous corpses staked along the path.  Periodically, the shrill wail of a banshee can be heard from within a tall black crystal tower that rises up at the end of the lane.

title: [Banshee Tower, First Floor]
description: Smooth, crystal black walls form a circular chamber of the first floor of the tower.  The murky opaque, barely translucent surface of the walls allows only the slightest, yet blurred view of the road outside.

title: [East Feywrot, Deep Water Dock]
description: Brightly lit glass globed lanterns cast a soft glow across the surface of the dock and the rippling waters beyond.  Remnants of mooring lines are threaded through heavy iron rings at the edge of the dock, but no vessel appears in sight.

title: [East Feywrot, Dune's End]
description: A series of freshly whitewashed planks form a steep stairway connecting the far end of the pine walkway to a sturdy and spacious dock jutting out across a deep inlet at the river's edge.  Swirls and eddies in the current below indicate a somewhat greater depth to the river at this point than that found farther away from the main channel.  A luminous moon, high overhead, casts soft reflections of shimmering gold flecks across the rippling surface.

title: [Caligos Island, Pier]
[Caligos Isle, Pier]
description: The sturdy pier stands ready to accomodate visitors arriving from, or embarking to, the mainland.  Resting on raised pillars anchored firmly in the substrate below, the terminal end stretches far enough off shore to reach deep water at low tide.  A small grey shanty with pristine white trim is affixed near the stairs, held fast with heavy linked chains.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dockside Stairway]
description: Traversing the steep slope, either toward, or away from, the water is equally treacherous, with loose scree and jagged rocks to either side of the walkway.   Frantically swaying brass lanterns illuminate a large dock below, as it rises and falls in tempo with the waves.  Salt spray rhythmically buffets this section of the stairway, making the footing slick and vision even more difficult in the fog encumbered, nightime environs.

Traversing the steep slope, either toward, or away from, the water is equally treacherous, with loose scree and jagged rocks to either side of the walkway.   A large dock below rises and falls in tempo with the waves, straining against its mooring chains with each passing swell.   Salt spray rhythmically buffets this section of the stairway, making the footing slick and vision difficult.

title: [Caligos Isle, Southern Exposure]
description: Proximity to the water's edge on this exposed outcropping brings fierce gusts of wind with a decidedly salty and sulfurous tang that burns the nostrils.  The ground is obscured by a blanketing mist of deep indigo, sinuously twisting around the ankles of any passersby.  Rounded protrusions of scoria and jagged shards of obsidian poke up from the dark and swirling ground cover.  To the east, only the wind-driven swaying of bright lanterns pierces the fog, indicating the location of the southern pier.

Rounded protrusions of scoria and jagged shards of obsidian poke up from the dark and swirling ground cover.  To the east, workers on a long wooden pier hustle to haul in heavy lines and repair pilings ravaged by recent storms.

title: [The Art Connection, Supplies]
description: Spacious and well-lit by lanterns, the walls of the wagon are covered with wooden paneling lined with lengths of ivory cotton.  Sunlight streams through a large clear crystal dome set into the roof.  A pair of carved mistwood tables are set to one side of the room, while a massive wooden chest sits on the other.  The floor is constructed from sturdy oak that is lacquered to a bright shine, its surface splattered with a rainbow of paint.  On the far side of the wagon, a small area has been sectioned off with a silk-draped archway.

title: [Caligos Isle, Southern Slope]
description: The slope grows steep here, with a long stone bench carved into the cliffside.  Loose rocks give way underfoot for those journeying to or from the large wooden dock to the west.  The wind-whipped sway of dock-bound lanterns flash swathes of light sporadically across the blackened seas, displaying only briefly the deep swells from afar, as well as the roiling white caps closing in on the rocky shore.  The surrounding towering landforms are alternately illuminated and then plunged again into darkness on the whim of the powerful breezes.

The slope grows steep here, with a long stone bench carved into the cliffside.  Loose scree gives way underfoot for those journeying to or from the large wooden dock to the west.  Deep swells in the distance transition to roiling white caps closer to the rocky shore.  A steep, lichen-covered cliff face rises to one side of the narrow pathway, forming a mountain whose peak is shrouded into obscurity by a thick mantle of deep indigo fog.

title: [Signed, Sealed, Delivered]
description: Thick lengths of dark blue velvet cover the walls of the spacious wagon.  Gathered tightly, the drapery ripples as it cascades to the floor creating a puddle of rich material.  Crafted from thick oak, a large writing desk dominates the shop.  On one side of the polished top is a vase full of quills while on the other is a small wooden tray of wax.  In the center of the two is a pile of various parchments and paper.  Set back in the room is a small stack of boxes that rest underneath a pair of silk-lined shelves displaying a wide variety of rings.

title: [Caligos Isle, Beachview]
description: From this narrow precipice, tiny figures holding torches and lanterns can be glimpsed on the black sand beach below whenever the fog, mist, and pungent steam billow off in a brief, but welcome breeze.  A colony of black coral clings to the base of a rocky overhang.  The tiny lights on the beach, however, pale in comparison to those that can be seen overhead when the fog lifts, exposing the grandeur of the vast, inky black sky.

A colony of black coral clings to the base of a rocky overhang.  The sound of waves lapping at the shoreline is punctuated now and then by high-pitched calls of sea birds from above and excited shouts from the beachfront below.

title: [A Wristed Development]
description: Lantern light flickers as salty, humid air drifts in from beyond a knotty pine half-door and lingers inside the half-circle room of reclaimed maoral.  A sandy stone floor offers a walking path around precious wares that shimmer from within a steel-framed glass display case supporting several mannequin legs, while more inventory dangles from a tiered platinum coil hanging from the ceiling.

A sandy stone floor offers a walking path around precious wares that shimmer from within a steel-framed glass display case supporting some mannequin parts, while more shiny trinkets dangle from a tiered platinum coil hanging from the ceiling.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: A long-abandoned lighthouse waits just offshore, silhouetted in the darkness against the silvery white, moonlit horizon.  Its carved, stone block walls rise sharply from its forgotten perch on a jagged, black shoal.  Centuries of buffeting winds and battering seas have not diminished the fortitude of this silvery grey sentinel to remain at its post, standing guard over no one at all.

title: [Savor Your Magic, Stick]
description: Sanded planks of blonde oak are branded with a variety of moons, stars, and celestial markings from one wall to the next.  Draping from a polished globe of brass in the center of the ceiling, swathes of sky blue chiffon billow down and connect in narrow strips to the four corners of the room.  A curved archway is nestled between dual brass racks displaying wares and a glass display case is centerpoint to the entry door.

title: [Caligos Isle, Ravine's Heart]
description: Enormous wrought iron stakes are pounded into the smooth shale wall along the eastern edge of the ravine anchoring a rickety staircase of teak and steel that ascends into mist.  In contrast, the western wall is smooth and slick with water from an unseen force, it's unyielding face blotting out the moonlight.  Along this section of the ravine, the sound of rushing, swirling water collides with the howl of an unseen and unfelt wind.
