Along this section of the ravine, the sound of rushing, swirling water collides with the howl of an unseen and unfelt wind.

Enormous wrought iron stakes are pounded into the smooth shale wall along the eastern edge of the ravine anchoring a rickety staircase of teak and steel that ascends into mist.  In contrast, the western wall is smooth and slick with water from an unseen force, its unyielding face blotting out the moonlight.  Along this section of the ravine, the sound of rushing, swirling water collides with the howl of an unseen and unfelt wind.

title: [The Tides That Bind]
description: The entry tunnel opens into a large, smoothly hewn room inside a plateau.  Orderly stone columns supported by wooden beams overhead line the sides of the chamber.  Veins of colorful gemstones line the floor in unorderly patterns, snaking from wall to wall.  Set between two supporting columns is an enruned archway with a carved sapphire keystone.

title: [Caligos Isle, Western Slope]
description: Pale moonlight highlights the abundance of muted grey veins of quartz that snake through the sloping gabbro path.  Emerging from jagged cracks in the uneven ground, plumes of acrid steam obscure much of the surrounding area, creating only a single path for reasonably safe passage.  The rhythmic sound of waves crashing on rocks below is broken only by the occassional shriek from somewhere in the encompassing darkness.

Muted grey veins of quartz snake through the sloping gabbro path.  Emerging from jagged cracks in the uneven ground, plumes of acrid steam obscure much of the surrounding area, creating only a single path for reasonably safe passage.  The cries of sea birds overhead and the crashing of waves upon the rocks below add an eerie musical score to the steam-enveloped slope.

title: [What Suits Zoo, The Sea]
description: Walls of wavy streaks bear a vibrant gradient of marine colors, the lightest of which spans the ceiling with a hint of glinting sunshine.  The realistic coral reef painted along the floor never repeats as it encircles a large reef-framed glass exhibit and leads to an arch in the north wall.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Thick and viscous, the mist strangles the area with its dank tendrils and its blanketing dampness.  Water drips from several bands of paddle weed that are imbedded in the cobbles of the path, their green leaves glimpsed briefly as the gloom sporadically parts to emit the moonlight from above.   Dark shadows play upon the crumbled remains of a crumbled flagstone tower in the distance, while a ragged shale outcropping is surrounded by echoing winds and voluminous darkness.

Ragged outcroppings of shale and flagstone swallow a wrought iron railing that encircles the pathway, their ragged protrusions blocking the view of the distant ocean and scenery.  Twining bands of paddle weed spread their dark green leaves through the area, their hairy roots clutching at the cobblestones to soak up any spare moisture they can find.  The crumbled remains of a tower, its base buried in the stone, rises roofless into the distance and creates darker shadows upon the mountain slag.

title: [The Hair Apparent]
description: Constructed of stained oak panels that have seen better days, this squat building's low ceiling makes the space seem somewhat cramped.  Scattered on all of the walls are several dingy paintings, some of them hanging slightly crooked.  Taking up most of the room is a long display counter, its surface littered with wares for sale, while a swinging door leads further into the building.  The scent of strong cologne permeates the humid air.

title: [Fantabulous]
description: A thick orange rug covers most of the battered tanik boards that form the floor.  A low heavy maoral shelf lines one wall, while a plain applewood rack flanks the other.  A battered invar hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Fantabulous, Storage]
description: Wooden crates and boxes are stacked haphazardly along the walls of this storage area.  A large corner area remains vacant of clutter, save for a small lumpy cot and a padded fel bench sitting perpendicular to each other.  A large copper lamp hangs on the wall barely a foot above the cot.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: Eerie, high-pitched shrieks are carried in on chilled sea breezes from the blackened waters below, their clarity distorted as the vorteces of swirling winds collide with upcurrents of sulfurous steam.  Though the origin of the plaintive cries is impossible to determine, they at least to identify the direction of the steep dropoff toward the rocks below, hidden in the fog enshrouded darkness.

Black-headed frigatebirds circle overhead, gliding by on outstreched wings of enormous size.  Where the updraft from the eastern sea meets the fierce winds coming off the plateau, the turbulent gusts lend an extra touch of treachery to the steep and slippery slope of loose, wet rock.

title: [Flotsam Frills]
description: Overlapping, salt-stained sailcloth panels line the high walls of the canopied area, the stony, sand-swept grounds littered with errant tendrils of curling seaweed.  A bleached driftwood case rests upon a knotted cotton carpet, behind a smaller area used for displaying wares that houses a dusky sandstone cabinet and a spindly smoky quartz rack.  Suspended overhead, an artfully tangled installation of ghostly white coral is hung at the center of the room.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Refracted light from above dances like a thousand shimmering prisms cast across a long, black sandbar.  With a swoosh, energetic waves sweep over you and head off toward a nearby shore.  Pieces of broken coral mixed with bits of driftwood appear to swim away in tandem.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Clumped strands of dark green seaweed float through the murky waters and appear as schools of fish until a glimmer of light from above shows their true form.  Occasional heaving surges in the ocean shift everything in a rhythmic back-and-forth motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Clumped strands of dark green seaweed float through the murky waters and appear as schools of fish until a glimmer of light from above shows their true form.  Occasional heaving surges in the ocean shift everything in a rhythmic back-and-forth motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Chilling you to the bone, a steady rush of icy water pierces your skin.  Endless blackness is broken only by tiny indigo twinkling in a short black sandbar nearby, the grains and oceanic debris upon it somehow glinting of their own accord in this pitch darkness of the deep.  A sudden rush of warmth from somewhere over your head is countered by a return to near-arctic temperatures as the water surrounding you shifts and resettles.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, up

title: [Hideaway Cavern]
description: Rocky walls consisting of dark shale in some areas and limestone in others spread all around in this cozy space.  A diminutive worktable, its surface covered in dust and ashes, holds a handful of blades sans hilts, some stained with sanguine and all wrought with cracks through their metal makeup.  Clearly ready for display and sale, a separate collection of blades, each finely crafted into a dagger and fully intact, dangles from a braided black rope that splays across the length of the area.

title: [Wrong Turn Tavern]
description: Built into the rock face, the derelict tavern is relatively bare, with only a handful of slipshod tables and chairs tucked under funnel-shaped glass lamps hanging from the craggy ceiling.  Cluttered on one side with six tall stools, a rough-edged oak bar is covered in a milky film, and the other side is entirely bereft of clean glassware and -- perhaps the reason for the general lack of patrons -- liquor.  Middling circular holes that serve as windows are cut into the rock and offer a view of the seascape to the east.

title: [Siren's Call, Cellar]
description: A diamond-nooked cellarette spans the entire back wall of this small room, and the shoulders and necks of wine bottles peek out from its depths.  A sparse few of the nooks are bereft of bottles, but are filled all the same by webbed tunnels woven by spiders or random bits of miscellany.  Underfoot, the uneven stone floor is solid, and every sound, no matter how slight, rebounds endlessly.

title: [Siren's Call, Mezzanine]
description: Open to the tavern's interior on one side and the downward slope of the mountain on the other, the mezzanine is buffeted by cool, soft breaths of air stirred by waves breaking on the shore far below.  Half of the sheltering overhang is an outcropping of rock, while the rest is a retractable oilcloth canopy in a deep shade of blue.  Each of the canopy's supports are moored in sculpted stone planters carved out from the rocky floor.  A narrow stairway leads down to the bar.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The walls of the tunnel are still fairly intact here, with little sign of decay.  A draft of stale air wafts up from a shaft in the center of the floor.  The tattered remains of a rope cling to a small ring in the ceiling, poised directly over the shaft.

title: [Catacombs, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Most of the roof has collapsed here, totally blocking travel farther east.  Water enters from the western tunnels and accumulates in a fairly deep, circular pool at the foot of the rubble.  Besides the sound of the gurgling water, you hear a low rumble from beyond the obstructing debris.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The dense conifer forests to the west serve as backdrop to the three-story buildings lining the cobblestone road.  Torches stand in iron holders that are precariously mounted into the cracked plaster, their black smoke staining the facades.

The snowy conifer forests to the west serve as backdrop to the three-story buildings lining the cobblestone road, the faint trails of woodsmoke drifting far in the distance.  Torches stand in iron holders that are precariously mounted into the cracked plaster, each one hung with colorful glass ornaments.

title: [So Shifty]
description: Smooth oak panelling frames the small room, and a dark wine rug spreads out across the flooring.  A curvy oak mannequin is nestled in the center with a squat oak table positioned nearby.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The dense conifer forests to the west serve as backdrop to the three-story buildings lining the cobblestone road.  Torches stand in iron holders that are precariously mounted into the cracked plaster, their black smoke staining the facades.

The snowy conifer forests to the west serve as backdrop to the three-story buildings lining the cobblestone road, the faint trails of woodsmoke drifting far in the distance.  Torches stand in iron holders that are precariously mounted into the cracked plaster, each one hung with colorful glass ornaments.

title: [The Demon Drop, Lesser]
description: A short step down reveals a dimly lit hallway, with the scent of aged leather and alchemical spices lingering in the air.  On either side, some wooden racks of armor stand as silent sentinels, their surfaces reflecting the soft glow of crystals embedded in the ceiling.  The hallway, lined with shelves holding faintly glowing crystal flasks, stretches ahead further into the shop.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Lyswe Court]
description: Stretching along the interior stone wall is an expansive courtyard with a dilapidated stone fountain, spouting water from a crack in one side, at its center.  Tall brown stone buildings line the courtyard, while green weeds grow up out of the cracks in the uneven cobblestone road.  The walls meet at a tall black iron gate that exits the village.

title: [Covert Couriers, Basement]
description: Filth and grime cover every inch of the surfaces down here.  A small wet drip plinks somewhere off in the dark, and a musty stench permeates the air.  The only light to speak of glimmers through the warped floorboards above your head.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Mark Alley]
description: Tall, dented poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which several pigeons roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is spattered with weeks' worth of bird droppings.

Tall, holly-spiralled poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which tri-colored geese roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is covered in a fine dusting of snow.

title: [Shadowed Light]
description: The subtle smell of old blood lingers in the air as dried pools of the sanguineous substance, along with various drips, mar the already damaged wood floors.  A series of hangers hang from rusted hooks protruding from soiled walls, with small oil lanterns between them.  Resting against a far wall is a pine table, its surface bare save for a few scraps of paper.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Blackened walls visibly wet with a strange fluid stretch in a full circle from the entrance of the shop.  Thick, tentacle-like appendages are hung from each like a curtain over each of the tunnels leading deeper into the temple.  Much like the walls, the floors are squishy and sticky with small sanguine colored pools strewn about.  A pair of black candles illuminate a rusted iron table in the center.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Blood-soaked prayer mats are lined up evenly facing a section of the wall marred with claw marks.  Resting atop four tentacle-like appendages is a pink lace-accented display, its glass top shattered.  Sunken into the floor next to each prayer mat is an uninviting cot.  A tentacle-wrapped squat dilapidated bookshelf filled with stained books and other trinkets off to one side catches your eye.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Blackened walls visibly wet with a strange fluid stretch in a full circle from the entrance of the shop.  Thick, tentacle-like appendages are hung from each like a curtain over each of the tunnels leading deeper into the temple.  Much like the walls, the floors are squishy and sticky with small sanguine colored pools strewn about.  A pair of black candles illuminate a rusted iron table in the center.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: A small, blackened altar sitting upon a circular rug takes up most of the ornate alcove.  In front of the altar is an ebon locker, its hinges rusted and twisted into odd angles.  Atop the altar is the burnt outline of a humanoid being, strange snake-like outlines can be seen on either side of it.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Blackened walls visibly wet with a strange fluid stretch in a full circle from the entrance of the shop.  Thick, tentacle-like appendages are hung from each like a curtain over each of the tunnels leading deeper into the temple.  Much like the walls, the floors are squishy and sticky with small sanguine colored pools strewn about.  A pair of black candles illuminate a rusted iron table in the center.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Thick, tentacle-like cords are draped down from blackened iron spikes along the wall.  The surface of each cord is littered with small suction cups that are drained of life.  Thrown haphazardly against the wall is a large stitched sack, with a collection of assorted goods spilling out.

Thick, tentacle-like cords are draped down from blackened iron spikes along the wall.  The surface of each cord is littered with small suction cups that are drained of life.  Thrown haphazardly agains the wall is a large stitched sack, with a collection of assorted goods spilling out.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Copper Road]
description: Thick oak poles form the framework and facade of a small tavern, while the rough boards of the walls still bear the greenish tinge of new lumber.  Trampled grasses attempt to maintain their claim on this once vacant lot, but the stamp of foot traffic proclaims it a lost battle.

Thick ribbon-latticed poles form the framework and facade of a small tavern, while the rough boards of the walls still bear the greenish tinge of new lumber.  Colorful spheres of thin glass dangle from ropes hoisted around the tavern, casting faint patterns with the ambient light.

title: [The Art of Lore, Salesroom]
description: Little has been done to tidy up this small, decrepit basement, its dirt floor littered with broken bricks, shattered jars, and other debris.  A solitary iron cauldron burns, illuminating a quartet of mannequins and a note.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The sharply angled intersection comes to a point at a giant pine tree easily higher than any giantman that may happen by.  The cobblestones are dusted with its needles, providing a slippery yet quietly fragrant path.  An arrow-shaped wooden sign points southeast.

title: [Make Your Mark]
description: Despite the worsening condition of the exterior of the tower, the inside is clean and neatly furnished with numerous bookshelves.  The grass making its way between the cracks in the cobblestone floor has been meticulously trimmed, and the walls behind the pewter-caged lanterns providing illumination have been scrubbed clean of soot.  A lacquered linden table has been carved to follow the gentle curve of the circular tower wall, its surface covered by a woven sapphire blue table runner.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Bailey Park]
description: The stone wall angles sharply as the road turns to the northwest.  Nestled in the corner, a neat brick building is shaded by the towering cedars and pines.

title: [The Penitent Petitioner]
description: Tucked against a crumbling wall and sheltered by large squares of oiled canvas, the small enclosure is swept clean of debris and the rough cobblestones of the road are scrubbed completely clean.  Burning tallows rest upon stones that have been tugged free of the wall to make tiny shelves, their slender waxy bodies bound in place by the melted remains of previous occupants.  Two alcoves, one draped in azure and gold and the other in ebon and silver, are lined with prayer benches for the penitent.

title: [Black Hand, Draccor's Haunt]
[Black Hand, Game Room]
description: The energy of the cavern echoes off the walls as patrons are camouflaged under a thick haze of hazelnut cigar smoke.  Sanguine leather bar stools line a sturdy ebonwood bar that curves outward to provide ample room behind the bar for shelves of various liquor from across Elanthia.  The expansive floor plan opens up to reveal a dart board, which receives the only splash of light in the grotto.  A dimly lit inlet in the rock houses a series of sleek cream leather booths creating an intimate atmosphere.

title: [Black Hand, Brewery]
description: The air is slightly damp, the silence of the rocky chamber broken by the quiet sound of water dripping far off in the distance.  A tremendous copper drum rises from the floor in the center of the room, tapering to a rounded peak near the ceiling to form a massive still.  Old, iron-banded vats line the walls, forming two rows of oak aisles among the space.  Off to the side, an ebonwood table holds some corked bottles of pale liquid, while a charcoal marble fireplace provides the only light in the space.

title: [Black Hand, Docks]
description: The dark cavern's cool air carries a musty scent of damp wood and stone.  Torches along the rough stone walls offer just enough flame to blacken the craggy ceiling above them.  Obsidian black water surrounds a pair of weathered wooden docks that terminate at large fel-framed doors crudely carved into the cavern wall.  An old, tethered rowboat facing the cavern mouth occasionally draws near its anchor post and knocks against it.

title: [Black Hand, Old Warehouse]
description: The large double sliding doors open to a poorly lit warehouse with a thick cedar floor covered with dust and scuff marks.  Stacks of crates and boxes occupy several marked locations on the floor, designated for storage and delivery.  Near the rear wall is a simple wooden desk covered in piles of stained paper.

title: [Black Hand, Botanist Lab]
description: The faint smells of tobacco, vanilla, and flora intoxicate the area.  Water tumbles down the eastern side of the cave's wall in a cascading miniature waterfall that forms into a pool surrounded by an array of wildflowers and moss.  A series of intertwining ivy stretches towards a single burst of moonlight that streams through a hole in the ceiling bathing the garden.  Shelves that have been carved into the rock hold an array of vials and flasks, while a burnished kakore table sits off to the corner.

title: [Black Hand, Supply Room]
description: A plush velvet charcoal sofa wraps around the cavern walls, and large pieces of aubergine ramie silk drape down from the ceiling providing a pop of color and texture to the room.  Spaced evenly in front of the long sofa are rounded glaes tables etched with a tessellated pattern.  Carved into the far wall is a huge steel vault, gems and coins scattered across the stone floor in front.  Silhouettes of different shapes fill the lounge, the shadows dancing in the warm flicker of some vaalin sconces.

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Triage Yard]
description: The open-air yard is enclosed by stone walls and the tall tower on the southern side.  At the center of the yard, a wood-burning brazier warms the injured.  Healers and clerics tend to those lying on canvas cots scattered throughout the yard.  The walls are inset with carved reliefs of healing herbs.  Hung near a narrow arch is a communal sack of herbs.  A stone stairway leads up into a hall that projects outward from the wall on corbels.  The stone tower projects a faint illumination over the yard from its glaesine windows.
a.location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Refuge Hall]
description: Rows of ebonwood tables set haphazardly with steins and mugs span the length of the hall.  Seated on adjacent long ebonwood benches are resting medics and recovering patients.  On one side are small-paned glaesine windows, and on the other a wide stone hearth capped with a solid mantle of walnut commands the focus of the hall.  Over the hearth is a silver-framed oil painting, and from exposed ceiling beams hang many unused drinking vessels.  A mithril-banded ebonwood door opens to a spiraling stairwell that leads further up into the tower.  A small basket of wooden sticks sits in the shadows against a polished ebonwood bar inlaid with ivory.
b.location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Mushroom Bed]
description: The maze of trees begins to thin, though the canopy of leaves still blots out much of the moonlight.  Normally sturdy, the soil increasingly becomes waterlogged toward the east, the muddy conditions making travel difficult.  As the atmosphere becomes dank, the vividly hued flowers make way for more subdued fungi and mosses.  Clustering around the base of one of the larger trees, a number of pale white mushrooms brighten the area.
b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Sunholm, The Battlements]
description: Protected by its crenellated parapet, the alure of the keep stretches between twin turrets, their azure-on-white pennons stark against the night sky.  Below, the inner ward and its guarded buildings fan out, illuminated within the bastioned curtain walls of the stronghold.  Beyond, the dark of the night swallows much of the countryside, save the dancing glows of caravansary campfires nestled below Vornavis' clifftop enceinte and the streetlights of the Freeport of Solhaven, dimly flickering in the night.

Protected by its crenellated parapet,  the alure of the keep stretches between twin turrets, their azure-on-white pennons streaming against the daylight sky.  Below, the inner ward and its guarded buildings fan out, and beyond the bastioned outer curtain wall the Cairnfang River stretches west towards the sea and Solhaven, opposite the east's vast plains and hills.  Southward, the tall blue granite walls of Vornavis' clifftop enceinte stand fast, while north lays an unending wilderness framed by mountains.

title: [Sunholm, The Hall of the Sun]
description: Above the colossal hall, rows of argent banners blazoned by azure sunbursts hang from immense wooden trusses.  Tall stained glass windows set into stone arches stretch skyward, their mottled light illuminating the granite tiled floor, each flanked by wall-mounted arms of all types.  A vast round table surrounded by heavy wooden chairs dominates the center of the hall, and at its end an immense stone hearth regally occupies a dais below a grand azurite stone sun supported by numerous heraldic shields.

title: [Carnival, Strange Street]
description: Light flickers across the wagons bordering the southern edge of the walkway from the bonfire to the northwest.  A tree stump remains to the side of the walkway, a stubborn reminder of the area before it was cleared for the carnival.  People pass by with looks of wonder and amazement.

title: [The Hair of the Dog]
description: Small and bright, this space somehow manages to be cozy instead of cramped.  A sturdy oak sideboard sits adjacent to a battered mahogany bar, the surfaces of both covered in edible and drinkable wares.  A set of twisted iron hooks is nailed onto the wall next to a swinging door that leads back to the kitchen.  While the polished wood floors are smooth and unblemished, they seem to have gathered a perpetual layer of shed hair that blows around like miniature furry tumbleweeds.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Hidden Hideaway]
description: Some colorful cushions are spread around the room near a small bar that is set in the far corner.  Hung between a misshapen hole in the wall and a lavender silk curtain is a gilded mahogany sign.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Haggard Hookup]
description: Against the far wall, a doorless wardrobe is pushed up against one side of a three-legged table to keep it from falling over.  A collection of hastily hastily nailed boards serves as a makeshift rack, which looks nearly ready to fall from where it is hooked to the wall.  An odd set of muddy footprints leads from a dirt-caked oak door and seems to disappear amongst the rest of the dirt covering the floor.

title: [Caligos Isle, Village Edge]
description: Vines drape from the high granite wall that disappears into the sky, the stone's dark face and towering height looming ominously over the small village.  Cracked barrels, discarded wagon wheels, and piles of warped boards lie broken upon the ground and display signs of long exposure to water and other elements.  Cracked coral, dried-out seaweed, and tangles of kelp rest in huge piles throughout the area, the strange aquatic flora looking out of place in the jungle-like foliage.

Blooming vines drape from the high granite wall, the stone's towering height providing a modicum of respite for a group of villagers engaged in lively conversation.  Baskets of fresh vegetables sit snuggled between the rows of a garden, the produce receiving a surprise inspection by a pair of curious kittens weaving in between the containers.  A pair of tridents, held together with pieces of sinew-bound driftwood, solemnly stand guard along the village edge, each one strung with bits of tumbled sea glass.

title: [Caligos Isle, Quiet Fissure]
description: Naturally formed, a ragged scar provides egress from the small alcove and stretches from the rough granite floor to the distant, dripping ceiling.  Tangles of vines, rubbery kelp, and barnacles reflect the ambient light that spills in from the outside world, while tiny scratching sounds hint at tiny denizens amid the craggy rocks.  A splintered bit of driftwood is imbedded into the wall, its rough body too distant to reach.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fishing Jetty]
description: Sharp gusts whip salty spray over massive squares of arm-width granite, their surfaces roughly carved with palm-sized spirals, creating a stable walkway that snakes out into the obsidian ocean shrouded by viscous mist.  Sharp volcanic glass spires rise up to pierce the surface of the churning waters, as waves lap at the sheer drop-offs and black sandy beaches on either side of the walkway.  Flotsam gathers along the coasts that extend perpendicular to the jetty, into the grey mists that clutch at the island.

title: [Caligos Isle, Village]
description: Cracked foundations are all that remain of single-room homes that once stood upon this sandy shore.  Splintered, warped, and shattered floorboards fill the rough square shapes, though the wooden lengths are waterlogged and riddled with barnacles.  To the northwest, large poles hint that a pier may once have stood there, but the timbers that allowed passage and access long ago rotted away.

A scattering of single-room homes have been erected along the sandy shore, their planks painted in a myriad of colorful tones and adorned with shells and bits of driftwood.  Large wooden poles, wrapped in a lattice of sun-bleached cotton ribbons, provide a foundation for a half-built pier, the remaining materials neatly stacked safely away from the day-to-day hustle of the residents.  The aroma of fish and vegetables emanates from one of the open windows, combining with the brininess of the oceanic air.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [The Favored Few, Showroom]
description: Four massive white columns stand at the corners of this raised pavilion.  Draped around and between them are large swathes of white silk.  Bright lights are carefully placed so as to be diffused by the silk, blunting their effect while still providing plenty of light.  A free-standing armor rack stretches across one wall of the pavilion, and a low marble table dominates the center of the space.  A scrollworked plaque is prominently mounted on one of the colums.

Four massive white columns stand at the corners of this raised pavilion.  Draped around and between them are large swathes of white silk.  Bright lights are carefully placed so as to be diffused by the silk, blunting their effect while still providing plenty of light.  A free-standing armor rack stretches across one wall of the pavilion, and a low marble table dominates the center of the space.  A scrollworked plaque is prominently mounted on one of the columns.  You also see some black marble steps leading back to the main grounds.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: The path narrows here, and beyond the edge lies a steep dropoff where tiers of hexagonal basalt columns present evidence of the dire consequences of falling.  Steam rises between the stone pillars in grey tendrils, the moisture collecting on the uneven rock face.  The bleached-white skeletal remains of a few sea birds scattered atop the black basalt columns have been picked clean and glitter almost picturesquely in the moonlight.

The path narrows here, and beyond the edge lies a steep dropoff where tiers of hexagonal basalt columns present evidence of the dire consequences of falling.  Steam rises between the stone pillars in grey tendrils, the moisture collecting on the uneven rock face.  Black-headed gulls circle overhead, dropping shells onto the the broken basalt columns.  Their piercing cries dissipate in the wind as they dive to retrieve their succulent prizes.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: Quasi-circular in design, the rotunda-style walkway of this portion of Clovertooth Hall mimics the round shape of the frosted red and ice blue-hued glass dome far above you.  A candle and crystal chandelier adorned with pearlescent saber-tooth tiger incisors on a long, golden chain fills the area with the amplified glow of refracted candlelight.  Set back a few feet from the top of the stair, a tiny halfling child statue leaning casually against a decorative railing serves as a bit of conceptual installation art.  Younger visitors passing by stop to strike a pose beside it before their parents shoo them on.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Saferoom]
description: Judging from the time-rounded stones and smooth floor, the saferoom is old, but it is kept free of dust.  Crates and barrels full of preserved foodstuffs are stacked floor to ceiling, filling the air with the sharp odor of brine and more muted hints of dry meat and fish.  A large metal lever protrudes from one wall.

title: [Formal Dining Room]
description: Subdued light provides the room with a warm glow as beeswax candles flicker in balenite sconces that line the honey oak walls.  A large umcor tapestry occupies one wall, while the others are adorned with smaller arras of varying cultural origins.  A long mahogany dining table lined with silk-cushioned high-back chairs dominates the room.  The scent of freshly baked bread wafts through a pair of white oak doors as they swing open for waitstaff delivering trays to a cherrywood sideboard.  A neat rubbish canister is tucked away in one corner.

title: [Clovertooth, Kitchen]
description: A pair of swinging white oak doors separates the kitchen and dining room, sealing off some of the noise from the bustling staff at work.  A large fel cupboard occupies one corner, its doors ajar, revealing shelves stacked with fresh fruit and prepared desserts.  The white marble counter is laden with cutting boards and a variety of knives and utensils.  A red-faced halfling chef threatens his assistants with a rolling pin as they scurry about the kitchen preparing dishes for the guests in the dining room.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: An immense barbican stands sentry over the wide South Gate of Icemule Trace, and the eastern tower stands high over this portion of the wall.  A small window provides the only means of entry, but it is far too high to access without some help from above.  To the north, the wall looks over Barter Alley to Tartifact's Bakery and the other shops of Trader's Way.

title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
description: The brisk winds of the north flow through the numerous windows that line the circular, stone walls.  Tattered bits of leather and cloth sit beneath the narrow slits, the stains on them a telltale sign of the many battles fought from these heights.  A particularly wide window opens up to the east, and a length of thick rope is tied to a grommet at its base.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: The wide South Wall looks down over the well-traveled confined of Bootlegger's Alley, which skirts between the wall and several of the most-patronized businesses in the city.  Across the alley to the north lie the grounds of House White Haven, while the view to the south is dominated by impenetrable forest.  Immediately to the east is the western barbican tower of the city's South Gate, which offers access only via an impossibly high window.

title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
description: The shallow steps of the winding stairway taper off at a round room marked by a group of narrow slitted windows.  Pale starlight shines through the narrow gaps in the stone, shimmering wanly against the bits of ice formed along their edges.  A steel grommet fixed beneath one of the wider windows holds a long length of rope.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The wall to the south is dominated by the barbican over the East Gate of the city.  A tall barbican tower stands just south of this position, and a single window high above provides the only point of access from the wall.  The curious odor of medicinal tart-baking wafts from Ma Leaftoe's shop on the other side of Fear Alley.

title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
description: A circle of windows looks out onto the surrounding landscape from the top of the tower, each offering as its view only a thin slice of the world as its view because of the arched, slit-like construction.  A few stick-like markings mar the otherwise smooth stone surface beneath the windows -- the arcane figures likely the handiwork of some rather bored guardsman.  A long, thick rope has been tied to a grommet beneath the widest of the windows, permitting access to the eastern wall below.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The wall ends in a tall barbican tower to the north, keeping watch over the East Gate of Icemule Trace.  A few adventurers wander through the gate at all times of day and night, some eager to test themselves against the wilds and some bearing the wounds and treasure that mark the relative success of their ventures.  To the west across the narrow Trade Alley stands the city jail.

title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
description: A variety of thick wooden planks provides a sturdy footing at the top of the staircase, the walls opening up into a variety of narrow slitted windows.  Various scuffs, nicks and scorches mar the otherwise smooth stone walls, a telltale sign of the many battles fought here.  A larger window harbors a long piece of rope tied to a grommet, the majority of its length arranged in long serpentine coils.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: Off in the distance lie the high Ice Plains behind their sturdy rolaren gate.  In the opposite direction stands the impressive structure of Silverwood Manor.  The wall itself is empty except for the ubiquitous snow and ice, which seems determined to claim the structure as its own.

Both sides of the wall are similarly cloaked in darkness.  On the city side, the nearest visible lights come from Silverwood Manor on Cursed Street, almost in the center of town.  The winds howl down the near empty walls, filling the night with a mournful chill.

title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
description: A few simple tokens hang above each narrow slitted window, each marred by some faint scar, dent, or tear.  Dark planks harboring black stains in the wood make up the floor, their short railings ensuring that none will take a rather nasty plunge to the floor far below.  A length of knotted rope is gathered beneath a grommet set into the wall beneath one of the wider windows to allow access to the west wall.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: The wall comes to an end at the tall barbican tower rising over the West Gate of the city.  A window provides the only access to the tower, and that only from the most difficult height.  To the west can be seen the Warrior's Guild compound and the Nightowl Pub, while immediately beneath the wall a variety of unsavory types make their way down the narrow thoroughfare known as Brewer's Alley.

title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
description: The stairs come to an end in this upper room, where a rough construction of planks and reinforced wood forms a small platform giving access to slitted windows in the walls.  A stunted little barrel stands between the gaps of the numerous slitted windows that encircle the area.  One wider window looks down upon the western wall of Icemule Trace, and a knotted rope is tied to a grommet securely fastened to its stony ledge.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Wine Storage]
description: Huge redwood racks line the stone walls from floor to ceiling, each nearly full to capacity with colorful bottles.  Thin bands of icy blue rhimar are visible here and there on the racks, and a faint swirl of cool mist eddies around the chamber.  Sconces set at intervals along the wine racks support tiny globes of pale, steady light.  A heavy redwood door is set into the south wall, while a short stair on the east side of the room leads down to a similarly robust door.

title: [Bard Guild, Great Hall]
description: Large windows covering the east and west walls of the Great Hall stand open to catch the salt-scented breeze blowing in off the Bay.  The beaded ceiling above is rich-toned teak, and ceiling fans suspended from it turn at a lazy pace.  On the floor, woven rugs cover slate tiles, and piles of patterned pillows lie here and there for seating, each grouping of cushions accompanied by low teak tables.

title: [Cholen's Temple, East Hall]
description: The wide corridor ends at an arched door inlaid with a crimson-stained lute set in a circle of gold.  Brass lanterns line the walls, spilling golden light in pools across the long crimson rug that traverses the length of the hall.  Three short steps lead up to an elevated door set in the west wall, while an oak door draped with scarlet silk stands further down the corridor in the east wall.

title: [Meditation Chamber]
description: A handful of colorful cushions and woven prayer rugs are arranged on the hardwood floor of the chamber.  A single lantern illuminates the jewel-toned silks that drape the walls, and a pierced brass screen is centered on the north wall.

title: [Rumor Woods, Talon Rock]
description: The path abruptly stops at a a massive rock formation amid the trees.  Thick with moss, lichen, and encroaching roots from the adjacent firs, the rock teems with forest life.  Though steep, the rock appears to have enough basic hand- and foot-holds to be traversable, with care.

title: [Rumor Woods, Small Cave]
description: The walls of the cramped cave are heavy with moss, lichen, and frost.  A smattering of small bones betray the cave's possible use as a den for a predator sometime in the past.  An array of delicate icicles hanging from the cave's mouth, while only darkness lies further in.

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Stone urns filled with crimson blooms are scattered about the area.  Branches from the tall shade trees twist together to form a thick, verdant canopy above.  A beautifully carved stone bench rests beside one of the thick trunks.
a.location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [The Primrose Pavilion]
description: Draping layers of finespun gold silk linen compose the airy canopy of the tall-peaked pavilion.  Several illuminated bronze lanterns are suspended over a wide-curved dark oaken bench that spans across the back of the room, giving off steady, gilded light throughout the space.  The crisp scent of bergamot drifts lightly upon the air, adding a comforting warmth to the cordial ambiance.

title: [Sylvanfair, Vestibule]
description: Square in shape, the vestibule is bathed in a shaft of muted gold sunlight streaming through the open top section of the front door.  A richly carved staircase rises from the terracotta-tiled floor, cantilevered against the four walls to provide a perfect viewing platform for the irregularly shaped table that dominates the center of the room.  Mismatched cabinets and battered trunks fill the asymmetrical spaces beneath the stairway, crammed with assorted timekeeping devices and navigational instruments.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: Close to the bottom of the cliffs, the cobblestone street is somewhat level.  A tidy row of stone cottages faces the bay, moonlight glinting on their glaes window panes.  A well-dressed elven man walks by at a fast clip, his eyes glued to the pavement.

Close to the bottom of the cliffs, the cobblestone street is somewhat level.  A tidy row of stone cottages faces the bay, sunlight glinting on their glaes window panes.  A well-dressed elven man walks by at a fast clip, his eyes glued to the pavement.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: The air within the musty tunnel is heavy, taxing your lungs even further.  Darkness fills the available space, making it impossible to continue in any direction without first palpating the surrounding wall surfaces.  The terrain, although still damp, appears to be heading upward.

title: [Under the Walls]
description: Dry dust floats about once again, the thick particles clinging to clothing, hair, and throat.  The tunnel has widened slightly, making it easier to push forward.  Darkness reigns still, but a lighter patch of space beckons from just a few more feet ahead.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
description: Situated a short distance off the path is an enormous pile of stone chips.  Tall grasses have pushed their way up from pockets of soil in the pile.  Above here, a range of rocky crags begin.

Situated a short distance off the path is an enormous pile of stone chips.  Tall grasses have pushed their way up from pockets of soil in the pile.  Moonlight illuminates a range of rocky crags above.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Hot Springs]
description: Wisps of steam rise off the pool as the hot water comes in contact with the cool mountain air.  Centered in the pool is a flat rock, barely protruding above the surface.  The rock has become home to several dragonflies.  Shadows from the tree branches above dance across the water.

Wisps of steam rise from the pool as the hot water comes in contact with the cool night breeze.  Moonlight illuminates a flat rock centered in the pool which has become home to several dragonflies.  The midnight-black water mirrors the night sky, seemingly an extension of the heavens above.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Third Floor]
description: The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, as a pair of the steps actually continue above the floor, creating an awkward step down.  Many signs of heavy impact can be seen on the protruding steps, as if someone or something had attempted to hammer them into place after they had been placed.  A staircase formed of the same stones found in the rest of the tower stretches upwards, though these particular stones are polished to a high sheen.

The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, evidenced by the uneven pool of tiny wooden toy gargoyles gathered in the corner of a lower step.  Colorfully painted arrows indicate that the tower stretches upward in a spiral of streamers and dried beetles.

title: [Pick a Pocket]
description: The small stone chamber is crowded at best, crammed with a nearly endless supply of stone blocks, wooden crates, and overturned chests.  The room appears to be more of a forgotten storage area than any space worth residing in for long.  Cobwebs clutter the corners of the scrunched space and the floor is covered with dust, broken up only by some fresh footprints moving to and fro.

title: [Grogiz's Sekrit Rume]
description: This "secret room" is almost identical to the one above.  It is made up of stone: stone walls, stone floor, and stone ceiling, save for the small opening into the room.  The only differences are the a crudely-made rug on the floor and a small purple thing in the corner.

title: [The Darker Path]
description: This cell is stone: stone walls, stone floor and stone ceiling.  There is a stone rack, a stone shelf, and a stone counter on one of the three full stone walls.  Water runs slowly down the wall in the corner and is slowly pooling on the floor, except for one area near the middle.

title: [A Gneiss Guy, Workroom]
description: Large and spacious, this underground room is cold and damp.  A granite leg leans at an angle against a large cracked chalk-dusted worktable.  The occasional drip of water can be heard from an iron rung ladder.

title: [A Gneiss Gal, Salon]
description: Glowing lichen provides a dim source of light in this damp section of cavern.  A stone-littered table rests close to one wall, while a low stone ledge lines two of the others.  A chilled air drafts in through a yawning hole in the wall.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Amaranth Wey]
description: The crush of passersby makes this busy intersection difficult to navigate.  Above all, the towering gate looms, casting the entire area into deep shadow despite the brightness of day.  A group of guardsmen stands to one side, casually watching the crowd.

Few people wander through the area at this hour.  The towering gate looms above, blocking any view of the moons and stars and leaving the area only dimly lit by several ironwork torches placed along the wey.  A group of guardsmen stands to one side, casually watching the crowd.

title: [On the Throne]
description: Tattered, sun-bleached canvas is draped over the wooden bows of the wagon frame, providing a makeshift shelter against the island winds.  The floor is littered with straw from unpacked crates that have been overturned and used as displays for merchandise, while unopened boxes are stacked at the far back of the wagon.  A short set of steps lead out of the wagon.

title: [Caligos Isle, Leviathans' Rest]
description: Three bloated and decaying orcas, likely a mama, papa, and baby, rest together in shallow pools between jagged peaks.  A putrid stench emits from each, as gases of decomposition seep through open wounds and deteriorating body cavities.  The baby's face and eyes have been picked clean by scavengers and, beneath the leathery exteriors, writhing hagfish can be seen devouring the choice flesh.  The treacherous nighttime path has been made moreso by a slick coating of blood, blubber, and a rancid, slimy ooze.

Three sun-bleached skeletal orcas, likely a mama, papa, and baby, rest together in shallow pools between jagged peaks.  Bits of leathery, black and white hide cling in scattered patches across each creature's bony structures, as if refusing to surrender its former identity.  The smallest skeleton is missing its head and much of its ribcage, and trails of bone shards litter the treacherous slope below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Oyster Pools]
description: Kidney-shaped tidal pools pockmark the black sands that stretch to the north, while boulders and rocky formations create a barrier that protects the tranquil waters from the waves beyond.  Every now and again, moonlight breaks through the heavy mist that clings to the beach and dances upon the white sands at the bottom of the tiny pools.  A rack of racks and nets is built against a set of rough oak steps that leads to a canopy in the east.

title: [Old Sage's Jewels of the Isle]
description: Bamboo poles, wedged into rocks, support an off-white canvas canopy that ripples and snaps in the ocean-borne breeze.  Fitfully burning torches rise along the edges of the small shop that consists of a single table fashioned of salvaged driftwood.  Dipping and rising, the uneven ground of black sands and large boulders descends towards a beach pockmarked with tidal pools.  To make passage between the shop and beach safer, someone has constructed a set of rough oak steps.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, East Alcove]
description: Sunlight from the skylight overhead glistens on a suit of full armor that stands between two of the doors.  A beautifully crafted sword mounted on fine rosewood hangs on the opposite wall.  Low voices can be heard coming from the west, but they are drowned out by the sound of running water.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Shop]
description: Beautiful alabaster wall sconces are set above a large glass display case, illuminating the contents within.  Next to the case, a large tanik chest sits opposite a wall tapestry.  In a corner of the small room, a potted palm crowds up against the ceiling.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: Torchlight flickers across the polished surfaces from sconces carved into the walls at regular intervals.  The small circular landing in the stairs provides enough room for several doors and a bit of standing room to rest on before continuing up or down.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Guest Room]
description: This guestroom is modest but tasteful.  The walls are hung with several small tapestries depicting various Dhe'nar battles, and velvet curtains frame the glaes window.  A large bed with quilted covers and overstuffed pillows lies in the center of the room, with a matching nightstand sitting beside it.

title: duplicate of 2953
description: Seven broad, stone steps lead upwards, bracketed by ornate wooden bannisters.  The balusters are carved into the spearheaded shapes of irises, while the newels are shaped like frogs upon lilypads.

title: [Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Left open to the crisp air of day via vast maple doors, the great hall is a cavernous chamber lined with long wooden benches that march in neatly ordered rows beneath its gabled windows.  At its eastern end, two steps lead from the main floor to the dais.  Three lancet windows on the eastern wall halo the dais in light, crowned by a wheel-shaped window inset with rose-colored stained glass.  The small minstrels' gallery sits over the oak-paneled buttery screen that graces the western wall.

Left open to the chill of night via vast maple doors, the great hall is a cavernous chamber lined with long wooden benches that march in neatly ordered rows beneath its gabled windows.  At its eastern end, two steps lead from the main floor to the dais.  Three lancet windows on the eastern wall halo the dais in muted moonlight, crowned by a wheel-shaped window inset with rose-colored stained glass.  The small minstrels' gallery sits over the oak-paneled buttery screen that graces the western wall.

title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
description: Cloying, sweet decay overwhelms any of the cavern's other odors, from the faintly metallic odor of the water to the ever-present bitterness of mold.  Its source is a jagged-edged pit, roundly uneven, that bores down into the stone of peninsula as it reaches its culmination.  Before the gash stands a tall pedestal with an ancient skin-bound enchiridion upon it.

title: [Den of Rot, Pit of Rebirth]
description: Hundreds of bodies are heaped into the pit, all of them female.  In life, each would have been possessed of surpassing beauty.  They lay heaped atop one another like broken dolls, eyes clouded over.  Together, theirs is an unbearable stench of old blood, death, and seething rot.

title: [Abbey Choir Loft]
description: At the top of the stair, the thick beam balustrade, seamless as if hewn from a single tree, is supported by thick wooden columns carved with rose vines and snowflakes.  Three shallow risers stand beneath the traceried lancet window that runs the length of the loft.

The thick beam balustrade, hewn from a single tree, is supported by thick wooden columns carved with vines of roses.  Three shallow risers stand beneath the traceried lancet window that runs the length of the loft.

title: [Abbey Chapel]
description: Ornate doors of heavy bronze muffle sounds from outside of the chapel, a long chamber with a low maple ceiling that has fanciful patterns of leaves and rosettes carved into its surface.  Framed on either side by pews of sturdy spruce, a walk proceeds to the east.  A thickly balustraded stair along the northern wall spirals up into a small loft.
To the right, a thickly balustraded stair leads upwards.  The low oak ceiling is carved into a fanciful pattern of leaves and rosettes.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, North]
description: Starlight illuminates the sky, though the moons never truly show their faces this close to the sheer cliff wall that stretches towards the sky.  Purple clover blossoms grow between the dark cobblestones, and tangled flaeshorn vines strive for the peak.  Smaller stalls, dark and secretive, have popped up in the shadow of the cliff, while an enormous iron-bound door is built directly into its craggy face.  A small oak and stucco shop rests on the far southern edge of the square.

A small oak and stucco shop rests on the far southern edge of the square.

Starlight bathes the cobblestone lane in a silver sheen, while dark shadows created by the looming presence of a high cliff vie for dominance.  A large two-story inn to the west lends its hulking form to the battle for darkness by looming over the smaller cottages built along the eastern edge.  Removed from the fight, a southern slip of road leads closer to the ocean and is the home of a sprawling stone-sided complex.

title: [Irosah's Armaments]
description: Large and small practice dummies are arranged on the western wall, each displaying a different armor type in a variety of colors and metals.  Along the eastern wall, shields are suspending from long chains in the ceiling, their broad expanses block exterior light from entering the shop.  Set beneath the light of twin lanterns, a long wooden counter separates the showroom from the workrooms and has a welcoming sign on it.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The staircase narrows to a claustrophobic tunnel of greyish, fitted stone.  Sputtering torches throw dim, flickering light down the narrow corridor, giving a sense of life to the old slate flooring.  The dust-filled air is stale and heavy, smelling of rotting cloth and long-dry bone.

title: [Abbey, High Gallery]
[Abbey Gallery]
description: Silvery moonlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Bright-pigmented paintings depicting the surrounding lands in different seasons are spaced along the opposite wall.  One depicts the environs in high summer, the greenery verdant and the fields blossoming, with nary a hint of snow to be seen.

One depicts the environs in high summer, the greenery verdant and the fields blossoming, with nary a hint of snow to be seen.

title: [Abbey, Grand Stair Landing]
[Abbey Grand Stair Landing]
description: The broad landing of the grand stair is oval, with its wooden floor painted dark green.  A semi-circular railing surrounds the landing and continues up the final five steps to the upper gallery.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, West]
description: Still busy despite the hour, traffic trickles in from the northwestern road through the cobblestone courtyard.  Wagons, mules, and heavily burdened workers have worn away some of the painting upon the cobblestone of the market, though some of the edges still display the black, cerulean, and azure hues.  A large flat-roofed tent with an enormous wooden sign hanging over its entry stands open for business along the western edges, while opposite a weathered oak building is brightly illuminated from within.

Constant traffic from the northwestern roads through the cobblestone courtyard lends this section of the market a loudness that is missing from other sections. paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Entry]
description: Sturdy oak pillars support this structure, though they appear to have been added at some point, as the outer framework of the building seems far more weathered and salt-stained.  A large statue of a one-eyed dwarf dominates the center of the space, and a circular bench runs around the perimeter of its base.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Kraken's Fall, Beach]
description: Winding paths lead up over the high, grass-covered dunes that line the northern sections of the beach, while along the south the tide ebbs and flows in a rhythmic fashion.  Bamboo torches, tall and straight, burn with bright orange flames from their place just out beyond the tideline.  A spiraling wooden staircase winds its way from the ground to the second-story entry of a conical-roofed bungalow built on stilts, a wide sailcloth banner attached to its railings displays a bright red painting with tidy letters beneath.

Bamboo torches, tall and straight, stand dormant just out beyond the tideline, the sun-bleached lengths hardened and devoid of lacquer.  A spiraling wooden staircase winds its way from the ground to the second-story entry of a conical-roofed bungalow built on stilts, a wide sailcloth banner attached to its railings displays a bright red painting with tidy letters beneath.

title: [Rock Lobster]
description: This tiny restaurant only has a few seats, most of which are empty and waiting for customers.  Bright yellow paint and ocean views in blue frames adorn the walls, which are lined with windows that overlook the roiling waters on the horizon.  Floating between the cramped tables, a distracted waitress moves plates to and from a kitchen window that produces delectable aromas.  A blue mandolin has been mounted above the entrance of this establishment, while a sturdy chair has been placed nearby.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Rising dark and ominous into the sky, a large wooden guard tower overlooks the tapered points of the surrounding colony walls.  A hard-packed dirt road pushes through gates to the west, though it quickly turns to mud as it travels east.  Very little traffic makes its way through the town entry, which is bathed in bright starlight.  Cracked mud, soft and viscous at its center, fills the entry to a sprawling oak and pine barn that is built in the center of the lane.

Casting its shadow upon the area, a large wooden guard tower rises above the tapered points of the surrounding colony walls.  A hard-packed dirt road pushes through gates to the west, though it quickly turns to mud as it travels east.  Steady traffic from loggers skidding their daily haul keeps the bustling town entry busy.

title: [Guard Tower, Office]
description: Hanging from wrought iron wall anchors, pot-bellied glass and blued steel lanterns maintain a comfortable brightness throughout the tidy office during all times of the day and night.  Various papers, signs, notes, and maps are tacked to a large bulletin board that is hung over a simple wooden desk and its matching chair.  A cast iron stove, its chimney piped out of the southern wall, occupies one corner of the space, while a rough oak ladder leads to the second floor.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Rising dark and ominous into the sky, a large wooden guard tower overlooks the tapered points of the surrounding colony walls. title: [Logging Colony, Tig's Barn]
description: Patches of mud, dried and cracked on the edges, dominate the entry to high-ceilinged stables, while sash windows tilted open allow the coastal air to slip through the humid confines.  Tidy bales of hay, straw, and rushes surround support posts that are evenly spaced down the various lanes.  The whiny and nickering of stalled animals fills the air.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Water Terrace]
description: A stunning backdrop of vertical limestone faces meet with a more substantial, horizontal plane of granite that form this spacious, above-ground terrace.  Rushing water cascades down in a frothy white display of force, pooling across the black granite surface in crystal clear sheets that sparkle with reflections of golden sunlight.  In the distance, the sound of waves against the shore provides a rhythmic melody.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: A steady *drip-drip-drip* echoes off of every facet of the surrounding rock walls, lending a near-deafening reverberation to the cramped, enclosed space.  Directly overhead and continuing down one wall, a deep fissure  proves to be the source of the watery incursion.  A spiderweb of cracks spreading from it lend an air of impending danger to this part of the tunnel.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, northwest, down, out

title: [Kraken's Fall, Beach]
description: Ebbing and flowing, the lapping waves darken the glistening sands as they soak the edges of a beach illuminated by bamboo torches.  Rough stone stairs rise to the northwest providing access to the road above, each smooth stone step cut directly into the cliff face, which gradually descends into dunes to the southeast.  Set back from the water, an enormous circular pedestal supports a large dolphin statue, the back of which is illuminated from light that spills out of a stone-lined angular archway built into the bluff.

Ebbing and flowing, the lapping waves darken the glistening sands as they soak the edges of a beach dotted with bamboo torches.  Rough stone stairs rise to the northwest providing access to the road above, each smooth stone step cut directly into the cliff face, which gradually descends into dunes to the southeast.  Set back from the water, an enormous circular pedestal supports a large dolphin statue that casts its shadow upon a stone-lined angular archway built into the bluff.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Mantle's Landing]
description: Encased by a small railing, the curving road affords an unobstructed view of the sea and sky.  Rough stone stairs descend to the local beach, their smooth faces carved right into the bedrock of the cliff-face and flanked by a looped rope railing anchored with driftwood.  Bright glaesine lanterns flicker with green and blue lights upon their wrought iron pedestals as they create circles of illumination on an elegantly appointed bar.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Sky Terrace]
description: This open-air terrace juts from the mountain at a dizzying height.  A bird's-eye view of the town of Kraken's Fall spreads out below, its cobblestone streets basking in the warmth of the sun.  The rising and falling swells of the blue-green ocean stretch toward the distant horizon.  The gentle fragrance of the forest below dances lanquidly within the cool mountain breeze.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Cool air currents waft through the wide tunnel passage, making it a refreshingly pleasant environ compared to other parts of the underground tunnel nearby.  A small pool of clear, cold water draws many visitors, as evidenced by the tracks of skittering crabs and slithering lizards left in the sand beside the water.  Lichen, liverwort, and tiny ferms cling to small cracks and fissure along the pale limestone walls.

title: [Rock Lobster]
description: This tiny restaurant only has a few seats, most of which are empty and waiting for customers.  Bright yellow paint and ocean views in blue frames adorn the walls, which are lined with windows that overlook the roiling waters on the horizon.  Floating between the cramped tables, a distracted waitress moves plates to and from a kitchen window that produces delectable aromas.  A blue mandolin has been mounted above the entrance of this establishment, while a sturdy chair has been placed nearby.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Lava Terrace]
description: Bursts of molten, orange-red magma bubble up from the center of the ever-expanding terrace.  Once ejected from hidden tubes deep within the earth, the viscous lava flows across the black and crackled surface, adding additional depth to the cooled pathways along the terraced perimeter.  Steam rises in plumes from pockets of cooling crust near a porous lava rock fissure, and a fine-grained ash chokes the air before being wafted away by the incoming sea breezes.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: The pale grey walls give the impression of closing in as this portion of the tunnel narrows to form a tightly confined space.  Passage is made more difficult by the presence of fallen rocks, obliterating what once may have been an accessible path.  A tremendous heat generating from the floor and walls makes them almost too hot to touch.  A reddish glow emanates from the edges of a nearby fissure.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Earth Terrace]
description: A substrate of igneous rock supports an earth-covered expanse just beyond the nearby cavern.  An abundance of plant life thrives in the open air.  Delicate ferns and mosses grow in and beside a ragged fissure, while grasses and arboreal specimens proliferate farther out toward the terrace edges.  The salty fragrance of sea air drifts lightly on the occasional breezes.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Multihued minerals paint the surrounding rock walls in shades of green, yellow, and white.  Colorful crystals, only a few inches high, cling to the stone floor and attempt the mighty climb toward the ceiling.  Skittering noises and the clacking of claws filter in from a deeper part of the tunnel.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: This area of the crater rim is flat enough to traverse upon reliably, though the footing is deep with volcanic ash.  Progress can be made west or northeast as well as back down a cliff face to the volcanic slopes far below.  Sulfuric gasses billow from the crater to the north and to the south is an unfettered view of Kharam Dzu and the waters of the ocean surrounding Teras Isle.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Face]
description: A way to the crater rim can be seen above, but only the most careful and patient climbers may make it to the top.  Progress further east is hindered by an unclimbable rocky buttress, and downward is a fall so great it would surely kill the most hearty of adventurers.  Though the basalt is crumbling it may be possible to shimmy west across the exposed rock.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Black Stone Beach]
description: Flanked by two prominently displayed torches, the wide opening of a water-slicked cave looms large atop a rocky promontory.  To the east, an expansive view of the whitecapped ocean stretches toward the horizon.  The thunderous crashing of waves against the shoreline drowns out all but the loudest of sounds from the nearby town and the piers in the distance.  Overhead, gulls cry out and scan the surroundings in search of an easy meal.

title: [Limestone Cave, Entry]
description: An open expanse welcomes visitors to this artificially illuminated cavity formed deep within the earth.  The sheer size of it illustrates the effect of centuries of dissolution of the porous limestone by acidic groundwater.  Scorch marks and a heavy layer of soot mar the faces of several naturally formed columns affixed with brightly burning sconces.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Rotted Cabin]
description: Tangled vines of kelp descend from the cracked ceiling, the rotting vegetation filling the dank cabin with an unhealthy stench.  Haloed by an eerie green light, a fissure in the wall provides a means of escape, as does a brass-tacked ladder.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Curling paint clings to the walls, largely due to barnacles imbedded in the wood, while clumps of seaweed create a slick walking space upon a moldy carpet with metallic cording.  To the east and west the passage is blocked by debris and a heavy, unpleasant odor.  A fissure in a northwestern corner is haloed in an eerie green light that spills from a frosted globe wedged into the floor.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Makiri Market]
description: At the edge of the bazaar the storefronts are squarer, and the architecture is much simpler in design, but showy finery prevails in the elaborate scrollwork and vibrant coloring of the window displays.  One central shop draws inspiration from the shore, brandishing iridescent mother-of-pearl and sea glass mosaic panels around the doorway.

title: [Grubbe Hub]
description: Chain-strung lanterns hang unlit above the earthen-walled dwelling.  A lopsided wooden table stands across the cramped room from a filthy glass-covered counter.  Floating in through a small round window, the salty air mingles with the scents of recently prepared dishes.  Nailed into the hardened dirt walls, a wrinkled folded notecard appears closely guarded by a heavily armored kobold.

title: [A Great Offense]
description: The plush emerald green rug covers most of the fel wood that form the floor of the wagon.  Placed up against one wall is a long birch table, while a tall sycamore display and a thin pine rack line the opposite.  A scratched kelyn hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [A Great Offense, Storage]
description: Boxes and crates are stacked haphazardly along the walls of this storage area.  The area in one corner remains vacant of clutter, save for a padded beech bench and a small lumpy cot sitting perpendicular to each other.  A burnished bronze lamp hangs on the wall barely a foot above the cot.

title: [Saddle Me Up]
description: Dirt and dust hang in the air, visibly twirling about with every little movement.  Horse tack is strewn about the area, the vast majority of it broken and abused collections of reins, bridles, straps, stirrups, and saddles, none of which seem to be actual sales merchandise.  Somewhat hidden amongst the clutter, a small halfling mutters to herself, loudly smacking her gums and rolling her eyes as she lounges against a display rack and idly kicks at several unfinished saddle trees at her feet.

title: [Cysaelotar, Whispering Boughs]
description: Wind sweeps across the tundra as it departs from high granite peaks in the distance towards the low valley, its gossamer fingers causing a nearby strand of spindle-trunked birch to rattle and sway.  Colorful leaves of verdant and gold hues dapple the reed-thin boughs, generating a soft whisper that carries through the area.  Bristle-headed black sedge and wide-bladed alpine grass mingles together across the slight incline as it travels south, while a narrow track winds its way further up the mound to the north.

title: [Cervidae Corral]
description: Bright blue, green, and red canopies stretch across a slender corridor created between the various corrals that stretch across the mixed grass and sedge ground.  Shepherd's crooks are bolted to the tall posts that flank a copper and oak gate, the lanterns dangling from them dormant for the moment.

Shepherd's crooks are bolted to the tall posts that flank a copper and oak gate, each dangling a lantern that spills golden light upon the area.

title: [Common Cervidae Paddock]
description: Unkempt and wide, the ground is covered in wild sedge and blue-green grass, which is lazily being munched on by the various animals that wander about the open space.  The corral stretches southward, providing ample space for grazing and herd mingling.

title: [Covert Couriers, Basement]
description: Filth and grime cover every inch of the surfaces down here.  A small wet drip plinks somewhere off in the dark, and a musty stench permeates the air.  The only light to speak of glimmers through the warped floorboards above your head.

title: [Covert Couriers]
description: Heavy coats of black paint cover the windows of the room, smeared with just enough strokes to guarantee dubious privacy to the shoppers while still allowing in minute trickles of light.  Despite the scented beeswax candles placed haphazardly around the room, an astringent, almost metallic, scent lingers in the air.

title: [Hinterwilds, Cave Entrance]
description: A clearing spans the space before a craggy cave that delves into a hillock of stone at the briar's edge.  Scents of spoor and decay spice the otherwise pristine air, enduring despite the nasty gale that shivers through the bramble patch.  Great paw prints congregate around the cave entrance.

title: [Hinterwilds, Warg Den]
description: Gnawed bones and shed white hair form a treacherous carpet on the floor of the den.  The cave mouth is at an angle that shields the interior from the wind, and while still chilly, the little enclosure is spared the worst of the elements.  A low ceiling curves to form the rear wall of the cave, onto which primitive figures are drawn in old, flaking pigments.  The distinctive musk of canines suggests that the den is still very much in use.

title: [Secret Tunnel, Entrance]
description: Spilled mead, long since dried, has leaked through the floorboards that form the ceiling of the underground passage.  The liquid has left behind sticky patches on the walls and ground of the tunnel end and fills the air with a stale sourness.   Descending as it travels east, the tunnel swiftly moves beyond the feeble illumination creeping in through the slatted boards overhead.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Mead Hall]
description: The remains of a bar the height of a tall giantman bisect the cavernous hall.  Spattered with raven droppings, the bar is bared to the elements by the crumbling roof, and the aurora's ghostly glow plays over the hall's interior.  Sharply pungent, the tang of spilled mead fends off the odor of char, but it has left the floorboards tacky in places.

title: [Eldurhaart, Heart Tree]
description: A huge hoarbeam tree has far outgrown the boundaries of its species, stretching its enormous limbs toward the sky.  Spherical lanterns are suspended from braided iron links woven through the old giant's gnarled branches.  Within a hollow at the base of the still-living colossus is a grand hall open to the elements.  A series of steps formed from the tree's twisted roots rises up to the hall's cavernous entrance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Eldurhaart, High Hall]
description: Arched beams of polished yew support the high peaked roof of the high hall, each carved with a pattern reminiscent of winding scales.  The air is warm and close and heavily tinged with char, and above, a colossal draconic head of carved spruce looks down over the entryway with cruelly narrowed eyes.  Rough-hewn stairs rise from the stone floor toward a dais in the north, which appears to be source of the heat and flickering firelight that casts the entryway in such ominous shadow.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Entryway]
description: Rich ivory granite walls provide a stark contrast to the warm polished mahogany floor.  A tall intricately carved lor grandfather clock is set against the right wall, while a vibrant tapestry bearing the image of a crest hangs on the left.  A sweeping dual staircase leads to the upper floor, creating an alcove occupied by a carved lor table.  A clear glass dome centered in the ceiling allows sunlight to bathe the area.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Bedroom]
description: Set along the east side of the expansive room is a pair of arched windows flanking a central set of nearly identical arched double doors.  Sunlight spills across the dark-stained mahogany floor, embracing an expansive cedar wardrobe.  Centered between a pair of lor nightstands, a cushioned back-panel bed rests against the wall opposite an elaborate fireplace.  Twin caramel-hued couches surround a modest oval glass table atop a rectangular dark ochre and ivory rug near the fireplace.

title: [Aurora's Light, Pasture]
description: Black-eyed daisies with bright yellow petals sprout from the long tufts of grass that grow around the posts of a whitewashed fence that encircles a grassy pasture.  Towering modwirs provide pockets of shade along the edges of the field, the reaching limbs brushing the roof of a nearby stable whose large stable doors gleam in the sunlight.  Twin lanterns clutched in the feet of rosin meadowlarks reflect prismatic light from their perch to either side of an angled staircase that leads to the stable's second story.
