title: [Aurora's Light, Loft]
description: Brilliant blue, polished haon floorboards are covered by a smattering of wooly bright white rugs, the lush floor coverings creating cozy social circles along the sharply angled western wall.  Round, high-backed chairs encircle a small carved table near a mahogany writing desk, while an oversized bright white armchair sits katy-corner beneath the watchful gaze of several meadowlark lanterns.  Near the exit, a pot-bellied cast iron stove, a rhimar-inlaid polished white chest, and a series of hanging baskets create a cozy and organized kitchenette.
b.location: Aurora's Light Stables, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Below Deck, Corridor]
description: Portholes mark both ends of the long corridor, the verdigris copper standing out on the mahogany walls.  Shield lanterns sway as the boat gently rocks at harbor, casting shadows upon the sparse white oak planks that fashion the floor.  A teak and steel stairway leads to the deck above, while a glossy oak door with a bronze placard reading, "Pinned and Pleated" leads deeper inside.

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Decent]
description: Sheltered by the icy overhang of the forecastle decking, an oak and glass door lays mostly in shadows as elliptical patterns of snow and sea salt dance across the deck.  Ropes stretch from the main mast, which is encircled by a bronze ring, towards the distant railings where pulleys assist in the manipulation of the behemoth.  Just a few steps towards the bow, an oilcloth-covered companionway of inky black rises from the flooring.

Radiating from around the copper housing of the foremast, rays of birch are inlaid into the teak decking to create the image of a sun within a dark sky, the design shadowed by the dusting of snow across the ground.  Nearby, a shelter acts as a companionway to the floor below and is covered with weather-treated oilcloth to keep ice from slicking the stairs.  The muffled sound of rattling ropes and pulleys draws attention to the lashed and furled sails, the sky blue fabric dangling thin icicles from above.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Pinned and Pleated]
description: Exposed rafters line the roof of the cabin, the constant creak and roll of the ship causing various hangings to sway and the sound of creaking to slip through the balmy air.  Rolled and bound to a support post is an off-white and navy blue hammock, which leaves room for a trio of mannequins to be displayed between copper-ringed portholes.  Tidy shelves dominate the one solid wall and are filled with tidily folded pieces of fabric, bowls filled with pins, and baskets of cording.

title: [Looter's Lair, Docks]
description: Built against the northern wall of the cavern is a sturdy dock crafted of thick, heavy timbers, which are covered with slick algae and tangled knots of seaweed.  Several boats are tied to the edge of the dock, while a long rough wooden ladder rises upon to its main platform.  Narrowing perceptively, the thin channel of water that leads further into the cave is blocked with large boulders, making passage via boat impossible.

title: [Looter's Lair, Depths]
description: Conical stalactites dimly glow with a faint greenish hue and have a sheen of water covering their rough surfaces.  Almost musical, the sound of the water dripping from the large rock formations echoes through the space.  Large and small puddles pock-mark the floor of the cave, whose southeastern edge drops off suddenly into a thin channel of water far below.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Corridor]
description: Circular in shape, simple paneling covered in a thick layer of whitewash lines the walls of the open corridor.  Set into one part of the inner hall is a varnished oak door with a crude trident etched into the lintel above.  Along another section is an iron-bound oak ladder that leads higher into the lighthouse.  Looking over a cast iron railing, one can see into the lowest chamber below.

title: [Lantern Room]
description: Panes of clear crystal are set into brass framework to create this small light chamber.  Centered in the room is a hollowed-out stone filled with fish oil.  A ring of copper lanterns hangs from the top of the chamber centered above the depression with individual wicks leading from the light source down into the liquid below.  Looking out through the glass on one side is a perfect view of the town, while on the other a beautiful glimpse of the vast ocean.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Tunnel]
description: A few torches line the tunnel as it winds its way through the mountain.  Fluorescent toadstools have been placed as markers for the location of a dark oak door and a heavy pine door.  A rhythmic dripping sound echoes from deeper within the tunnel.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Iron Room]
description: Torches and toadstools alike have been placed around this meeting room in order to keep it well lit.  In each corner of the room rests a set of polished iron armor upon a stand, and expertly forged shields hang along the far wall.  A long, broad table covered with documents rises from the floor in the center of the room.  A large oak chair stands at the head of the table, while several shorter stone chairs have been neatly arranged along the sides.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing - Urchin Hideout]

title: [First Elanith Bank, Teller]
description: Most of the teller windows that line this room are missing the gates and gratings that once secured them.  Impatient clients stand at one of the two intact windows, waiting to get the attention of the tellers on the other side.

title: [Icemule Trace - Urchin Hideout]

title: [Icemule Trace, Bank]
description: A row of highly polished brass teller windows lines the back wall of the bank.  Staggered in height from short to tall, their ledges comfortably accommodate travellers of all sizes.  Suspended from the ceiling is a gilded silver sign.

title: [Bank of Vornavis, Solhaven]
description: Dark panelled walls rise above you, culminating in a carved coffered ceiling.  The plush burgundy carpets are silent underfoot.  Merchants and townsfolk mill about, speaking in hushed, reverent whispers.  Three teller windows are open, the quiet clink of coins drifting from within.

title: [River's Rest - Urchin Hideout]

title: [River's Rest Bank, Teller]
description: Unlike the other buildings in this town, this one is built of stone blocks, and decorated with wood beams.  When you realize that it is protecting the wealth of all who do business here, you can understand why.  Heavily armed guards watch over the lobby although you notice one flirting with a pretty elven teller who is currently between customers.  The window she is standing at is protected by heavy metal bars and appears to be very secure.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth]
description: Two heavily heavily barred windows set just above a small marble ledge are the only items of real interest in this barren yet elegant lobby.  The walls, ceiling and floor, though, speak of a wealth of silvers that have enriched the owners of the establishment.  Two dwarves mill about behind the windows, counting coins, writing notes, and conducting the customary bank business.  A gilded sign, affixed to the wall between the two windows, gives information on the use of the bank's services.

A small but elegant wrought iron chandelier hangs from the ceiling above, its amber glaesine globes casting a warm hue across the room.

The rich blue carpeting underfoot muffles the sound of movement as patrons conduct their business in hushed tones and move back out into the lobby.  The teller sits behind a tall counter, flanked by two elven guards.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Hanging Gardens]
description: Although the floating platform is suspended well above the ground below, it overflows with abundant plant life.  The edges of the dais are brimming with delicate white queen's lace, dark lavender, fragrant rosemary and a variety of other colorful flora.  Thick grass underfoot provides an enticingly peaceful resting spot.  A thin silk canopy is suspended above, providing ample shade from the day's brightness.

The edges of the dais are brimming with delicate white queen's lace, dark lavender, fragrant rosemary and a variety of other colorful flora.  Thick grass underfoot provides an enticingly peaceful resting spot.  A thin silk canopy is rolled back to permit an unobstructed view of the starry night sky.

The dais is ringed by a series of slender columns, each one simply fluted and carved from perfectly white marble.  Within the circle of the columns' embrace, and elevated high off of the ground, a tiny garden of cultivated plants grows.  Closed roses climb around the carved legs of a mistwood bench, which sits alongside neat beds of night blooming columbine and a tended plot of white jasmine.  Over the whole enclosure is a coffered dome set with an oculus.

title: [The Bank of Kharam-Dzu]
description: Surly dwarves grumble in line, clutching their coin-purses to their chests.  Opposite the doors is a high, black steel counter.  A spectacled dwarf is perched behind it, squinting at you from atop his tall chair.  All around him, bald heads and flailing hands bob up and down frantically.  The clinking of coins mixes with giggles of glee from the back.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Tower]
description: The view from the tower is spectacular.  The city is spread out before you, huddled in a valley beneath the great mountain Stormbrow.  Far to the northeast, beyond the walls, the sky is lit with a dim, red glow.  To the northwest, you see only mist.  A white glaes statue of a dwarf stands tall on a podium, gazing over the town.

title: [Kraken's Fall Bank, Teller]
description: A wide wooden counter spans the entire width of this room, and interspersed across its top are heavy iron bars a handsbreadth apart, securely fastened to both the counter and the stone ceiling overhead.  A glossy black placard inlaid with gold leaf text is prominently placed above a single gap in the center of the iron supports.  Three stern-looking guards stand at the ready, their hands near their weapons as they track every movement in the room.

title: [Cysaegir Bank]
description: Simple wooden teller windows fitted with glaes panes stand open to service the many Aelotoi men and women bustling about.  A domed skylight allows sunshine to stream in, glinting off the silver coins being transferred, withdrawn, and deposited.  Vivid butterflies have been painted flitting across the pale pink and blue-tinted stone walls.

title: [Isle of Four Winds - Urchin Hideout]
[the Isle of Four Winds - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Four Winds Bank, Teller Windows]
[Mist Harbor Bank, Bank Windows]
description: A magnificent bouquet of freshly cut orchids sits on a table at the center of the room.  Beneath it, an intricate mosaic depicting a scene from one of the island's gardens is inlaid upon the wood floor.  Behind a long counter stretching from wall to wall, tellers are busy helping customers.  Casually dressed guards stand at each end of the counter, quietly watching the room.  Mounted on the ceiling, a massive woven palm frond fan softly whirrs as its tiny pulleys help keep the room nice and comfortable.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Large and acoustically well proportioned, the stage opens expectantly to the auditorium -- lights and curtains, tabs and borders, all are cleverly placed to entice the audience's eye.  A semitransparent scrim hangs at the back from the grid of metal framework above.  A wide apron at the front of the stage completes the space, from which every seat in the house can be seen.

title: [Bard Guild, Performance Hall]
description: The auditorium is cavernous, and every inch of the curved ceiling appears to be covered in vividly colored frescos.  The walls are a combination of polished mahogany and painted panels that equal the ceiling in decoration.  Tiers of seats descend toward a stage at the hall's far end, their ranks upholstered in crimson velvet that matches red carpet runners traversing the aisles between them.  A row of small lanterns illuminates the front of the stage.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Tatters of old spiking - strips of tape to indicate where pieces of scenery are to be placed - mark the worn black floor.  Dark blue velour tab curtains hang to right and left, creating offstage wings.  Large overhead lamps light the stage, hidden from the audience by blue velour border curtains.

title: [Bard Guild, Auditorium]
description: The walls and ceiling of the large auditorium are crafted of thin beams of honey-colored oak, all assembled in an elegant design calculated to enhance the room's acoustics.  Rows of benches march down the floor's gentle descent, toward a stage at the far end of the hall.  Indigo blue runners muffle footsteps, matching dark blue velvet curtains framing the stage.  A row of lanterns sits across the stage's lip, like gargoyles guarding a tower's heights.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Smooth and inviting, the boards of the stage floor stretch evenly from upstage to down.  Overhead, booms and battens rub elbows with the light bridge - the narrow platform behind the teaser curtain, from which lighting instruments are hung.  Framed in velvet curtains, the opening across the proscenium and into the auditorium fairly calls with expectancy.

title: [Jastev Amphitheater]
description: Tiers of carved stone seats descend in orderly, semi-circular waves toward a stage at the lower end of the open-air amphitheater.  Overhead, the sky provides a black velvet ceiling, sparkling with stars and the moons.  Cerulean blue stage curtains as well as the stage itself are shielded from any inclement weather by an overhanging roof.

Tiers of carved stone seats descend in orderly, semi-circular waves toward a stage at the lower end of the open-air amphitheater.  Overhead, the sky provides a brilliant blue ceiling, studded with occasional passing clouds.  Cerulean blue stage curtains as well as the stage itself are shielded from any inclement weather by an overhanging roof.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]

title: [Theatre Andaire]
description: The stage, its underpinnings carved of rich darkly stained maoral, sits recessed into the theatre's back wall.  Thick garnet-hued velvet curtains, trimmed with glimmering golden cords and tassels, hang across the wall, providing a lush backdrop to the stage.  Creatively shuttered glaesine lanterns hanging from the rafters above direct warm golden light at the stage while leaving the seating area in almost complete darkness.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Stage]
description: The stage lighting -- created by evenly spaced oil lamps hung over the proscenium -- illuminates the wide-planked stage.  A new coat of polish is unable to hide the scuffs and marks left by decades of actors.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Auditorium]
description: The Performance Hall is a grand chamber filled with rows of cushioned benches facing a stage at the far end.  The stage has generous proportions -- heavy indigo curtains flank it on either side.  A row of lanterns placed along its lip are hooded on the sides facing the audience, with all their illumination directed toward center-stage.

title: [Bard Guild, Aerie Pub]
description: The Pub is a comfortable chamber, open on the west to a view of town and sea, as well as an imposing outlook of the Aerie Auditorium floating at a similar altitude.  A number of tables offer seating, each with distinctive design echoing that of the Aerie and its supporting column.  Across the south wall of the Pub is a long bar, crafted of polished teak and rolaren hardware shined to a high gloss.

title: [Aerie Pub, Aria Table]
description: The Aria table rises from its narrow foot with elegance, the pedestal carved in fine detail.  Beginning with a narrow circumference, it flares as it lifts, until it finally concludes at the carved, circular top.  Across the teak tabletop is another masterful carving, depicting a complex series of interweaving musical staffs with accompanying notes and accents.  A large conch shell has been converted into a lantern, which sits at the table's center.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Framed with aquamarine curtains and tabs, with a wide proscenium and tapered wings, the stage provides easily accessible space for any type of performance.  Footlights and lanterns hung overhead provide lighting to heighten the effect.

title: [Bard Guild, Aerie Auditorium]
description: The Aerie is a monumental construction, possessing a vast interior that captures the essence of floating within a cloud.  Cantilevered sections of the ceiling cascade down toward a stage at the far end of the chamber, naturally amplifying any discourse occurring there.  Rows of seats crafted of light-toned teak are set in descending rows, and the floor and stage curtains are tinted a soft tone of aquamarine, completing an overall schema of airiness and light.  Three vaulted arches provide exits.

title: [Abbey, Teleportation Chamber]
description: Beyond a rose gold and marble arch rests a small chamber with a low, rough ceiling, the floor composed of concentric blocks of stone.  Attended by several robed acolytes, a luminous sliver is suspended at the center of the room.  It crackles occasionally, bathing the surroundings in green and gold light.

title: [Sparkfinger's Alchemy, Workroom]
description: Uneven light from the aurora wavers through windows of brown glass, glinting off of bubbles in the panes.  Several glowing lamps supplement the weak lighting, awakening glints and gleams from multicolored bottles on lopsided shelves lining the walls.  Behind a steel-topped counter, bubbles froth feverishly within a collection of beakers and flasks filled with multifarious fluids.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Trail]
description: A grass-covered knoll rises up to the west with a dark tunnel leading into its interior.  Thick bushes cover the ground, growing wild in both shape and direction.  Extending out from the hillside is a rough dirt path which cuts through the shrubbery with a series of hearty weeds taking hold along its route.

title: [Dusty Tunnel]
description: A faint breeze drifts in from the tunnel mouth, bringing with it a fresh scent and helping to dispel any lingering must in the air.  What began as a few patches on the rocky ground slowly turns into a packed dirt fully covering it.  A large opening stands at the far end of the tunnel leading to the outside.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Slipping through a red-speckled carpet of bearberry shrubs, a serpentine track follows the wide curve of the northeastern hillock.  Peaked tents draped in jewel-toned bourde are staggered along the verdant slope amid sunlit sprays of blooming snow gentian.  Shielded baskets filled with fire shed a comfortable heat throughout the area, the flames within hissing and snapping in defiance to the ever-present alpine winds.

Peaked tents draped in jewel-toned bourde are staggered along the verdant slope amid moonlit sprays of blooming snow gentian.  Shielded baskets filled with fire shed a comfortable heat throughout the area, the flames within hissing and snapping in defiance to the ever-present alpine winds.

title: [Ewe Vixen]
description: Canvas stretches across a sturdy oak frame, creating a small booth with an open front that faces the winding caravan trail.  Travel and loose shale cover the ground, crunching as guests come and go within the cramped shelter.  Long tables line the walls, while a series of copper hooks land in various ornaments hang from their affixed position along the oak beams.

title: [Iyo Glade, Meadow]
description: A small congregation of ducks lies sleeping just off the path in this area, nestled amongst the deeper recesses of the grassy meadow.  The pathway branches here, allowing for passage around the pond while also winding towards a small copse of trees to the north.  A neatly tended garden of bright wildflowers sits across the trail from the sleeping ducks, suffusing the air with a light, delicate aroma.

title: [Sticks and Stones, Hollow]
description: Buzzing fills the hollow interior of this massive mistwood tree.  The occasional bee flits past you, gone in an instant as it heads up from a rabble of the tiny creatures defensively swarming the entrance from intrusion.  Gnarled growths along the walls form a series of narrow ledges that ascend into a massive honeycomb hive covered in busy worker drones.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Foyer]
description: This room is alive with the near-constant happy warbling emanating from a large polished brass gilded cage containing a pair of bluebirds.  Formed from unfinished logs, the walls of the cabin are crafted and fitted so perfectly that none of the frigid air from outside can be felt.  A series of polished silver hooks are imbedded in the wood at eye height directly adjacent to the oak door, and a small stool sits just beneath them.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Garden]
description: A broken-down farm house stands just inside the wooden archway, its empty door and broken windows leering over the snow-filled garden.  A dilapidated barn slumps into the snow to the north of the garden.  To the southeast, a thin trail leads around the corner of the house.

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Armory]
description: Thick walls of square-riveted iron cover the large room from floor to ceiling, the wrought metal gate framed by chainmail scabbards and narrow racks affixed vertically next to cormorant-shaped lanterns.  Iron-ringed drawers encircle the perimeter, the half-opened containers filled with vials and pouches of unknown substances.  Sigils of red-stained paint cover the visible surface of the stone staircase, the layers of repainting creating splatters of dried flakes across the metal floor.
a.location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Observatory]
description: A circular table carved from gilt-veined marble dominates the mahogany-planked room, its surface covered with a small scale model of Elanthia and its waterways.  Iron-framed windows flank an antiqued gold telescope, leaving a pair of tall leather-backed chairs to hold back the heavy curtains fashioned of faded pirate flags.  A collection of weaponry is displayed above an unadorned slate fireplace, the mantle stacked with nautical charts and volumes.
b.location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Winding as aimlessly as the river once did, paths overgrown with tall verdant marshgrass split off from the main artery toward multiple residences, each decorated with iron lanterns that creak noisily in the warm, light breeze.  Large patches of soggy ground begin to cluster together, some forming shallow pools along the wandering trail.

title: [A Vague Inkling, Showroom]
description: Walls of pale grey stone enclose the spacious building, while thick rafters of oak support the layers of a compact thatched roof.  Partially covering the polished wooden floor is an oval braided rug mixed with a wide range of green.  Centered in the room is a live-edge maple table draped with a forest green velvet runner.  Next to a curtain-draped archway is a series of bronze hooks fashioned in the shape of various skeletal creatures.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Rooftops appear behind high green reeds scattered along the gently sloping riverfront, the muddy strand trampled with myriad footprints.  Luminous white pebbles litter the shoreline creating a rough path away from the water's edge, through the reeds and disappearing over a grassy bank.  An assortment of abandoned luggage is piled high in a small white boat run aground on the eastern riverbank.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The split rail fence bordering the path extends straight to the river's edge, thus far hidden by the mists, then levels off to transition into the railing of a shallow but wide dock.  A pair of coils of heavy rope rest near the railing, while the far opposite end of the dock is occupied by a bunch of halved cider barrels.  Twin pendant lanterns dangle from mooring posts on opposite sides of the platform, with a small space to directly access the river left in the middle.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: In the space between several broken headstones, the ground has been cleared of grass and granite, all marble and vines swept away to make room for a pitched wood fire and a massive cast iron cauldron.  The legs of the cauldron loft the receptacle well above the flames, which are balefire green, and its contents glow with a sickly celadon hue, with gouts of mists creeping over the rim to spill out onto the ground.  Behind it are several vaults arranged in sets.

title: [The Witching Family Vault]
description: Within the hallowed walls of the massive vault lie a pair of black marble tombs nestled into two shallow depressions in the floor, both carved into elven figures lying in repose.  Silver sconces set high on the walls flank the tombs, while a black iron candelabra stands lit between them.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: In the space between several broken headstones, the ground has been cleared of grass and granite, all marble and vines swept away to make room for a pitched wood fire and a massive cast iron cauldron.  The legs of the cauldron loft the receptacle well above the flames, which are balefire green, and its contents glow with a sickly celadon hue, with gouts of mists creeping over the rim to spill out onto the ground.  Behind it are several vaults arranged in sets.

title: [The Vamped Vault]
description: Dusky, autumnal shades of carnelian, gold, and foxfire green pour through stained glass window panes encircling the elongated vault, the blanched stone flooring dappled in the warm tones.  A raised beveled ledge solidly frames the bare walls, adjacent to a finely woven rowan case and a massive cast iron cauldron resting at the center of the space.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The path curves slightly westward here around a both ancient and very dead tree.  Its leafless limbs stretch up and out, over the path toward the sky, as if searching for something unknowable like a penitent at prayer.  Though dead, the tree is sturdy and hale, with black bark and crevices between the clusters of branches and within the trunk itself that invite investigation.  Beneath the tree's menacing guard are several crypts in a row, spaced out on either side of its looming countenance.

title: [Flasked with a Purpose]
description: A thick curtain of star jasmine blankets the crypt's cobbled stone walls, offering a touch of color to an otherwise gloomy area.  Empty bottles repurposed into candle holders line the floors amidst large globs of melted wax and beetle carapaces.  Centered in the room is a nondescript stone platform supporting a large iron urn decorated in carved grape clusters.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The path curves slightly westward here around a both ancient and very dead tree.  Its leafless limbs stretch up and out, over the path toward the sky, as if searching for something unknowable like a penitent at prayer. Beneath the tree's menacing guard are several crypts in a row, spaced out on either side of its looming countenance.

title: [The Sorrowwood Crypt, Entry]
description: A few guttering candles valiantly battle the subterranean gloom, their wan illumination casting peculiar shadows on the walls that appear to lurch drunkenly at the slightest hint of a draft.  Flanking a darkened passageway, a tatterdemalion statue of a one-winged fairy presents an outstretched tray for perusal, and a cracked marble sculpture of a kneeling sea nymph offers a peek into a lidless coffret on her lap.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]

title: [Winning Shriek, Rest]
description: Intricate dark-hued stains embellish the inner walls of this hallowed alcove, where ample space encircles the central burial vault, allowing unhibited movement.  Smooth, white ceramic tiles, worn by countless visitors, enclose the deceased, radiating outward along the cardinal points, while the interstices between them are embraced by the native ground's natural covering.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]

Beneath the tree's menacing guard are several crypts in a row, spaced out on either side of its looming countenance.

title: [Murky Tunnel]
description: A dark, cramped tunnel unwinds, ever-constricting as it continues, progressively more and more narrow as it descends steeply beneath the cemetery.  Inky black silence blankets everything, broken only by the occasional soft whisper of a sepulchral breeze.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Several freshly dug graves lie in a straight line parallel to the path, though none have markers except for one carelessly abandoned shovel shoved blade-first into the ground at the head of the last vacant hole.  The dense mist covering the ground largely avoids the empty graves, save for one in the middle, and there, tendrils of mist spill over the edge like long, distended fingers reaching in to dig something out.

title: [A Neatly Dug Rectangular Grave]
description: Apparently, this is a relatively deep hole, six feet deep and seven feet long by reckoning, seemingly rectangular in shape rather like...a grave.  It's a grave.  The size and dimensions, hard pack of the dirt, the precise cut of the walls, vertical and slightly intimidating from this angle, give it away.  Yep.  This is a grave.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Rising like a sentinel over the high grasses beyond the curving track, the skeletal remains of a once towering tree hunkers to the north.  Though leafless and decrepit, the arboreal colossus still spreads a shadow upon the land, expanding and contracting like long fingers of inky blackness grabbing at the round wooden entrances to homes built directly into the barrow.  A series of smooth-featured stones carved in various forms of supplication encircle the tree.

title: [Piper's Peepers]
description: Spindled roots dangle from the ceiling, nature finding a way to invade the home within the barrow despite thick rafters and heavy planking.  Copper-sided lanterns are spread throughout the space, their sides decorated in avians that create shadows on the rough walls and hard-packed dirt floor.  A simple cot rests in one corner near a fireplace, while a variety of containers in blue, red, and green are clustered near the exit.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Stairs]
description: Sinuous winged viper statues wrap around marble posts at the foot of a sweeping staircase leading up to a chandelier-lit landing.  The landing splits to the east and west, the carpeted steps climbing up and vanishing from sight.  From a high vantage point mid-flight, a young lady peers out from an oak-framed oil painting, her emerald eyes seeming to follow the retreating footsteps of the hotel guests.

title: [A Carpeted Landing]
description: Crystal droplets, pendants, and beads draped over an elaborate gold leaf frame create a dazzling display of illumination in the grand stairwell of the hotel.  Framed by gilded railings on both sides, the centerpiece is a sweeping, curved staircase, clad in polished mahogany and adorned with a crimson carpet featuring gold floral motifs.  A dried garland of purplish black hissing ivy and midnight belladonna cascades down each banister, filling the air with a sweet, yet acrid, fragrance.

title: [Winterbriar Orchard]
description: Dark green hedges with rime-touched briars grow tall and thick, separating the area from the town beyond, and dozens of fruit trees grow in perfectly neat rows along one side of a wide cobblestone path.  Across the path, several cozy homes are scattered across a tree-strewn meadow and tucked amidst the edge of the hedges.  Several smaller walkways lead off the main path to more distant structures, and the main path forks widely, offering a choice between southeasterly and southwesterly.

title: [Beneath the Philtrum]
description: Exposed rafters are covered in frosted globes that shed their bright light upon the wares that fill the shelving units that line the walls of the small but quaint shop.  Thick carpets dampen the chill that rises from the floor, while a riverstone fireplace has a banked fire laid in it that keeps the dampness from the air.  Several storage baskets are scattered along the walls, though noticeably vacant from the path of a nearby door.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Lake's Edge]
description: Several lake houses cluster near the snow-covered banks of Icebriar Lake, while others nestle between clusters of trees set to the other side of the cobblestone path that winds along the length of the lake.  Several snowmen loom atop large drifts of snow, many wielding weapons where stick hands would normally be found.  While most of the lake's shore is inaccessible, a single icy bank appears relatively safe, albeit guarded by a squat snowman with a claidhmore.

title: [Stillwater Timber, Salesroom]
description: A tall window framed in mahogany knotwork offers a picturesque view of Icebriar Lake.  Polished oak planks span the floor, their waxy sheen catching the soft glow of lanterns along the paneled walls.  Hollow stumps repurposed as bins cradle bundled branches, while iron-banded cases display an assortment of containers.  The faint resinous scent of freshly cut wood drifts in through a black and red check-patterned curtain leading to the workroom.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Haunted Bridge]
description: Dark cedars, rowan, and ash crowd together and join branches over the main path, casting eerie shadows across the area, and trails lead through the snow and underbrush to a variety of buildings.  A stream meanders to and fro with a twisting bridge arching from steep mossy bank to steep mossy bank.

title: [Smoldereye Lodge]
description: The ground floor of the tower is paneled in roughly hewn dark hardwoods and smooth, exposed riverstone.  Thousands of tiny facets of glimmering saewehna gems stud the ceiling overhead, arranged in patterns of constellations.  A thick engraved modwir shelf full of books runs along a section of the wall.  Arranged atop a massive tanik dresser are a mithril necklace stand and an engraved mistwood jewelry box.  A small curio cabinet displays a gold-banded keepsake chest.

title: [House of Twilight]
description: Curls of once decadent wallpaper are abandoning the wall in several places, leaving bare wood beneath, and cobwebs span every corner.  An archway, staircase, and door at the rear of the foyer are roped off, but a lintel-capped mistwood door stands open off to the side, framed on one side by a repurposed coat rack laden with harnesses and an old nail barrel with a plank top on the other.  A hastily written note is attached to the barrel, a small sign is attached to the rack, and a very large parchment notice hangs directly above a massive hole in the floor.

title: [A Neatly Dug Rectangular Grave]
description: Apparently, this is a relatively deep hole, six feet deep and seven feet long by reckoning, seemingly rectangular in shape rather like...a grave.  It's a grave.  The size and dimensions, hard pack of the dirt, the precise cut of the walls, vertical and slightly intimidating from this angle, give it away.  Yep.  This is a grave.

title: [The Witching House, Laboratory]
description: A shallow set of steps lead down into the laboratory, its surroundings less bland than one might expect of an underground room.  The walls are lined with ebonwood panels, with an embroidered silk tapestry decorating one large area, while an ebonwood apothecary cabinet dominates nearly the entirety of the back wall.  Opposite the cabinet is a sturdy glass-topped worktable and a long silver-wrought shelf hung high enough above to accommodate all of the alchemical tools beneath.  Between the end of the worktable and the steps that lead out is a round side table with a a black parchment note scribed in silver ink propped atop it.

title: [The Witching House, Foyer]
description: Glossy ebonwood floors stretch out from the door and across the room, with matching furniture that sits against walls with forest green, satin-sheened paper with an upper edging of onyx vines near the crown molding.  Ahead and slightly to the right is a satin cord-barred staircase, while a heavy ebonwood door has been placed beneath the railing on the side of the staircase.  To the left of the entrance is a wide ebonwood arch adorned with silver-drawn violet silk curtains that leads into a study, and another archway at the rear of the foyer offers a view of what must be a formal dining room.

title: [Vigil's End, Rocky Hillside]
description: Organically terraced by jagged, layered shale protrusions, the earth climbs northerly in a steep acclivity.  Brightly flowered groundcover blankets the treacherous terrain, their roots forcefully emerging from between the sheets of sedimentary rock.  Trimmed in an invar-braced marble arch, a fissure rends one of the short cliffs.  Under the meager shade offered by sparsely leaved trees, the asperous road, fraught with gaping cracks, picks a strategic path through the multitudinous hazards.

title: [Don't Bug Me!, Showroom]
description: Beyond the irregularly edged fissure that marks the entrance to this torch-lit space, the striated rock walls open up to reveal a modestly sized cave lined with iron shelving.  Moisture glistens off the walls and floor, dancing with scintillating sparkles as the reflected torchlight moves sinuously with the fluctuating passage of incoming air.

title: [Vigil's End, Armistice Avenue]
description: Towering over the broad pathway, an umbrageous oak sunders the cobblestones with eruptions of knotted roots.  A slatted ramp winds around the tree, its handrails ensnared in curling, wayward tendrils of spined vines strangling the enormous trunk.  Trimmed to boxy shapes, blossomed azalea bushes edge the residences lining the road.  Vibrantly painted wood shields trim the wraparound porch of a turreted brick house overlooking the blushed, floriated canopy to the south.

title: [Fiendish Phantomes, Athenaeum]
description: Massive open space has been hollowed out into the core of this tree, creating an interior pavilion with multiple arched outlets that peer deeper, through the tree's branches.  Carved into the oak walls of this dome are floor-to-ceiling bookshelves trimmed with faenor metalwork, each one depicting different vegetation.  The worn floor is covered in omnifarious parchments and half-torn books that are blanketed with dust and webbing.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Shadowed silhouettes of vultures roost within the knotty branches of an immense elm, a suit of lichen-encrusted armor slumped against the trunk.  Glass shards glitter in the weeds beneath the jagged-edged windows of a thatched roof bakery.  Nestled in brick and shingle rubble, a blackened boulder takes up residence within the adjacent destroyed shop.  Arrowheads and discarded weaponry sprinkle the muddied road with corroded debris.

title: [It's To Pie For, Bakery]
description: Their frightful faces flickering with fiery light, carved ghost pumpkins decorate the splintered shelves and dusty corners in festively arranged trios.  A display case stretches out from the maple counter, its glass front shattered over the petrified pies within.  Beside a rusty potbelly stove, taxidermy carrion birds perch on the mantel over a caved-in brick hearth, eternally caught in mid-flight.

title: [A. B. Witching, Tinkering]
description: Though subterranean, the chamber has been decorated to conceal that fact, with two walls lined with floor-to-ceiling witchwood bookcases, while the others are covered with a deep forest green wallpaper lined with thin stripes of metallic bronze.  Sconces are mounted meticulously at regular intervals between the lines, set with ivory candles that glow with viridian-sparked golden flames.  A narrow glass-shelved rack, with a witchwood humidor on the top shelf, stands beside a set of steep stairs leading downward.

title: [The Witching Family Vault]
description: Within the hallowed walls of the massive vault lie a pair of black marble tombs nestled into two shallow depressions in the floor, both carved into elven figures lying in repose.  Silver sconces set high on the walls flank the tombs, while a black iron candelabra stands lit between them.

title: [Sonreeva, Subterrane]
description: Smoke from burning torches lingers in the air, mixing with dust and causing the narrowing passage to feel more constricting.  Long curtains of cobwebs hang from the ceiling and walls, stirring slightly.

title: [Sonreeva, Dark Passageway]
description: Smoke from burning torches lingers in the air, mixing with dust and causing the narrowing passage to feel more constricting.  Long curtains of cobwebs hang from the ceiling and walls, stirring slightly.

title: [The Snowcat's Den, Cellar]
description: Barrels crowd the walls of the cellar, redolent with odors of brine.  Pitch seals most of them to protect the pickled contents.  Roots breach through the foundations of the inn toward the further verges of the cellar, having worked their inexorable way through the old stone.

title: [The Snowcat's Den, Parlor]
description: Light filters intimately through windows of smoky stained glass bearing scenes of the hunt, vivid reds commingling with the glistening golds and silvers of bright weaponry adorning the panes.  A capacious suede couch faces the translucent artwork, framed to either side by a burled maple endtable.  The sweet pungence of pipe smoke has permeated the walls and furnishings, and is a not unpleasant undertone to the aroma of roasting meat wafting from the kitchens.

title: [Crawling Shore, Sinkhole]
description: Swirling muck and sucking goo covers the bottom of the sinkhole, fed by a constant trickle of frigid seawater and sandy mud from above.  A rope ladder dangles from the sinkhole's aperture, which occupies a good third of its crumbling ceiling.  Nearby, a silver stake lies mostly submerged in the water.

title: [Crawling Shore, Sinkhole]
description: Seawater swirls slowly on the ground, carrying bits of muck toward a deep sucking sinkhole near the water's edge.  Up above, on a bluff with steeply cragged sides, rest signs of civilization in the rooftops and palisade walls of a small village.  Despite the buildings' presence, the breeze carries only the cries of gulls and the roar of the crashing waves.

title: [Moonsedge, Wildrose and Dirge]
description: Beneath the shelter of the walls flourish banks of sweetbriar, their petals like rubies in the dimness.  The perfume of the resplendent blossoms lingers on the air, heavy and saccharine.  At a join in the walls, a basalt guard tower climbs high into the air, gargoyles and grotesques lending their hideous grace to perches up its dark stone facade.

title: [Moonsedge, Guard Tower]
description: Racks of weapons, rusted to the point of uselessness, occupy the lower story of the watchtower.  Though blunted by corrosion, the deteriorating blades were obviously once of impressive make.  Stone steps climb in a spiral toward the tower's top, proceeding behind a curved wall adorned with a large crimson banner embroidered with a rising charcoal crescent moon with a briar sprig before it.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Ward]
description: The flagstones split into two distinct paths, one bending north toward the mouth of a small training yard sheltered by the castle walls.  Overgrown with grasses and weeds, the pathway is uncertain.  A clearer trail toward the castle's entrance leads past a dark tower stationed along the curtain wall.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Raven Loft]
description: Old droppings stain the stairs and coops of the rookery but have mostly been washed clean by rain and snow in the intervening years since the tower's abandonment.  They still lend a chalky white patina to the stone perches along the walls, which spiral up in a clockwise pattern toward the tower's ruined crown.  The collapsed ceiling leaves the zenith of the tower open to the moonlight and the forbidding shine of the stars.

The collapsed ceiling leaves the zenith of the tower open to the daylight, which blazes in cruelly.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Walkar Avenue]
description: Merchants busy themselves outside their pavilions, drawing large crowds to observe them work on their crafts.  Textiles of vibrant prismatic colors hang from a few posts of the outdoor shops, the fabrics eerily waving in the winds.  The constant clang of a hammer on metal reverberates from behind a large thatch-roofed building, a plume of dark smoke billowing upwards.  Several thin hounds dart about the street, scratching at barrels and pressing noses to the ground, fast on the trail of their next meal.

title: [The Blue Orchid]
description: Glass-paned lanterns hang from wooden beams along the ceiling casting a glow throughout the area.  The walls are decorated with several framed paintings of blue orchids, and a low counter is cluttered with an abundance of ink bottles and an assortment of needles.  Silk onyx curtains border a wide window, the display showcasing multi-hued stock tattoo drawings.  In the back, a muscular tattoo artist leans over a writing desk, an inked-hand diligently sketching a design on a piece of vellum.

title: [Gathering Dahcre Chamber]
description: Starlight from alabaster skylights gently illuminates this comfortable room, casting a soft light on the many exotic plants growing here.  A profusion of heat-loving tropical vines twine about a white-veined green marble fireplace, their flower-laden tips nearly covering a silver looking-glass set above the mantel.  Pots of bright crimson and gold dragonstalks nearly obscure a pinewood bar flanked by a pair of white, green, and silver banners.  A brilliant green faenor medallion caps the painted trellis archway leading into the room.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Shrine of Fate, Oratory]
description: Cool marble slabs stretch across the circular floor of the shrine, the alabaster hue fairly luminous in the sunlight that slips through the surrounding pillars.  At the heart of the structure is a decorative altar, long and wide; its smooth surface is rather plain while its sides are carved with basrelief images.  A trinity of statues, each a different female Artkati, stands between the pillars.

title: [Shrine of Fate, Altar]
description: Surrounded by carved columns, an altar rests at the center of a small shrine with a domed ceiling.  Cold air radiates from the smooth surface of the altar, veins of gold, cobalt blue, and sea green spiderwebbing across it only to disappear beyond the edges.  A quiet hum fills the air.

title: [Introspection Dahcre Chamber]
description: Slender columns of mica-flecked black marble punctuate the walls of this room, supporting a ceiling of elegant black basalt tracery.  The hearth is crafted of the same unusual marble; set above the mantlepiece, a silver looking-glass glints oddly in the twice-reflected light.  A silver tray bearing exotic refreshments rests on a carved ebony sidetable nearby.  Above the obsidian archway opening into this room, a silvery moonstone medallion glitters coldly.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Subterranean Hideaway]
description: Several bioluminescent fungi dotting the walls and ceiling provide light for the subterranean cavern, casting a soothing blue-green glow over everything.  Set into the moist rock wall, a ladder leads to a wooden panel in the ceiling.  A single strand of tiny glass baubles hangs over a partially buried sea chest, each glowing with a yellow-red light, and steam rises from a handcarved stone pool in the center of the cavern.  Some shelves hold several towels and a handful of refreshments.

title: [Oteska's Den, Entry]
description: Wood made from repurposed ships' hulls lines the floors and walls of this small entryway, all polished to a rich sheen.  The variety of woods and hues is broken by an iron-worked rich maoral door leading back to the shop, and a spiral staircase winding up.  Hanging between a pair of crossed cutlasses is a brass plaque, and an unusually neat pile of netted glass floats is carefully arranged in one corner, each globe dimly lit from the inside to illuminate the area.
b.location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Great Western Sea]
description: The nearby schooner offers some protection from the choppy water of the Northern Waves.  The great hull of the nearby krolvin warship is dangerously close, threatening to crush you between the two ships.  A long rope ladder descends from the schooner above, allowing ease of access to the vessel for those overboard.
a.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Great Western Sea, Schooner]
description: Two tall masts reach skyward, each bearing a large unfurled sail.  The salty sea air has smoothed and faded the blond wood of the deck and rails, although the ship's wheel maintains a rich honey hue, having been meticulously polished by an assiduous crew.  A long wooden bench runs along the sides of the schooner, offering both seating and shelter for objects stored beneath.  An iron chain as thick as a giantman's arm secures a heavy black anchor to the ship's bow.
b.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the middle of the rock wall, lending access to deep niches carved out of the stone.  Winks of gold and other metallic hues flash from the darkness of several of the holds.  A single such recess might be the work of nature, but the even procession of them suggests that they must be the work of skilled beings.  Above, the rock wall is smoother and lends little purchase for climbing.  In some places it appears smooth as blown glass.

title: [Altar of the Sea's Bargain]
description: Winds scream about the peak of the talon that gives the island its name, tossing the sparse grass scattered across the tiny plateau at the summit.  Sprouting from the grass as if it grew there, an ornate seaglass altar dominates the space.  Held aloft by a twist of seaglass is a clear glass orb.  Veils of swirling mist spin about the island as if it is the eye at the center of a hurricane.  They conceal all but the vaguest view of the storm-swept ocean and the mainland beyond.

title: [Ethnobotany Conservatory]
description: Rays of moonlight pierce through the ceiling-high windows of the conservatory, highlighting the orderly wooden bookshelves filled with colorful leather-bound tomes and folios.  Several embroidery-covered chairs are scattered beside the live-edged haon table, the arrangement facing the blackboard attached to the sketching-draped walls.  A tri-legged easel stands beside a staircase leading to the facility above, the narrow hallway displaying artifacts and small knickknacks on angular displays.

title: [Ethnobotany Research]
description: A circular display dominates the center of the window-framed room, the inner walls of the table reinforced by riveted plates of drakar radiating constant heat across the sand-filled pit.  Smaller versions of the rounded containers are scattered across the expansive facility, each one uniquely erected with varieties of glass, metal, and clockwork contraptions slowly clicking at random intervals.  The chair-lined wall displays hand-sketched studies of several species alongside stacks of scrolls.

title: [Underground, Narrow Tunnel]
description: Black shadows dance on the periphery of your vision, but you can never seem to focus on anything long enough to identify it.  The floor of the tunnel is slick from a constant trickle of water that runs down the walls and your footing doesn't seem very secure.

title: [House Aspis, Wine Cellar]
description: This is a long narrow space under the foundations of the house.  It is cooler than the rooms above and rather a bit damper.  Long rows of dust covered bottles sit on wooden racks along one wall.  Casks of ale, mead, brandy and other liquid delights squat along the other wall awaiting their call to duty in the lounges and rooms abovestairs. Beads of moisture collect along fissures in the walls and an occasional drip echoes faintly through the still air.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Stage Right]
description: Through the heavy curtain, one has a clear view of the stage.  This darkened corner provides an ideal place to reflect.  There is a hushed silence as people move to perform various duties.

title: [Den of the Dragon]
description: Some open curtains of heavy, dark green velvet drape the vast stage, and argent tenting protects it and the closest pews from the elements without ruining the view of the rest of the audience.  Globes of ethereal, magical lights hang overhead, beaming their glows in strategic directions controlled by a series of overhead ropes and pulleys that disappear behind the dark, backstage curtains.  A shiny silver plaque adorns the front of a podium to the right of the stage and a walkway leads up and out.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Stage Left]
description: From this vantage point, one can see all that happens on the stage just beyond the slightly open curtain.  From this room, it is quite possible that every whisper could be heard by an audience.  Above are pulleys through which braided ropes are drawn and left to drape down.  The rope ends are coiled neatly to avoid mishap.

title: [Bayview Manor, Ruined Workshop]
description: The smell of burnt timber and cloth, which is relieved only by the large hole that has been blasted into the roof, permeates the remnants of this shattered workshop.  Large spiderweb cracks radiate outward from the central point of this large, round room.  Throughout, shattered bits of plinite have embedded themselves into the wall, their inner light casting a dull, ethereal glow. In the center, a makeshift platform has been erected and topped with a polished silver telescope.

title: [Bayview Manor, Library]
description: Sturdy floor-to-ceiling shelving filled with books and folios organized by subject matter line the walls of the room.  Atop a thick wool rug in the center of the room sits a dark byssine-lined chair and a grand mahogany desk covered in neatly organized papers and trays containing various alchemical apparatuses.  Above, a polished gold lantern hangs from a decorative canopy that has been inlaid with various gemstone constellations.

title: [More Fantabulous, Hatch]
description: Only the edges of the polished oak floor are visible, as most is covered by a bright blue rug.  Some invar hooks hang from one wall, while a thick cherrywood rack flanks the opposite.  A burnished steel hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [More Fantabulous, Storage]
description: Numerous wooden crates and boxes are stacked up throughout this storerom.  One area near the real wall is kept clear, save for a small padded cot and a cushioned tanik bench.  A polished silver lamp hangs low on the wall just above the cot.

title: [Bloodriven Village - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Countinghouse]
description: Shadows dart in and out of this corner nook, and hushed whispers mix with the distinctive sound of clinking coins.  Raucous cheers from the arena make it nearly impossible to understand the mutterings.  A pair of black-gloved hands poke out from beneath a stone ledge, ready to accept your coins.

title: [Keep Tower, Seareach Room]
description: Swathes of dust-heavy cobwebs fall in lengths across the darkened room, which is surrounded by dozens of tapestries that depict similar scenes.  Several lacquered masts, each hung with a different flag, are arranged through the room and are labeled with the names of historical vessels.

title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
description: Light filters in from the arched opening at one end of the corridor, a surprising change from the previous levels.  The same two doors -- one hidden near the shadow of the stairs leading down, the other opposite an arrow loop -- are the only embellishment to the otherwise plain ashlar walls.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Garden]
description: Nestled between rhododendron and hemlock, a swift stream tumbles over a craggy ledge ten feet above the ground in a continuous waterfall, spilling into a rock-lined pool.  A knotted hemp rope dangles from a magnificent hollow-trunk tree hung with myriad glass orbs illuminating a pebbled path winding through creeping vines and overgrown roots.  Beneath a low-hanging limb, a roomy hammock of meshed twine fishing net offers needful repose amid the tuneful waters synchronized with buzzing insects and echoing birdsong.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Platform]
description: Secluded behind drapes of interwoven vines, an oversized, downy feather bed nestled in a cradle of curving branches is situated in the center of a lofty platform overlooking a lush garden.  A near-perfect circular opening in the canopy overhead acts as a skylight, offering a glimpse beyond the verdurous sanctuary.  Thrown over a gnarled branch of a prodigious, hollow-trunk tree, a length of knotted rope dangles over the pooling water of a woodland waterfall below.

title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
description: Cramped clusters of spruce trees decorate the grey-white landscape and compete for space along the narrow trail, their limbs sagging tirelessly beneath the weight of fresh snow.  Chunks of ice rain down from higher ledges and threaten any who dawdle.  A formidable precipice intersects with the trail and severs the path to lower ground.

title: [Dragonspine, Frozen Cave]
description: Deceivingly larger than expected, this cave is comprised of a sturdy rock ledge with ample room for a few adventurers, a small campfire, and a vast, open space that plummets to the depths below.  Obstructive ice stalactites hang from above and occasionally unite with a twin stalagmite to form an impressive ice column.  Plumes of steam rise from the platform edge and disperse along the ceiling to refreeze and replenish the ceaseless ice formations.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Clearing]
description: Built from indigenous trees, a makeshift shelter is barely enough to keep the elements from soaking the ground and everything underneath.  Thick branches, greenery, a bit of mud, and some sizeable sheets of oilcloth have all been applied to the outside to aid with weatherproofing, though heavy winds manage to keep the refuge in a state of constant repair.  Tucked neatly beneath the wood frame, with space leftover for a few travelers, a hollowed-out tree stump and a smooth cottonwood bench offer a few basic amenities.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Rocky Ledge]
description: No wider than a couple of feet, it has become increasingly difficult to maneuver along this sturdy strip of stone that cuts in and out of the mountain's natural shape.  Rocks crunch loudly underfoot, and smaller pebbles roll off the ledge and meet an early demise on the ground below.  Fortunately, a small clearing is a short jump over a deep crevice and should provide suitable accommodations for a brief rest.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: Set back from the water's edge, a large round stone hut partially conceals the mouth of a cave.  Always assailing, powerful gusts of wind blow between them and create something like a low whistle; a sad and mournful song.

title: [Titan's Crown, Cave]
description: Though shallow, the cave offers enough protection from the wind and rain to allow for the maintenance of a small fire.  The smoke fills the air, billowing up in white clouds and bathing strips of meat slowly drying on racks all around the firepit.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Spanning the distance to an upper southern ledge, this bridge doesn't seem sturdy enough to support the weight of a single individual, much less a group of multiples.  Wide gaps between each of its wooden slats give a bird's eye view of the rocky cavern floor, which appears to be littered with skeletal remains.  Faint growls and snorts echo through the area, but it's difficult to pinpoint their origin, as every sound seems to bounce off the walls multiple times.

title: [Raining Caves, Behind the Falls]
description: Thick and heavy, the excessive humidity is harsh enough to leave one gasping for fresh, cool air, which is severely lacking in this cave system.  Connected bridges and ledges create a navigable circle around a large chasm, and a foreboding tunnel is evident on the south ledge.  Connectors of questionable craftsmanship, made from fraying rope and moldy ironwood planks, bridge the gaps between the platforms and ledges, which would otherwise be unreachable.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Spanning the distance to an upper southern ledge, this bridge doesn't seem sturdy enough to support the weight of a single individual, much less a group of multiples.  Wide gaps between each of its wooden slats give a bird's eye view of the rocky cavern floor, which appears to be littered with skeletal remains.  Faint growls and snorts echo through the area, but it's difficult to pinpoint their origin, as every sound seems to bounce off the walls multiple times.

title: [Raining Caves, South Ledge]
description: Providing an encompassing glimpse of the area from this lofty vantage point, it is obvious that both moonlight and moisture are able to infiltrate the cavern given the glistening rock walls and the resulting performance of twinkles that dance around the black abyss.  In addition to the ramshackle connectors, a dark tunnel, with disembodied howls emerging from its opening, begs investigation.  A tiny trickle of water flows down the slick granite wall, easily overlooked if not for a small puddle directly beneath.

title: [Raining Caves, South Ledge]
description: Providing an encompassing glimpse of the area from this lofty vantage point, it is obvious that both moonlight and moisture are able to infiltrate the cavern given the glistening rock walls and the resulting performance of twinkles that dance around the black abyss.  In addition to the ramshackle connectors, a dark tunnel, with disembodied howls emerging from its opening, begs investigation.  A tiny trickle of water flows down the slick granite wall, easily overlooked if not for a small puddle directly beneath.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Dark granite walls with a slick sheen form a long east-west tunnel with what appears to be a larger open area at the eastern end.  Droplets of moisture fall from the ceiling and create a pit-a-pat that echoes throughout the corridors and resembles the sound of a light rain.  Translucid veils of mist, tinged slightly with a greenish hue, appear periodically and float in the air like clouds, only to be dispersed with the least bit of movement.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: With even the most careful of steps, the bridge sways back and forth in a precarious manner, creaking and groaning as if it could surrender to its shoddy condition at any moment.  Worn smooth after excessive use, the ropes used for handholds bear an unfortunate side effect of the excessive humidity:  a chalky, dark green mold.  Splintered sections of wood detach from the structure's main slats with a distressing crack, similar to that of a bone breaking.

title: [Raining Caves, South Ledge]
description: Providing an encompassing glimpse of the area from this lofty vantage point, it is obvious that both moonlight and moisture are able to infiltrate the cavern given the glistening rock walls and the resulting performance of twinkles that dance around the black abyss. title: [Raining Caves, East Ledge]
description: Chilled beads of water rain down from the cave's stone canopy, a veil of moisture clouding the main panorama.  Partially excavated, with a mining pick lodged into the granite and its wooden handle broken in half, a small alcove gathers a pool of water as its entrance slopes downward.  An iron lantern with yellowed glass panes hangs from a patinaed copper hook.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Without an abundance of light, the ability to identify distant objects is difficult at best.  The location of this bridge, however, is situated directly beneath a thin stream of light, infiltrating the cavern from an aperture farther up the wall.  Prowling and lurking far below are packs of hounds, some with eyes that cast a green glow, and others whose nostrils erupt a green mist.  Patches of tinged fog rise slowly into the air, but dissipate long before they reach the bridge.

title: [Raining Caves, East Ledge]
description: A short overhang provides a temporary reprieve from relentless raindrops falling from the ceiling.  Significantly cooler drafts from above plummet and commingle with the humid, warmer air below, creating a blanket of thick fog that swells and recedes, like ocean waves.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Without an abundance of light, the ability to identify distant objects is difficult at best.  The location of this bridge, however, is situated directly beneath a thin stream of light, infiltrating the cavern from an aperture farther up the wall.  Prowling and lurking far below are packs of hounds, some with eyes that cast a green glow, and others whose nostrils erupt a green mist.  Patches of tinged fog rise slowly into the air, but dissipate long before they reach the bridge.

title: [Raining Caves, North Ledge]
description: Seemingly suspended between two bridges, the north ledge does not connect with the wall at the floor, making movement somewhat problematic.  Periodic vibrations rumble through the cavern and rattle the floating stone slab, bits of rock crumbling free and falling to the chasm floor.  There are a number of persistent trickles, liquid threads from floor to ceiling, greatly resembling puppet strings.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Bouncing with unbridled motion, this fragile link between the west ledge and north ledge quickly becomes a lifebuoy, evidenced by the haggard condition of the once-thick ropes that serve as railings.  An echoing drip-drop sound serves only to distract from the inability to see clearly in this mist-laden area of the cavern.  Slick walls glisten despite sufficient lighting, mostly due to silvery blue flecks imbedded into the stone.

title: [Raining Caves, North Ledge]

title: [Raining Caves, Platform]
description: Deep scrapes and gashes surrounding a deep pit suggest that a clawed creature has either buried a treasure or wants to dig something up.  Given the harsh aromas ascending from the center of the cavern, the likelihood that dead things are buried throughout is increasing.  From this ledge, it's difficult to see any detail given the lack of lighting, but there is definite movement at the bottom of the chasm.

title: [Hinterwilds - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Brindlestoat's, Moneylender]
description: A crooked wooden desk dominates the small nook to the eastern end of the jeweler's shop.  A tattered green banner above is stitched with piles of glinting coins.  At the desk sits a wizened halfling moneylender who pores over his ledgers with squinting eyes.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The ashy-hued surroundings contrast with the horizon of an endless blackness.  A layered settlement of rocks juts outward, displaying a narrow fissure in the cliff allowing entrance into an underground cavern.

title: [Bleaklands, Nightmare Cavern]
description: The uneven earthen ground descends sharply, narrowing as it does before opening into an immense cavern.  Columns of stalagmites rise from the floor, rugged and twisted like jagged, broken teeth.  A faint, dark mist blankets the area, creeping along the base of the rock pillars.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Garden]
description: Spiderwebs glint silver in the daylight that creeps through the branches of crooked birches enclosing the temple's yard.  The silken webs stretch between the trees and entangle a gate of ebon metal along the plot's perimeter, though the noise of the abounding street is muffled and distant.  Dark flagstones offer a path through the creeping undergrowth toward a dark stone vault nestled deep within the thickly clustered trees.

title: [Shadowsilk Passage, Dark Path]
description: Tiny black arachnids writhe over the cragged surface of the cave walls, and in the light from the web-rimmed entrance, their bodies seem a shifting sea of quickened onyx.  The surreptitious sussurus of countless scurrying steps echoes down a northeastern tunnel, where green-tinged pale phosphorescence relieves the shadows.  A pungent scent like crude oil saturates the air.

title: [The Old Ossuary, Boneyard]
description: Piles of bones, some bleached to whiteness and others still with shreds of flesh clinging to them, are scattered around this yard in orderly clumps.  A rough pathway has been organized through the scattered debris to a clearing in the middle of the chaos that holds a short bloodstained table and an overturned mammoth skull with massive yellowed tusks.  A pile of skulls has been assembled into a makeshift crypt, the entrance flanked by blue-flamed torches.

title: [The Old Ossuary, Crypt]
description: Despite being made of interlinked bones, this crypt seems fairly sturdy.  Flickering blue flame illuminates the space from lit candles sitting inside several of the skulls set into the crooked walls, the eerie light making it seem like the skull's eyes are glowing.  The floor, unlike the rest of the structure, is made of packed dirt.

title: [Ramshackle Lighthouse, Overview]
description: The chilly wind blows across the open space, amplifying the sounds of waves crashing across the Tenebrous Cauldron as they echo across the wooden framework.  A hemp rope-knotted vine hangs along a beam set across the cylindrical roof, swaying gently in the ambient breeze, causing the tiny bells woven through the fibers to tinkle quietly.  Unoccupied nests of straw and shredded parchment frame the staircase leading down to the ground, the wall above them affixed with small trinkets crafted from sea glass.

title: [Otterstide Pool]
description: A scattering of flat-topped boulders encircle the blue-colored waters of the pool, the ripples gently lapping against the strands of sea kelp clinging to the sun-bleached rocks.  Bright flags of sailcloth hang in garlands across the ramshackle lighthouse erected from various scraps of wood, the ship names carved across the planks in a myriad of languages.  Nestled away from the rocks are several otter-carved stools and tables covered in banana leaves, the seating shaded by a grove of verdant palm trees.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Under a blanket of stars, azure waters shimmer across travertine terraces, forming cool pools that beckon passersby to visit for a nighttime dip.  Steam from the pools higher up the cliff forms a pale haze in the air that dances and sparkles as the starlight above twinkles.  Creating a cozy retreat, a cobalt blue sailcloth canopy arcs over a resting area illuminated by blown glass globes.  A solitary tamarisk tree, in full bloom, casts intricate shadows upon the starlight-illuminated travertine nearby with its twisted branches and looping roots.

title: [Travertine Terrace, Canopy]
description: Smooth and subtly textured, the ground beneath the cobalt blue canopy is fashioned of planned travertine.  Brightly colored cushions are scattered about the wide area, forming small and large social circles around low cedar tables covered in chilled offerings.  Several smaller, kidney-shaped pools of azure water naturally form to the north and east, each one filled from those higher up the steep incline.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Starlight casts a silvery glow on an opulent bank's grand domed roof, emphasizing its elegant design and smooth curves.  Marble walls with golden accents give off a subtle glimmer as they reflect the light of nearby blown glass lanterns.  Whorled heather, kriti, sea spurge, and fan palms frame the building, their slender fronds and pale blossoms painted in gradient shades of silver and grey.  Broad marble steps, veined in gold and grey, proceed from the avenue up to the doors, which stand open and inviting.

title: [Isle of Ornath Bank, Lobby]
description: Grey and gold-veined marble sprawl across the floor, the highly polished surface reflecting the sunlight that spills through the glass windows at the base of the pendentive dome above.  Golden linden inlay at the heart of the floor creates a compass rose that is wreathed by calligraphed words.  Limestone pillars, in groups of three, rise from the eight points of the pentagonal room, each group supporting arches over the branching hallways.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, out

title: [Gallery, Inside the Eye]
description: A stone platform justs out like a pier over a lake of molton red lava, fed by the many tubes that flow down the rocky walls.  Crude images have been carved into the walls of the volcano, representing fiery beasts and hideous creatures.  An uneven steel staircase has been constructed along one side.  Its steps are crooked and tilted, but the bolts that secure it to the wall seem strong enough.

title: [Gallery, Above the Isle]
description: A circular balcony fashioned of brilliantly polished mithril surrounds the entire room.  Daylight streams through the domed ceiling above, though the vision below is far more ominous.  Ascending from far below is a model of the Eye of V'tull, its cone rising through the center of the balcony's ring.  Its edge is close, just on the other side of the balcony's rail.

A circular balcony fashioned of brilliantly polished mithril surrounds the entire room.  The domed ceiling above sparkles with the reflection of torchlight off the hundreds of white starstones that dangle from the blue-black canopy.  Ascending from far below is a model of the Eye of V'tull, its cone rising through the center of the balcony's ring.  Its edge is close, just on the other side of the balcony's rail.

title: [House Paupers, Ice Bar]
description: Sturdy pale pine beams provide support for the ceiling and walls of this room carved deep into the glacier while leaving much of the ice uncovered, keeping the air chilled.  A glass chandelier hangs over the crystal bar that dominates the room, sending a kaleidoscope of color over everything.  Despite the chill, the plush chairs and divans invite you to linger until you're ready to traverse the narrow tunnel again.

title: [House Paupers, Great Room]
description: Carved from the glacier, the room is given an airy warmth by pine planks covering the floor and curving up the walls to the domed ceiling.  The western wall is dominated by a large fireplace framed by sandstone tiles and flanked by arched openings.  A crystal chandelier reminiscent of icicles hangs above a large oval table adorned with a gold wool runner and surrounded by fur-covered benches and chairs.  Periodic waves of cold air flow from beneath a curtain of caribou hides while some oak doors lead out to the porch.

title: [Kestrel's Perch, Sitting Room]
description: Polished oak paneling skirts the lodge, contrasting with green trim and upholstery on the generous leather armchairs.  A large trestle table occupies one of the room's ends, flanked by a number of carved oak chairs.  In the shadow of an overstuffed green sofa is a narrow slatted stairway, which leads upward to an open loft.  A stone hearth dominates all, occupying the long wall across from a painted green door.  Above the hearth, an immense elk trophy surveys its domain with a solemn gaze.
a.location: Kestrel's Perch, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Kestrel's Perch, Loft]
description: Tucked under the smoothly sanded oak planks of the peaked ceiling is a rather spacious loft that runs the entire width and nearly half the length of the cabin.  An intricately carved oak railing offers a view of the room below, broken only by a narrow slatted stairway.  Sunlight streams through a bay window, casting brilliant pools of light on the large braided rug that covers the floor.  Nestled opposite the window is a large four-poster bed, while a large oak armoire stands off to one side.

title: [Kestrel's Perch, Sitting Room]

A large trestle table occupies one of the room's ends, flanked by a number of carved oak chairs.
